Bekhorot 36a:5-11: Amar rabbi ila: lo hayu muchezakin bo shehu bechor, uva echad veamar shehu bechor umumo immo — neeman.
May ka mashma lan, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir? tenena: haishsha sheamra "eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani" neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dei baaya la amra. aval hacha, dela saggi dela amra, dekadashim bechutz la achel,
Ema: la happe sheasar hu, ka mashma lan, dei mishshum hachi — hava shade beh muma denikkar veachel leh.

Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: may shena mehahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh, vaamar leh: la tezil beorcha dinhar pekod deikka mayya, zil beorcha denaresh delekka mayya. azal beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamara, vaata vaamar leh: beorcha dinhar pekod azli, umihu mayya la havo.
Vaamar rava: ma lo leshakker, i bae amar: beorcha denaresh azali. vaamar abbaye: "ma lo leshakker" bimkom edim la amrinan.

Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday ikka mayya, hacha vadday shade beh muma — chashasha hu, uvimkom chashasha amrinan "ma lo leshakker". yatev ravina vekaamar lehay shemata bela gavra, amar leh rava zute leravina: anan mishshemeh derabbi ila matninan la.
Berakhot 51a:18-51b:9: Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hamevarech al kos male — notnin lo nachala beli metzarim, shenneemar: "umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha". rabbi yose bar chanina omer: zoche venochel shene olamim, haolam hazze vehaolam habba.
Ittur. rav yehuda meatterehu betalmidim, rav chisda meattar leh benatle. amar rabbi chanan: uvechay. amar rav sheshet: uvevirkat haaretz.
Ittuf. rav pappa miattaf veyatev. rav assi pares sudara al resheh.
Notlo bishte yadav. amar rabbi chinnana bar pappa: may keraa? — "seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai".
Venotno layyamin. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: rishonim shaalu: semol mahu shettesayyea layyamin? amar rav ashe: hoil verishonim ibbaya lehu velo ippeshit lehu,
Umagbiho min hakkarka tefach. amar rav acha berabbi chanina: may keraa — "kos yeshuot essa uveshem Adonai ekra".
Venoten enav bo — ki hechi dela nayssach dateh minneh.
Umeshaggero leanshe beto bemattana — ki hechi detitbarach devethu.

Ulla ikkela leve rav nachman. kerech rifta, barech birkat mezona, yehav leh kasa devirketa lerav nachman. amar leh rav nachman: lishaddar mar kasa devirketa leyalta. amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: en peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish, shenneemar "uverach peri vitnecha". "peri vitnah" lo neemar, ella "peri vitnecha".
Tanya name hachi, rabbi natan omer: minnayin sheen peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish — shenneemar: "uverach peri vitnecha", "peri vitnah" lo neemar, ella "peri vitnecha".

Addehachi shemaa yalta, kama bezihara, veallat leve chamra, utevara arba mea danne dechamra. amar leh rav nachman: neshaddar la mar kasa acharina, shelach la: kol hay navga, devirketa hi. shelacha leh: mimmehaddure — mille, umissemartute — kalme.

Amar rav assi: en massichin al kos shel beracha. veamar rav assi: en mevarchin al kos shel pureanut. may "kos shel pureanut"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kos sheni. tanya name hachi: hashshote kiflayim lo yevarech, mishshum shenneemar "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael", vehay la metakkan.

Amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: haochel umehallech mevarech meummad, ucheshehu ochel meummad — mevarech meyushshav, ucheshehu mesev veochel — yoshev umevarech. vehilcheta bechullehu yoshev umevarech.
Chagigah 3a:15-3b:5: Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi yochanan ben beroka verabbi elazar [ben] chisma shehalchu lehakebil pene rabbi yehoshua bifkiin. amar lahem: ma chiddush haya bevet hammidrash hayyom? amru lo: talmidecha anu umemecha anu shotin. amar lahem: af al pi chen, i efshar levet hammidrash belo chiddush.
Shabbat shel mi hayta? shabbat shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta. uvamme hayta haggada hayyom? amru lo: befarashat hakehel. uma darash bah?

"Hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf". im anashim baim lilmod, nashim baot lishmoa, taf lamma bain? kede litten sachar limviehen. amar lahem: margalit tova hayta beyadchem, uvikkashtem leabbedah mimmenni?
Veod darash: "et Adonai heemarta hayyom", "vaAdonai heemircha hayyom",

Amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: attem asituni chativa achat baolam, vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam. attem asituni chativa achat baolam, dichtiv: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad", vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam, shenneemar:

Veaf hu patach vedarash: "divre chachamim kaddarvonot uchemasmerot netuim baale asuppot nittenu meroe echad", lamma nimshelu divre tora ledarvan? lomar lach: ma darvan ze mechavven et happara litlameha lehotzi chayyim leolam — af divre tora mechavvevnin et lomdehen middarche mita ledarche chayyim. i ma darvan ze mittaltel — af divre tora mittaltelin, talmud lomar: "masmerot".

I ma masmer ze chaser velo yater — af divre tora chaserin velo yeterin, talmud lomar: "netuim", ma netia zo para verava — af divre tora parin veravin. "baale asuppot" — ellu talmide chachamim, sheyyoshvin asuppot asuppot veoskin battora. hallalu metammein vehallalu metaharin, hallalu osrin vehallalu mattirin, hallalu poslin vehallalu machshirin,

Shemma yomar adam: heach ani lamed tora meatta — talmud lomar: "kullam nittenu meroe echad". el echad netanan, parnas echad amaran, mippi adon kol hammaasim baruch hu, dichtiv: "vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle".

Af atta, ase oznecha kaafarkeset, ukene lecha lev mevin lishmoa et divre metammeim veet divre metaharim, et divre osrin veet divre mattirin, et divre foslin veet divre machshirin. ballashon hazze amar lahem: en dor yatom sherabbi elazar ben azarya sharuy betocho.
Isaiah 40:1-6: Dabberu al-lev yerushala͏m vekiru eleha ki mala tzevaah ki nirtza avonah ki lakcha miyyad Adonai kiflayim bechol-chattoteha {s}
Kol kore bammidbar pannu derech Adonai yashsheru baarava mesilla lelohenu
Kol-ge yinnase vechol-har vegiva yishpalu vehaya heakov lemishor veharchasim levika
Venigla kevod Adonai verau chol-basar yachdav ki pi Adonai dibber {p}
Kol omer kera veamar ma ekra kol-habbasar chatzir vechol-chasdo ketzitz hassade
Isaiah 40:11-15: Keroe edro yire bizroo yekabbetz telaim uvecheko yissa alot yenahel {s}
Mi-madad beshoolo mayim veshamayim bazzeret tikken vechol bashshalish afar haaretz veshakal bappeles harim ugevaot bemoznayim
Mi-tikken et-ruach Adonai veish atzato yodiennu
Et-mi noatz vayvinehu vaylammedehu beorach mishpat vaylammedehu daat vederech tevunot yodiennu
Hen goyim kemar middeli ucheshachak moznayim nechshavu hen iyyim kaddak yittol
Isaiah 40:16-21: Ulevanon en de baer vechayyato en de ola {p}
Kol-haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu-lo
Veel-mi tedammeyun el uma-demut taarchu lo
Happesel nasach charash vetzoref bazzahav yerakkeennu uretukot kesef tzoref
Hamesukkan teruma etz lo-yirkav yivchar charash chacham yevakkesh-lo lehachin pesel lo yimmot {s}
Halo tedu halo tishmau halo huggad merosh lachem halo havinotem mosdot haaretz
Isaiah 40:22-26: Hayyoshev al-chug haaretz veyoshveha kachagavim hannote chaddok shamayim vayyimtachem kaohel lashavet
Hannoten roznim leayin shofte eretz kattohu asa
Af bal-nittau af bal-zorau af bal-shoresh baaretz gizam vegam-nashaf bahem vayyivashu useara kakkash tissaem {s}
Seu-marom enechem ureu mi-vara elle hammotzi vemispar tzevaam lechullam beshem yikra merov onim veammitz koach ish lo nedar {s}
Isaiah 40:7-10: Yavesh chatzir navel-tzitz ki ruach Adonai nashva bo achen chatzir haam
Yavesh chatzir navel tzitz udevar-elohenu yakum leolam {s}
Al har-gavoah ali-lach mevasseret tziyyon harimi vakkoach kolech mevasseret yerushala͏m harimi al-tirai imri leare yehuda hinne elohechem
Hinne adonay Adonai bechazak yavo uzeroo moshla lo hinne secharo itto ufeullato lefanav
Mishnah Beitzah 1:1-2:
Betza shennolda veyom tov, bet shammay omrim, teachel. uvet hillel omrim, lo teachel. bet shammay omrim, seor bechazzayit vechametz bechakkotevet. uvet hillel omrim, ze vaze bechazzayit: 
Hashshochet chayya vaof beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, yachpor bedeker vichasse, uvet hillel omrim, lo yishchot, ella im ken haya lo afar muchan mibbeod yom. umodim, sheim shachat, sheyyachpor bedeker vichasse, sheefer kira muchan hu:
Mishnah Beitzah 1:3-6:
Bet shammay omrim, en molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach, aval mattehu mechallon lechallon. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, lo yittol, ella im ken nianea mibbeod yom. uvet hillel omrim, omed veomer ze vaze ani notel: 
Zimmen shechorim umatza levanim, levanim umatza shechorim, shenayim umatza shelosha, asurim. shelosha umatza shenayim, muttarim. betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken, asurim. veim en sham ella hem, hare ellu muttarim: 
Bet shammay omrim, en mesallekin et hatterisin beyom tov. uvet hillel mattirin af lehachazir. bet shammay omrim, en notlin et haeli lekatztzev alav basar. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en notnin et haor lifne haddorsan velo yagbihennu, ella im ken yesh immo chazzayit basar. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en motziin lo et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et sefer tora lirshut harabbim. uvet hillel mattirin: 
Bet shammay omrim, en molichin challa umattanot lakkohen beyom tov, ben shehuremu meemesh, ben shehuremu mehayyom. uvet hillel mattirin. amru lahem bet shammay, gezera shava, challa umattanot mattana lakkohen, uteruma mattana lakkohen, keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma, kach en molichin et hammattanot. amru lahem bet hillel, lo, im amartem batteruma, sheeno zakkay baharamatah, tomru vammattanot, shezzakkay baharamatan:
Mishnah Beitzah 1:7-10:
Bet shammay omrim, tevalin niddochin bemadoch shel etz, vehammelach befach, uveetz happarur. uvet hillel omrim, tevalin niddochin kedarkan bemadoch shel even, vehammelach bemadoch shel etz: 
Habborer kitnit beyom tov, bet shammay omrim, borer ochel veochel. uvet hillel omrim, borer kedarko becheko, bekanon uvetamchuy, aval lo vetavla velo venafa velo vichvara. rabban gamliel omer, af mediach veshole: 
Bet shammay omrim, en meshallechin beyom tov ella manot. uvet hillel omrim, meshallechin behema chayya vaof, ben chayyin ben shechutin. meshallechin yenot shemanim uselatot vekitniyyot, aval lo tevua, verabbi shimon mattir bitvua: 
Meshallechin kelim, ben tefurin ben sheenan tefurin, veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen kilayim, vehen letzorech hammoed, aval lo sandal hamesummar velo minal sheeno tafur. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo minal lavan, mippene shetztzarich umman. ze hakkelal, kol shenneotin bo, beyom tov meshallechin oto:
Mishnah Beitzah 2:1-5:
Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat, lo yevashshel adam battechilla miyyom tov lashshabbat, aval mevashshel hu leyom tov, veim hotir, hotir lashshabbat, veose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat. bet shammay omrim, shene tavshilin. uvet hillel omrim, tavshil echad. veshavin bedag uvetza shealav shehen shene tavshilin. achalo o sheavad, lo yevashshel alav battechilla. veim shiyyer mimmennu chol shehu, somech alav lashshabbat: 
Chal lihyot achar hashshabbat, bet shammay omrim, matbilin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, uvet hillel omrim, kelim millifne hashshabbat, veadam bashshabbat: 
Veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan, aval lo matbilin. umatbilin miggav legav umechavura lachavura: 
Bet shammay omrim, meviin shelamim veen somchin alehen, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim, meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehem: 
Bet shammay omrim, lo yachem adam chammin leraglav, ella im ken reuyin lishtiyya. uvet hillel mattirin. ose adam medura umitchammem kenegdah:
Mishnah Beitzah 2:6-9:
Shelosha devarim rabban gamliel machamir kedivre vet shammay, en tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov lashshabbat, veen zokfin et hammenora veyom tov, veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amar rabban gamliel, mimehen shel bet abba lo hayu ofin pittin geritzin, ella rekikin. amru lo, ma naase levet avicha, shehayu machamirin al atzman umekillin lechol yisrael, lihyot ofin pittin geritzin vechori: 
Af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel, mechabbedin ben hammittot, umannichin et hammugmar beyom tov, veosin gedi mekullas belele fesachim. vachachamim osrin: 
Shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir, vachachamim osrin. parato yotza virtzua shebben karneha, umekardin et habbehema veyom tov, veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahem. rabbi yehuda omer, en mekardin et habbehema veyom tov, mippene sheose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim, en mekardin, af lo mekartzefin: 
Harechayim shel pilpelin temea, mishshum shelosha chelim, mishshum keli kibbul, umishshum keli mattachot, umishshum keli chevara:
Mishnah Mikvaot 10:4-7:
Ellu shehem tzerichim sheyyavou vahen hammayim, hakkesher shebbapperaksim shebbakkatef, vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach, utefilla shel rosh bizman sheenah chotza, veshel zeroa bizman shehi ola veyoredet, ushenatzin shel sandal, uvegadim shehitbilan mechubbasin, ad sheyyevabeu. hitbilan neguvin, ad sheyyevabeu veyanuchu mibbibuan: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehem arukkin veatid liktzotz, matbilan ad mekom hammidda. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyatbil et kullo. shalshelet deli gadol, arbaa tefachim, veshel katan, asara, matbilan ad mekom hammidda. rabbi tarfon omer, ad sheyyatbil et kol hattabbaat. hachevel shehu kashur bakkuppa eno chibbur, ella im ken tafar: 
Bet shammay omrim, en matbilin chammin betzonen velo tzonen bechammin, lo yafim beraim velo raim beyafim. bet hillel omrim, matbilin. keli shehu male mashkin vehitbilo, keillu lo taval. male me raglayim, roim otam keillu hem mayim. male me chattat, ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat. rabbi yose omer, afillu cheli machazik kor veen bo ella reviit, keillu lo taval: 
Kol hoochalin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya bechachatzi feras. kol hammashkin mitztarfin lifsol et haggeviyya birviit. ze chomer beshote mashkin temein mibbammikve, sheasu vo shear hammashkin kammayim:
Mishnah Mikvaot 10:8: Achal ochalim temeim, veshata mashkim temeim, taval vehekian, temeim, mippene sheenan tehorim bagguf. shata mayim temeim, taval vehekiam, tehorim, mippene shehem tehorim bagguf. bala tabbaat tehora, nichnas leohel hammet, hizza veshana vetaval vehekiah, hare hi chemot shehayta. bala tabbaat temea, tovel veochel batteruma. hekiah, temea vetimmeattu. chetz shehu tachuv baadam, bizman shehu nire, chotzetz. veim eno nire, tovel veochel bitrumato:
Mishnah Mikvaot 8:3-9:1: Hammetil tippin avot mittoch haamma, tame, divre rabbi elazar chisma. hameharher ballayla veamad umatza vesaro cham, tame. happoletet zera bayyom hashshelishi, tehora, divre rabbi elazar ben azarya. rabbi yishmael omer, peamim shehem arba onot, peamim shehem chamesh, peamim shehem shesh. rabbi akiva omer, leolam chamesh:

Nachrit sheppalta shichvat zera miyyisrael, temea. bat yisrael sheppalta shichvat zera minnachri, tehora. haishsha sheshshimmesha vetah, veyarda vetavla, velo chibbeda et habbayit, keillu lo tavla. baal keri shettaval velo hetil et hammayim, kesheyatil et hammayim, tame. rabbi yose omer, bechole uvezaken, tame. beyeled uvevari, tahor:

Nidda shennatna maot befiha veyarda vetavla, tehora mittumatah, aval temea hi al gav rukkah. natna searah befiha, kaftza yadah, kartza siftoteha, keillu lo tavla. haochez beadam uvechelim umatbilan, temein. veim hediach et yado bammayim, tehorim. rabbi shimon omer, yerappe, kede sheyyavou vahem mayim. bet hassetarim, bet hakkematim, enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahen mayim:
Ellu chotztzin baadam, chute tzemer vechute fishtan vehartzuot shebberashe habbanot. rabbi yehuda omer, shel tzemer veshel sear enam chotztzin, mippene shehammayim bain bahem:
Mishnah Mikvaot 9:2-5:
Kilke hallev vehazzakan, uvet hassetarim baishsha, lifluf shechutz laayin, vegeled shechutz lammakka, vehartiyya shealeha, useraf hayyavesh, vegilde tzoa sheal besaro, uvatzek shettachat hatztzipporen, vehammilmulin, vetit hayyaven, vetit hayyotzrim, vegetz yeveni. ezehu tit hayyaven, ze tit habborot, shenneemar (tehillim 40), vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven. tit hayyotzrin, kemashmao. rabbi yose metaher beshel yotzrin umetamme beshel mareka. vegetz yeveni, ellu yitdot hadderachim, sheen tovlin bahen velo matbilin otan. ushear kol hattit, matbilin bo keshehu lach. velo yitbol baavak sheal raglav. lo yitbol et hakkumkemus bappechamin, ella im ken shifshef: 
Ellu sheen chotztzin, kilke harosh, uvet hashshechi, uvet hassetarim baish. rabbi eliezer omer, echad haish veechad haishsha, kol hammakpid alav, chotzetz. vesheen makpid alav, en chotzetz: 
Lifluf shebbaayin, vegeled sheal hammakka, useraf hallach, velichluche tzoa sheal besaro, vetzoa shettachat hatztzipporen, vetzipporen hameduldelet, keshut shel katan, lo tame velo metamme. kerum sheal hammakka, tame umetamme: 
Ellu chotztzim bakkelim. hazzefet vehammor bichle zechuchit, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz. al hashshulchan veal hattavla veal haddargash, al hannekiyyim, chotztzin. al habbelusin, enan chotztzin. al mittot baal habbayit, chotzetz. veal shel ani, eno chotzetz. al ikkuf shel baal habbayit, chotzetz. veal shel zakkakin, eno chotzetz. veal hammardaat, chotzetz. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad keissar haitalki:
Mishnah Mikvaot 9:6-10:3:
Al habbegadim, mitztzad echad, eno chotzetz. mishshene tzedadin, chotzetz. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yishmael, af mitztzad echad. rabbi yose omer, shel bannaim, mitztzad echad. veshel bur, mishshene tzedadin: 
Mitpachat shel zappatin veshel yotzrin veshel mefassele ilanot, en chotztzin. rabbi yehuda omer, af shel kayyatzin, kayyotze vahen. ze hakkelal, kol hammakpid alav, chotzetz. vesheeno makpid alav, eno chotzetz: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehichnisan shello chedarkan, o shehichnisan kedarkan velo merkan, o shemmerkan venishberu, hare ellu chotztzin. keli shehitbilo derech piv, keillu lo taval. hitbilo chedarko velo zibborit, ad sheyyattennu al tziddo. keli shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav min haemtza, eno tahor ad sheyyattennu al tziddo. tzelochit sheppiha shokea, enah tehora ad sheyyenakkevenna mitztziddah. kalmarin hedyotot, enah tehora ad sheyyenakkevenna mitztziddah. vekalmarin shel yosef hakkohen hayta nekuva vetziddah: 
Hakkar vehakkeset shel or, hare ellu tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim. keset agulla, vehakkaddur, vehaemum, vehakkamea, vehattefilla, enan tzerichin sheyyavou vahem hammayim. ze hakkelal, kol sheen darko lehachenis ulehotzi, tovlim setumim: 
Ellu sheenam tzerichim sheyyavou vahem hammayim, kishre heani, vehannimin, vachavat shel sandal, utefilla shel rosh bizman shehi chotza, veshel zeroa bizman sheenah ola veyoredet, veazne hachemet, veazne hattarmul:
Mishnah Niddah 1:1-3:
Shammay omer, kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. hillel omer, mippekida lifkida, vaafillu leyamim harebe. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella meet leet memaet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet. kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. vehameshammeshet beiddim, hare zo chifkida, umemaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida: 
Ketzad dayyah sheatah. hayta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka vetohorot, ufersha veraata, hi temea vechullan tehorot. af al pi sheamru, metammea meet leet, enah mona ella mishshaa sheraata: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, arba nashim dayyan sheatan, betula, meubberet, menika uzekena. amar rabbi yehoshua, ani lo shamati ella vetula, aval halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Mishnah Niddah 1:4-2:1:
Ezo hi vetula, kol shello raata dam miyyameha, af al pi shennesua. meubberet, mishsheyyivvada ubbarah. menika, ad shettigmol et benah. natna venah lemenika, gemalattu o met, rabbi meir omer, metammea meet leet. vachachamim omrim, dayyah sheatah: 
Ezohi zekena. kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot samuch leziknatah. rabbi eliezer omer, kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot, dayyah sheatah. rabbi yose omer, meubberet umenika sheavru alehen shalosh onot, dayyan sheatan: 
Uvamme amru dayyah sheatah. biriyya rishona. aval bashsheniyya, metammea meet leet. veim raata harishona meones, af hashsheniyya dayyah sheatah: 
Af al pi sheamru dayyah sheatah, tzericha lihyot bodeket, chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar. umeshammeshet beiddim, chutz miyyoshevet al dam tohar, uvetula sheddameha tehorim. ufaamayim tzericha lihyot bodeket, beshacharit uven hashshemashot, uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah. yetera alehen kohanot, beshaa shehen ochlot batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, af bishat avaratan milleechol batteruma: 
Kol hayyad hammarba livdok benashim, meshubbachat. uvaanashim, tikkatzetz. hachereshet vehashshota vehassuma veshennitrefa datah, im yesh lahen pikchot, metakkenot otan vehen ochlot batteruma. derech benot yisrael, meshammeshot bishne iddim, echad lo veechad lah. hatztzenuot metakkenot lahen shelishi, letakken et habbayit:
Mishnah Sukkah 5:2-5:
Bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag, yardu leezrat nashim, umetakkenin sham tikkun gadol. umenorot shel zahav hayu sham, vearbaa sefalim shel zahav berashehen, vearbaa sullamot lechol echad veechad, vearbaa yeladim mippirche chehunna uvidehem kaddim shel shemen shel mea veesrim log, shehen mattilin lechol sefel vasefel: 
Mibbelae michnese chohanim umehemyanehen mehen hayu mafkiin, uvahen hayu madlikin, velo hayta chatzer birushalayim sheenah meira meor bet hashshoeva: 
Chasidim veanshe maase hayu merakkedim lifnehem baavukot shel or shebbidehen, veomrim lifnehen divre shirot vetishbachot. vehaleviyyim bechinnorot uvinvalim uvimtziltayim uvachatzotzrot uvichle shir belo mispar, al chamesh esre maalot hayyordot meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, keneged chamishsha asar shir hammaalot shebbattehillim, shealehen leviyyim omdin bichle shir veomrim shira. veamdu shene chohanim bashshaar haelyon sheyyored meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, ushete chatzotzrot bidehen. kara haggever, taku veheriu vetakau. higgiu lemala asirit, taku veheriu vetakau. higgiu laazara, taku veheriu vetakau. hayu tokin veholchin, ad shemmaggiin lashshaar hayyotze mizrach. higgiu lashshaar hayyotze mimmizrach, hafchu fenehen lammaarav, veamru, avotenu shehayu vammakom hazze achorehem el hechal Adonai ufenehem kedma, vehemma mishtachavim kedma lashshamesh, veanu leyah enenu. rabbi yehuda omer, hayu shonin veomrin, anu leyah, uleyah enenu: 
En pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, veen mosifin al arbaim ushemone. bechol yom hayu sham esrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, shalosh liftichat shearim, vetesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim. uvammusafin hayu mosifin od tesha. uveerev shabbat hayu mosifin od shesh, shalosh lehavetil haam mimmelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. erev shabbat shebbetoch hechag hayu sham arbaim ushemone, shalosh liftichat shearim, shalosh lashshaar haelyon, veshalosh lashshaar hattachton, veshalosh lemilluy hammayim, veshalosh al gabbe mizbeach, tesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim, vetesha lammusafin, shalosh lehavetil et haam min hammelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol:
Mishnah Sukkah 5:6-8:
Yom tov harishon shel chag hayu sham shelosha asar parim, veelim shenayim, vesair echad. nishtayyeru sham arbaa asar kevasim lishmone mishmarot. bayyom harishon, shishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashsheni, chamishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashear echad echad. bashshelishi, arbaa makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashear echad echad. barvii, shelosha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bachamishshi, shenayim makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashshishshi, echad makriv shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashshevii, kullan shavin. bashshemini, chazru lappayis kevargalim. amru, mi shehikriv parim hayyom, lo yakriv lemachar, ella chozrin chalila: 
Bishlosha ferakim bashshana hayu kol mishmarot shavot beemure hargalim uvechilluk lechem happanim. baatzeret omrim lo, helach matztza helach chametz. mishmar shezzemanno kavua, hu makriv temidin, nedarim unedavot ushear karbenot tzibbur, umakriv et hakkol. yom tov hassamuch leshabbat, ben millefaneha ben milleachareha, hayu chol hammishmarot shavot bechilluk lechem happanim: 
Chal lihyot yom echad lehafesik bentayim, mishmar shezzemanno kavua, haya notel eser challot, vehammitakkev notel shetayim. uvishar yemot hashshana, hannichnas notel shesh, vehayyotze notel shesh. rabbi yehuda omer, hannichnas notel sheva, vehayyotze notel chamesh. hannichnasin cholkin batztzafon, vehayyotzin baddarom. bilga leolam choleket baddarom, vetabbatah kevua, vechallonah setuma:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Makom shemmafsikin beshabbat beshacharit sham korin bemincha uvesheni uvachamishi uleshabbat habbaa. ketzad. shabbat rishona korin beshacharit beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bemincha korin <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot noach" asara pesukim o yoter. vechen besheni uvachamishi. vechen leshabbat habbaa beshacharit matchilin meelle toldot noach vekore ad sof hasseder. veal derech zo korin kol hashshana. umaftirin bechol shabbat veshabbat bannavi meen shekkara battora:

Uverashe chodashim. harishon kore shelosha pesukim mipparashat <small>(Bamidbar 28 b)</small> "tzav". vehashsheni chozer vekore pasuk 3 shekkara harishon ushene pesukim sheacharav kede sheyyeshayyer bapparasha shelosha pesukim. vehashshelishi kore shelosha pesukim sheshshiyyer hashsheni im <small>(Bamidbar 28 9)</small> "uveyom hashshabbat". veharvii kore <small>(Bamidbar 28 11)</small> "uverashe chadshechem". veim chal rosh chodesh lihyot beshabbat motziin shene sefarim beshacharit. beechad korin bo seder otah shabbat uvashsheni kore bo hammashlim uverashe chadshechem. vehammaftir kore inyan rosh chodesh. umaftirin <small>(yeshaya 66 23)</small> "vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho". verosh chodesh av shechal lihyot beshabbat maftirin <small>(yeshaya 1 14)</small> "chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi". verosh chodesh shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat maftirin bashshabbat shellefanav <small>(Shmuel 1 20 18)</small> "vayyomer lo yehonatan machar chodesh":

Kol haole likrot battora poteach bedavar tov umesayyem bedavar tov. aval parashat <small>(Devarim 32 1)</small> "haazinu" kore harishon ad <small>(Devarim 32 7)</small> "zechor yemot olam". vehashsheni matchil mizzechor yemot olam ad <small>(Devarim 32 13)</small> "yarkivehu". vehashshelishi miyyarkivehu ad vayyar Adonai vayyinatz. veharvii min vayyar Adonai vayyinatz ad <small>(Devarim 32 29)</small> "lu chachmu". vehachamishi min lo chachmu ad <small>(Devarim 32 40)</small> "ki essa el shamayim yadi". vehashshishshi mikki essa el shamayim yadi ad sof hashshira. velamma poskin bah beinyanot ellu mippene shehen tochacha kede sheyyachzeru haam bitshuva:

Shemona pesukim shebbesof hattora muttar likrot otam bevet hakkeneset befachot measara. af al pi shehakkol tora hi umoshe mippi haggevura amaram hoil umashmaan shehem achar mitat moshe hare nishtannu ulefichach muttar leyachid likrot otan:

Kelalot shebbetorat kohanim en mafsikin bahen ella echad kore otan matchil bappasuk shellifnehem umesayyem bappasuk shel acharehem. ukelalot shebbemishne tora im ratza lifsok bahen posek uchevar nahagu haam shello lifsok bahen ella echad kore otan:

Beshacharit bemusaf uvinilo hakkohanim nosim et kappehem. aval bemincha en nesiat kappayim. mippene shebbemincha kevar saadu kol haam veshemma shatu hakkohanim yayin veshikkor asur binsiat kappayim. vaafillu beyom taanit en nosin kappehen bemincha gezera minchat taanit mippene minchat kol yom:

Bamme devarim amurim betaaniyyot shemmitpallelin bo mincha uneila kegon tzom kippur vetaanit tzibbur. aval taanit sheen bo neila kegon tisha beav veshiva asar betammuz hoil utefillat mincha shellahem samuch lishkiat hachamma hare niret kinila veenah mitchallefet bemincha shel kol yom. ulefichach yesh bah nesiat kappayim. vechohen sheavar veala ladduchan bemincha shel yom hakkippurim hoil vehaddavar yadua sheen sham shichrut hare ze nose kappav veen moridin oto mippene hachashad shello yomru pasul haya lefichach horiduhu:

Ketzad hi nesiat kappayim baggevulin. beet sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur laavoda kesheyyomar retze kol hakkohanim haomdim bevet hakkeneset neekarin mimmekoman veholchin veolin ladduchan veomdim sham penehem lahechol vaachorehem kelappe haam veetzbeotehem kefufot letoch kappehem ad sheyyashlim sheliach tzibbur hahodaa umachzirin penehem kelappe haam ufoshtin etzbeotehen umagbihin yedehem keneged kitfehem umatchilin <small>(Bamidbar 6 kad)</small> "yevarechcha". usheliach tzibbur makre otam milla milla vehem onin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 23)</small> "amor lahem" ad sheyyomar. keshemmashlimin pasuk rishon kol haam onin amen. vechozer sheliach tzibbur umakre otan pasuk sheni milla milla vehem onim ad shemmashlimin pasuk sheni vechol haam onin amen. vechen befasuk shelishi:

Kesheyyashlimu hakkohanim shelosha pesukim matchil sheliach tzibbur beracha acharona shel tefilla shehi sim shalom vehakkohanim machzirin penehem kelappe hakkodesh vekoftzin etzbeotehen veomdin sham badduchan ad sheyyigmor habberacha vechozrin limkoman:

En hammakre rashshay (lehakerot lakkohanim) ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen hakkohanim rashshain lehatechil babberacha ad sheyyichle haddibbur mippi hammakre. veen hatztzibbur onin amen ad shettichle habberacha mippi hakkohanim. veen hakkohanim matchilin bivracha acheret ad sheyyichle amen mippi hatztzibbur. veen sheliach tzibbur rashshay laanot amen achar hakkohanim kishar haam shemma tittaref dato velo yeda ezo beracha makre otan, im pasuk sheni o pasuk shelishi:

En hakkohanim rashshain lehachazir penehem min hatztzibbur ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen hakkohanim rashshain leaker mimmekoman ad sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur sim shalom. veen rashshain lachof kishre etzbeotehem ad sheyyachaziru penehem min hatztzibbur. umittakkanot [ ezra] shello yaalu hakkohanim ladduchan besandelehen ella omdin yechefin:

Kesheyyihyu hakkohanim mevarchin et haam lo yabbitu baam velo yassichu datan ella yihyu enehem keneged haaretz keomed bitfilla. veen adam rashshay lehistakkel bifne hakkohanim beshaa shehen mevarchin et haam kede shello yassichu datam. ella kol haam mitkavvenin lishmoa habberacha umechavvenim penehem keneged pene hakkohanim veenam mabbitim bifnehem:

Im haya hakkohen hamevarech echad matchil levarech meatzmo. usheliach tzibbur makre oto milla milla kemo sheamarnu. hayu shenayim o yoter enan matchilin levarech ad sheyyikra lahem sheliach tzibbur veomer lahem kohanim vehem onin veomrim <small>(Bamidbar 6 kad)</small> "yevarechcha". vehu makre otan milla milla al hasseder sheamarnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:3: Kosheret ishsha mifteche hechaluk af al pi sheyyesh lo shene petachim, vechute sevacha af al pi shehu rafuy beroshah, uretzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin otan al haregel bishat malbush, venodot yayin veshemen af al pi sheyyesh lo shete aznayim, ukedera shel basar af al pi sheyyechola lehotzi habbasar velo tattir hakkesher. vekoshrin deli bimshicha o beavnet vechayyotze bo aval lo bechevel. vekoshrin lifne habbehema o beraglah bishvil shello tetze af al pi sheyyesh lah shene issarot. vechevel shehaya kashur bappara koshro baevus. haya kashur baevus koshro bappara. aval lo yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus. veim haya chevel gardi shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze mevi vekosher bappara uvaevus. mippene shekkol ellu hakkesharim maase hedyot hen veenan shel kayyama ella paam kosher ufaam mattir ulefichach muttar likshor otan lechattechilla. chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogarot mattir umafkia vechotech venotel veochel:
Niddah 24b:15-17: Gemara bishlama dam umayim — lo kelum hi, ella geninim — nechush shemma valad hava venimmoach? amar abbaye: kamma yayin chay shatat immo shel ze shennimmoach ubbarah betoch meeha?
Rava amar: "male" tenan, veim ita deittemoche ittemach — michsar [hava] chasar. rav adda bar ahava amar: "gevavnim" tenan, veim ita deittemoche ittemach — kulle bechad gavvna have kae.

Tanya, abba shaul omer: kover metim hayiti, vehayiti mistakkel baatzamot shel metim. hashshote yayin chay — atzmotav serufin, mazug — atzmotav sechuyin, karauy — atzmotav meshuchin. vechol mi sheshshetiyyayto merubba maachilato — atzmotav serufin, achilato merubba mishshetiyyayto — atzmotav sechuyin, karauy — atzmotav meshuchin.
Pirkei Avot 4:13-17:
Rabbi yehuda omer, heve zahir battalmud, sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon. rabbi shimon omer, shelosha chetarim hem, keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut, vecheter shem tov ole al gabbehen: 
Rabbi nehoray omer, heve gole limkom tora, veal tomar shehi tavo acharecha, shechaverecha yekayyemuha veyadecha. veel binatcha al tishshaen (Mishlei 3): 
Rabbi yannay omer, en beyadenu lo mishshalvat harshaim veaf lo miyyissure hatztzaddikim. rabbi matya ven charash omer, heve makdim bishlom kol adam. veheve zanav laarayot, veal tehi rosh lashshualim: 
Rabbi yaakov omer, haolam hazze dome lifrozdor bifne haolam habba. hateken atzmecha vapperozdor, kede shettikkanes latteraklin: 
Hu haya omer, yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze, mikkol chayye haolam habba. veyafa shaa achat shel korat ruach baolam habba, mikkol chayye haolam hazze:
Pirkei Avot 4:18-21:
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, al teratztze et chavercha vishat kaaso, veal tenachamennu beshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav, veal tishal lo vishat nidro, veal tishtaddel liroto vishat kalkalato: 
Shemuel hakkatan omer, (Mishlei kad) binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha, pen yire Adonai vera beenav veheshiv mealav appo: 
Elisha ben avuya omer, hallomed yeled lema hu dome, lidyo chetuva al neyar chadash. vehallomed zaken lema hu dome, lidyo chetuva al neyar machuk. rabbi yose var yehuda ish kefar habbavli omer, hallomed min hakketannim lema hu dome, leochel anavim kehot veshote yayin miggitto. vehallomed min hazzekenim lema hu dome, leochel anavim beshelot veshote yayin yashan. rabbi omer, al tistakkel bakkankan, ella vema sheyyesh bo. yesh kankan chadash male yashan, veyashan sheafillu chadash en bo: 
Rabbi elazar hakkappar omer, hakkina vehattaava vehakkavod, motziin et haadam min haolam:
Pirkei Avot 4:22-5:3: Hu haya omer, hayyillodim lamut, vehammetim lehechayot, vehachayyim liddon. leda lehodia ulehivvada shehu el, hu hayyotzer, hu habbore, hu hammevin, hu haddayyan, hu ed, hu vaal din, vehu atid ladun. baruch hu, sheen lefanav lo avla, velo shichcha, velo masso fanim, velo mikkach shochad, shehakkol shello. veda shehakkol lefi hacheshbon. veal yavtichacha yitzrecha shehashsheol bet manos lecha, sheal karchacha atta notzar, veal karchacha atta nolad, veal karchacha atta chay, veal karchacha atta met, veal karchacha atta atid litten din vecheshbon lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu:

Baasara maamarot nivra haolam. uma talmud lomar, vahalo vemaamar echad yachol lehibbarot, ella lehippara min harshaim shemmeabbedin et haolam shennivra vaasara maamarot, velitten sachar tov latztzaddikim shemmekayyemin et haolam shennivra vaasara maamarot:

Asara dorot meadam vead noach, lehodia kamma erech appayim lefanav, shekkol haddorot hayu machisin uvain ad shehevi alehem et me hammabbul. asara dorot minnoach vead avraham, lehodia kamma erech appayim lefanav, shekkol haddorot hayu machisin uvain, ad shebba avraham vekibbel alav sechar kullam:
Asara nisyonot nitnassa avraham avinu alav hashshalom veamad bechullam, lehodia kamma chibbato shel avraham avinu alav hashshalom:
Pirkei Avot 5:13-16: Arba middot benotne tzedaka. harotze sheyyitten velo yittenu acherim, eno raa beshel acherim. yittenu acherim vehu lo yitten, eno raa veshello. yitten veyittenu acherim, chasid. lo yitten velo yittenu acherim, rasha:
Arba middot beholche levet hammidrash. holech veeno ose, sechar halicha veyado. ose veeno holech, sechar maase veyado. holech veose, chasid. lo holech velo ose, rasha:

Arba middot beyoshvim lifne chachamim. sefog, umashpech, meshammeret, venafa. sefog, shehu sofeg et hakkol. mashpech, shemmachnis bezo umotzi vezo. meshammeret, shemmotzia et hayyayin vekoletet et hashshemarim. venafa, shemmotzia et hakkemach vekoletet et hassolet:

Kol ahava shehi teluya vedavar, batel davar, betela ahava. vesheenah teluya vedavar, enah betela leolam. ezo hi ahava hatteluya vedavar, zo ahavat amnon vetamar. vesheenah teluya vedavar, zo ahavat david vihonatan:
Pirkei Avot 5:4-8: Asara nissim naasu laavotenu vemitzrayim vaasara al hayyam. eser makkot hevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzriyyim bemitzrayim veeser al hayyam. asara nisyonot nissu avotenu et hammakom baruch hu vammidbar, shenneemar (Bamidbar 14) vaynassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli:

Asara nissim naasu laavotenu bevet hammikdash. lo hippila ishsha mereach besar hakkodesh, velo hisriach besar hakkodesh meolam, velo nira zevuv bevet hammitbachayim, velo era keri lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, velo chibbu geshamim esh shel atze hammaaracha, velo natzcha haruach et ammud heashan, velo nimtza fesul baomer uvishte hallechem uvelechem happanim, omdim tzefufim umishtachavim revachim, velo hizzik nachash veakrav birushalayim meolam, velo amar adam lachavero tzar li hammakom shealin birushalayim:

Asara devarim nivreu beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, veellu hen, pi haaretz, ufi habbeer, ufi haaton, vehakkeshet, vehamman, vehammatte, vehashshamir, vehakketav, vehammichtav, vehalluchot. veyesh omrim, af hammazzikin, ukevurato shel moshe, veelo shel avraham avinu. veyesh omrim, af tzevat bitzvat asuya:

Shiva devarim baggolem veshiva vechacham. chacham eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan, veeno nichnas letoch divre chavero, veeno nivhal lehashiv, shoel kainyan umeshiv kahalacha, veomer al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon, veal ma shello shama, omer lo shamati, umode al haemet. vechillufehen baggolem:

Shiva mine furanuyyot bain laolam al shiva gufe avera. miktzatan measserin umiktzatan enan measserin, raav shel batztzoret baa, miktzatan reevim umiktzatan seveim. gamru shello leasser, raav shel mehuma veshel batztzoret baa. veshello littol et hachalla, raav shel kelaya vaa. dever ba laolam al mitot haamurot battora shello nimseru levet din, veal perot sheviit. cherev baa laolam al innuy haddin, veal iuut haddin, veal hammorim battora shello chahalacha:
Pirkei Avot 5:9-12: Chayya raa vaa laolam al shevuat shav, veal chillul hashshem. galut baa laolam al ovde avoda zara, veal gilluy arayot, veal shefichut damim, veal hashematat haaretz. bearbaa ferakim haddever mitrabbe, barviit, uvashsheviit, uvemotzae sheviit, uvemotzae hechag shebbechol shana veshana. barviit, mippene masar ani shebbashshelishit. bashsheviit, mippene masar ani shebbashshishshit. uvemotzae sheviit, mippene ferot sheviit. uvemotzae hechag shebbechol shana veshana, mippene gezel mattenot aniyyim:

Arba middot baadam. haomer shelli shelli veshellecha shellach, zo midda venonit. veyesh omrim, zo middat sedom. shelli shellecha veshellecha shelli, am haaretz. shelli shellecha veshellecha shellach, chasid. shelli shelli veshellecha shelli, rasha:

Arba middot baddeot. noach lichos venoach lirtzot, yatza secharo vehefsedo. kashe lichos vekashe lirtzot, yatza hefsedo vischaro. kashe lichos venoach lirtzot, chasid. noach lichos vekashe lirtzot, rasha:

Arba middot battalmidim. maher lishmoa umaher leabbed, yatza secharo vehefsedo. kashe lishmoa vekashe leabbed, yatza hefsedo vischaro. maher lishmoa vekashe leabbed, chacham. kashe lishmoa umaher leabbed, ze chelek ra:

Psalms 94:1-6: Hinnase shofet haaretz hashev gemul al-geim
Yabbiu yedabberu atak yitammeru kol-poale aven
Shevuot 18b:4-11: Bea minneh rabbi yonatan ben yose ben lakonya merabbi shimon ben yose ben lakonya: azhara levoel nidda, minnayin min hattora? shekal kala petak beh: azhara levoel nidda?! "veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav"!
Ella azhara limshammesh im hattehora veamra lo "nitmeti", dela nifrosh miyyad – menalan? amar chizkiyya, amar kera: "utehi niddatah alav" – afillu bishat niddatah tehe alav.
Ashkechan ase, lo taase menalan? amar rav pappa, amar kera: "lo tikrav"; "lo tikrav" name la tifrosh hu, dichtiv: "haomrim kerav elecha al tiggash bi ki kedashticha".
Tanu rabbanan: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam" – amar rabbi yoshiyya: mikkan azhara livne yisrael sheyyifreshu minneshotehen samuch levistan. vechamma? amar rabba: ona.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol sheeno poresh meishto samuch levistah, afillu hoyin lo banim kivne aharon – metim; dichtiv: "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam vehaddava beniddatah", usemich leh: "achare mot".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol happoresh meishto samuch levistah – hoyin lo banim zecharim, dichtiv: "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar". rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: hoyin lo banim reuyin lehoraa, dichtiv: "lehavedil... ulehorot".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammavdil al hayyayin bemotzae shabbatot – hoyin lo banim zecharim; dichtiv: "lehavedil ben hakkodesh uven hachol", uchetiv hatam: "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria". rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: banim reuyin lehoraa, dichtiv: "lehavedil... ulehorot".
Amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet, amar rabbi elazar: kol hamekaddesh et atzmo bishat tashmish – hoyin lo banim zecharim; shenneemar: "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim", usemich leh: "ishsha ki tazria".
Sotah 22a:8-22b:6: Ishsha perusha vechulei. tanu rabbanan: betula tzalyaynit, vealmana shovavit, vekatan shello kalu lo chodashav — hare ellu mevalle olam.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: lamadnu yirat chet mibbetula, vekibbul sachar mealmana. yirat chet mibbetula — derabbi yochanan shama lehahi betula denafla aappa vekaamra: ribbono shel olam, barata gan eden uvarata gehinnam, barata tzaddikim uvarata reshaim. yehi ratzon millefanecha shello yikkashlu bi bene adam.

Kibbul sachar mealmana — dehahi almana dahavay be chenishta beshivavuta. kol yoma havat atya umetzalla be midresheh derabbi yochanan. amar la: bitti, lo bet hakkeneset beshivavutich? amara leh: rabbi, velo sechar pesiot yesh li?
Ki kaamar, kegon yochani bat retivi.
May "katan shello kalu lo chodashav"? hacha targimu: ze talmid chacham hamevaet berabbotav.

Rabbi abba amar: ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore. deamar rabbi avahu amar rav huna amar rav: may dichtiv "ki rabbim chalalim hippila vaatzumim kol harugeha". "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" — ze talmid chacham shello higgia lehoraa umore. "vaatzumim kol harugeha" — ze talmid chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more.
Vead kamma — ad arbein shenin. ini? veha rabba ori! beshavin.
Umakkot perushin vechulei. tanu rabbanan, shiva perushin hen: parush shichmi, parush nikpi, parush kizzay, parush meducheya, parush "ma chovati veeesenna", parush meahava, parush miyyira.

Parush shichmi — ze haose maase shechem. parush nikpi — ze hamenakkef et raglav. parush kizzay — amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ze hammakkiz dam lakketalim. parush meducheya — amar rabba bar shela: dimshappa ki meducheya.
Parush "ma chovati veeesenna". ha mealleyuta hi! ella deamar "ma chovati tu veeesenna".

Parush meahava, parush miyyira. amaru leh abbaye verava letanna: la tittene parush meahava parush miyyira, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam battora uvemitzvot afillu shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: demittammera mittammera, udemiggalleya miggalleya, be dina rabba litpera mehane dechafu gunede. amar la yannay malka lidveteh: al tityari min happerushin, velo mimmi sheenan perushin, ella min hatztzevuin sheddomin lifrushin, shemmaasehen kemaase zimri umevakkeshin sachar kefinchas.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 14: Ella inun arba parshiyyayn ha attearu behu, chad nekudda (sefer acher illaa) kadmaa. vechad raza dealma deate. vechad yemina vechad semala. illen raza ditfilin deresha. vehacha beraza da, yichuda da telat shemahan illain, innun kegavvna deinnun arba parshiyyayn. Adonai kadmaa, da nekuda illaa, reshita decholla. elohenu, raza dealma deate. Adonai batraa, kelala dimina usemala kachada, bichlala chada veillen innun tefilla deresha, veda ihu yichuda kadmaa.

Tefillin didroa, kelala (go tefillin didroa kelala) dechol hane kachada, veda ihu raza, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. (ayyen behakedama 13 amud bet) hacha kelala deinnun tefillin deresha, deitkelilu go tefillin didroa.

Veraza da, baruch: da raza dinkuda illaa, deihu baruch, dechol birchan navin mittamman. vei tema, alma deate ikre baruch. lav hachi. deha nekudda illaa ihu dechar, alma deate nukeba, ihu baruch, veihi beracha, baruch dechar, beracha nukeba. veal da baruch ihu nekudda illaa. shem: da alma deate, deihu shem gadol. kema deat amer (yehoshua 7:9) uma taase leshimcha haggadol. kevod: da kevod illaa, deihu yemina usemala, vechullehu kelilan behay tefilla shel yad, deihu malchuto. venatil kolla begavvih, uvehay itteklilan behay malchut, almin kullehu, lemezan lon, ulesappeka lon, bichmma deitztzetrichu.

Veda ihu yichuda ditfillin deresha utefillin didroa, kegavvna deraza deyichuda ditfillin, hachi hu yichuda decholla. veda ihu beriru demilla. veha saddarna yichuda da kamme butztzina kaddisha, veamar li deha bed gavvnin itsaddar yichuda, veda berira dechullehu. vehachi ihu vadday, vechullehu raza deyichuda, aval siddura ditfillin, da hu yichuda illaa kaddeka yaut.

Umiggo deitkelilu yemina usemala beraza dishma chad beorach kelal, itztzetrich levatar leappaka lon. beorach perat, aval lav beorach yichuda, deha yichuda bikrae kadmae ihu, lemehevi Adonai echad, bitfillin deresha. ushemo echad, bitfillin didroa. vahavi kolla chad. kevan deyichuda itsaddar kolla bichlala, meresha dinkuda illaa, itztzetrich levatar leitatra meresha dinhora kadmaa, deihu resha decholla. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Galif veatkin moshe, 25 atvavn beraza difsuka deyichuda, dichtiv shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. veinnun 25 atvavn gelifin, mechukkakin beraza dilella. yaakov baa leatkkena letatta, beraza deyichuda, veatkin bechd atvavn, veinnun baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. vela ashlim lech atvavn, begin dead la ittekkan mashkena. kevan deittekan mashkena, veishtelim milla dehava nafik minneh, kad ishtelim, la mallil ella bech atvavn, leachazaa deha ishtelim da, kegavvna dilella, dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:1) vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor, ha 25 atvavn.

Veal da 25 zinin, leashlema tikkuna demakdesha, vechol hane atvavn okimna beinnun atvavn gelifin deolifna mimmar. uvegin demashkena ishtelim berazin illen, ikre 25, beyichuda dishlimu demashkena. veal da (Tehillim 145:10) vachasidecha yevarchucha ketiv, raza dishlimu dechol mashkena, vetikkuna dileh.

25: Lokovel 22 atvavn, vetora uneviim uchetuvim, deinnun kelala chada, raza chada. beshaata deyisrael ka meyachade yichuda behay kera, beraza dech atvavn, deinnun shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, ubbaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, deinnun 24 atvavn, vichavven kol chad behu, kullehu atvavn mitchabberan kachada, vesallekin lechibbura chad, tesha vearbaim tarin, beraza deyovla. ucheden itzterich lesalleka vaed, la yattir. ucheden itpetachu tarin, vechashiv kudesha berich hu lehahu bar nash, keillu kiyyem orayyta kulah, deihi atya bemt panim becholla.

Veal da itzterich lechavvevna reuta bech uvearba veesrin, lesalleka lon biruta delibba, betesha vearbein tarin dekamran, kevan deitkavvavn behay, yitkavvavn behahu yichuda deamar mar, shema yisrael vegomer baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, kelala dechol orayyta kolla. zakkaa chulakeh man deyitkavvevn behu, vadday kelala ihu dechol orayyta deella vetatta. veda ihu raza deadam, shelimu didchar venukeba, veraza dechol mehemnuta. ad kan.

Ribbi abba shalach leh leribbi shimon veamar leh, hay deukemeh mar battefillin demare alma, 4 parshiyyayn innun kudesha dekudeshin, shappir. mishcha deal tefillin, veinnun retzuin ikru kedushsha, asmachta menalan. shalach leh (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto vegomer, dayyka vehachi ukemeh rav hamenuna sava. veillen innun deresha, uderoa yadcha beHei, veha okmuha.

Amar ribbi shimon, it man dematne behay gavvna, vehaya deroa semala dekudesha berich hu, veikre gevura. i hachi la ishtaaran beresha ella telat. veinnun arba. aval teren retichin kaddishin innun, da itkeshar belibba, veda itkeshar bemocha. velibba umocha, itkeshar da beda. veziuuga chad lehu, veshappir kaamru chavrayyay. vehaya leot al yadcha, kema deittemar, vela ikre ella ot.

Amar ribbi shimon, beshaata debar nash akdim befalgut lelya, vekam veishtaddal beorayyta, ad denahir tzafra. betzafra anach tefillin beresheh, utefillin birshima kaddisha bidroeh, veitattaf beittufa demitzva, veate lenafka mittara deveteh. ira bammezuza, reshima dishma kaddisha betara deveteh. arba malachin kaddishin mizdavvevgin immeh venafkin immeh mittara deveteh, veozfe leh leve kenishta. umachreze kammeh, havu yekara lediyyukena demalka kaddisha, havu yekara livreh demalka, lefartzufa yekara demalka. rucha kaddisha sharya aleh, achriz veamar (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Keden hahu rucha kaddisha salleka leella, veashid aleh kamme malka kaddisha, keden pakid malka illaa, lemichtav kammeh kol innun bene hechaleh, kol innun deishtemodan kammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo. may ulechoshve shemo. kema deat amer (Shemot la) (sefer acher chashav haefod) vechoshve machashavot, innun deavdin lishmeh, umanuta becholla, umanuta ditfillin, bevattehon birtzuehon uchetivathon. umanuta detzitzit, bechutehon, bechuta ditchelta. umanuta dimzuza. veillen innun choshve shemo. uchetiv (sham) vechoshve machashavot.

Velo od ella dekudesha berich hu mishtabbach beh, umachriz aleh bechullehu almin, chamu ma birya avdet beolami. uman deyeul kammeh leve kenishta, kad nafik mittareh, vela tefillin beresheh vetzitzit bilvusheh, veomer (Tehillim Adonai:8) eshtachave el hechal kadshecha beyiratecha. kudesha berich hu amar, an hu morai, ha sahid sahaduta deshikra.

Amar ribbi yosi, zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dehacha amar elohenu. (nusach acher elohecha) deamar ribbi shimon, moshe bedarga illaa yattir itachad, al shear nevie mehemne. veamar ribbi shimon, ilmale havo yade bene nasha millin deorayyta, lindeun deha let shum milla beorayyta, o at beorayyta, dela it bah razin illain veyakkirin.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 16: Ribbi chiyyay amar, hay man devae deyistamar orchoy, la yebar al mayyay deoshdin kamme pitcha. begin detamman shari chad shida, vehu ben teren dashin defitcha, veanpoy lokovleh defitcha, veistache kol ma deavdin beveta, vela live leh leenosh (leinish) deyishde mayyay ben tere tare. ribbi yitzchak amar, mayin tzelilan let lan bah. vehu dela yoshit lon orach kelana. may taama. begin deit leh reshu lenazka. vela od ella deyehdar resheh lokovle beta, uvechol ma deistechal itlatteyay.

Telat mea veshittin vechamesh, kechusheban yeme shatta, it leh shammashin, dehu shallit alayyhu, vechullehu nafkin im bar nash, kad nafik mittara deveteh. amar ribbi elazar, kol da bae kudesha berich hu lenatra lon leyisrael, veatkin shemeh kaddisha leella, deihu orayyta, veorayyta kolla chad shema kaddisha ihu, uman deishtedal beorayyta, ishtedal bishmeh.

Ta chaze, bae bar nash befitcha deveta lerashma shema kaddisha, deihu mehemnuta decholla. deha bechol atar dishma kaddisha ishtechach, zinin bishin la mishtakkeche tamman, vela yachlin lekatrega leh lebar nash, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:10) lo teune elecha raa vegomer.

(Mezuza ikre). atar defitcha deveta sharya, kegavvna dilella, atar defitcha deveta illaa sharya, mezuza ikre. dehu tikkuna deveta, ufitcha deveta. mehahi mezuza arkin mare nimmusin, mare dedinin kammeh la mishtakkechin. vekovel da letatta, kad bar nash atkin mezuza lefitcha deveta, vehay shema kaddisha rashim beatooy, hay bar nash itattar beitroy demareh, vela keravin lefitcha deveteh zinin bishin, vela mishtakkeche tamman.

Ribbi abba hava ate millemechome lerabbi shimon, paga beh ribbi yitzchak, amar leh mean ate, mareh dinhora, gevar deitdabbak benura deachla kol yoma, ha nehora immeh share. amar leh, tanenan dechiyyuva aleh debar nash, lekabbela appe shechinta, bechol resh yarche veshabbatte. uman ihu. rabbeh. kol shekken butzina illaa kaddisha, dechol bene alma baan lekabbela anpoy. amar ribbi yitzchak, ahadarna immach, veakbel anpe shechinta, veatam meinnun millin illain, deatamat kammeh.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 2: Ta chaze, kad ittear ruach tzafon befalgut lelya, vecharoza nafik. vekudesha berich hu ate leginta deeden leishtashea beruchehon detzaddikayyay, keden mitkavvne (nusach acher mitare) kol bene matronita, vechol bene hechala, leshabbecha leh lemalka kaddisha. ucheden kol innun pikdonin deruchin deitmasseran bidah, kullehu ativ lemarehon. verubba divne alma mitarin behahi shaata, veha pikdoneh dechullehu ativ legabbayyhu.

Innun divne hechala illaa kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, mitare mishtaddele betushebachta deorayyta, umishtattefe bichneset yisrael, ad denahir yemama. kad ate tzafra, hi, vechol bene hechala (demalka) kullehu atyayn legabbe malka kaddisha, veinnun ikrun benin demalka umatronita. veha ukemuha.
Kad ate tzafra, bae lenakkaa garmeh becholla, ulemezan zayyneh, leishtaddela im malka kaddisha, deha belelya ishtedal bematronita. hasheta atya im matronita, lezavvevga lah im malka.

Ate leve kenishta, madke garmeh bekarbenin, meshabbach betushebachtayyhu dedavid malka. achid tefilin beresheh, (sefer acher bideh uveresheh) vetzitzit begadfeh, omer tehilla ledavid. veha ukemuha, tzalle tzelota kamme mareh, bitzlota bae lemekam, kegavvna (sefer acher beziuuga) demalache illae, leitchabbera bahadayyhu, deinnun ikrun haomdim, kema deat amer, (zecharya 3:7) venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim. ulechavvevna reuteh kamme mareh, veyitba bauteh.

Ta chaze, beshaata debar nash kaim befalgut lelya mearseh, leishtaddela beorayyta, karoza kare aleh veamar, (Tehillim 134:1) hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot. hasheta kad ihu kaim bitzlota kamme mareh, hahu karoza kare aleh veamar, venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haelle.

Batar dimsayyem tzelota biru (vekaim beeta) kamme mareh, ha ukemuha, devae lemimsar nafsheh biruta delibba, lehahu atar deitzterich. vechamma etin it leh levar nash becholla. uveshaata ditzlota kayyeyma (sefer acher sayymea), kol innun millin deappik bar nash mippumeh behahi tzelota, kullehu sallekin leella, uvakin avirin urekiin, ad dematu lehahu atar dematu umitatteru beresha demalka, veavid minnayyhu atara. veha okmuha chavrayyay, tzelota devae bar nash lekudesha berich hu, lechavvevna dihe tzelota tachanunim. menalan. mimmoshe, dichtiv vaetchannan el Adonai. da ihu tzelota mealya.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 3: Ta chaze, man dekaim bitzlota, bae lechavvevna ragloy, veokmuha. uvae lechappeya resheh, keman dekaim kamme malka. uvae lemichseyay (lamekaseyya) (sefer acher leastema) enoy, begin dela yistakkal bishchinta. uvesifra derav hamenuna sava amar, man defakach enoy beshaata ditzlota, o dela maich enoy beara, akdim aleh malach hammavet, vechad tippuk nafsheh, la yistakkal binhiru dishchinta, vela yamut binshika. man dimzalzel bishchinta mittezalzzel hu behahu shaata deitzterich beh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:30) ki mechabbeday achabbed uvozay yekallu.

Hay man deistakkal bishchinta, beshaata deihu metzalle. vehech yachil leistakkela bishchinta. ella linda devadday shechinta kayyeyma kammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir, detamman share shechinta. begin kach la baya lemeheve chotzetz beno uven hakkir, veokmuha.

Man dekaim bitzlota, bae lesaddera shevacha demareh bekadmita, ulevatar yitba bauteh. deha moshe hachi amar bekadmita, atta hachillota vegomer. ulevassof ebera vegomer. ribbi yehuda amar, may shena hacha dichtiv adonay bekadmita, beAlef dalet nun yod, ulevassof Adonai, vekarenan elohim. ella siddura hachi hu mittatta leella, uleachlela middat yom ballayla, umiddat layla bayom ulezavvevga kolla kachada kaddeka yaut.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 8: Tana beraza illaa besifra ditzniuta, 3 chalalin deatvavn reshimin, itgalleyayn bah begulegalta dizer anpin. vetanenan, 3 moche innun, distimu beinnun chalalin. umishsheruta (vamemasheykevatea) democha illaa setimaa deattika kaddisha deitmeshich behahu zeer anpin, ishtechachu 4 moche. veillen 4 mochin, (sefer acher dina let kateraay mikkol kitre malka) mishtakkechin umitpashshetin (sefer acher becholla veinnun) bechol gufa veinnun 4 rihate, dearba batte ditfilin, deanach kudesha berich hu.

Ubbegin kach bae bar nash laanacha bechol yoma, begin deinnun shema kaddisha illaa beatvoy reshiman, dichtiv, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha. utenan, shem Adonai mammash, veillen tefillin deresha. (mocha illaa deitmeshach bemocha tattaa ikrun tere mochin veinnun dichtiv chachmot, umitparshan bechad)

Ribbi yitzchak amar, hu dichtiv, (Shemot 13:2) kaddesh li chol bechor, da hi kitra dechalil veastim kol innun acharanin. (kol bechor kol bechor setam, leillaa) meshichuta (sefer acher mashiryayta) dilella setima beh. (decholla) veda ikre peter kol rechem, petichuta dechol meshichuta derachame, visoda (nusach acher unehiru) dilella.
Amar ribbi shimon, vesatim beYod dishma kaddisha. veda (sefer acher yod) chad beta ditfillin, dehu kaddesh li chol bechor setam. mocha (nusach acher abba) illaa, chachma.

Beta tinyayna, vehaya ki yeviacha Adonai (elohecha). amar ribbi yehuda mocha detaroy nafkin lechamshin tarin. tarin saggiin, veinnun lokovel zimnin saggiin dichtiv, (Shemot 20:2) asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim. (Shemot 13:18) hotziacha Adonai mimmitzrayim. veidkar zimnin saggiin ducherana demitzrayim. veinnun chamshin lokovel chamshin.

Vetanenan besifra derav hamenuna sava, deamar tarin saggiin dilella vetatta, tavar kudesha berich hu, dahavo setimin umitkatterin beshalshelehon, begin leappaka lehu leyisrael (levar). deha meillen tarin dehahu mocha, mitpatteche umishteru kol shear tarin. veilmale deitaru veitpetachu innun tarin dehay mocha, la havo mitpattechin innun acharanin lemebad dina, uleappaka lon leyisrael min avduta.

Vecholla satim behay deikre ima illaa, deminah ittear chela leima tattaa. umay ihu. dichtiv bah (Yeshayahu 51:4) uleummi elay haazinu. al tikre leummi, ella leimmi. dela zaz kudesha berich hu mechabbevah lichneset yisrael, ad dikraah immi. vehay nafka meima illaa, dehi beta tinyayna, deikre Adonai dishma kaddisha, deitpattecha lechamshin tarin. umehay nafak rucha lechad nukeba defardashka dechotama.

Vetanenan, yovla denafkin beh avdin lecheru, behay mocha itachad. veinnun chamshin shenin deyovla. veinnun chamshin yomin dechushebana deomer, beh itachadu. divhu nayychin ruche deavdin, umappeke ruchehon (nusach acher umappik rucheh) lenayycha. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom haniach Adonai lecha meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda vegomer. uvegin kach, Adonai nayycha derucha, uleappaka rucha lecheru. vehay beta yetziat mitzrayim bah talyay, uveat Adonai dishma kaddisha, kema deittemar. ad kan kelala dey dishma kaddisha.
Ta chaze, missitra deabba nafik chesed. missitra deimma nafik gevura. vecholla achid kudesha berich hu, umitattar behu, at vav.

Beta telitaa shema yisrael, yisrael sava. veahavta et Adonai elohecha. tana ribbi shimon, da hu raza illaa, deyisrael illaa itattar besitra deabba. umay ihu. avraham. veitattar besitra deimma. umay ihu. yitzchak.

Tanenan, veahavta man derachim leh lemalka, avid yattir tivu chesed im kolla. vechesed yattira, hahu deikre chesed deemet, dela bae agar aleh, ella begin rechimuta demalka, derachim leh yattir, uvirchimuta demalka talya chesed. veal da ikre (Yeshayahu 41:8) avraham ohavi. uvegin derachim leh yattir, asge chesed bealma. veal da, hacha veahavta. uvirchimuta talya chesed, veda hi beta telitaa.

Beta reviaa, vehaya im shamoa. hishshamru lachem. vechara af Adonai. gevura takkifa, vedina kashya hi, venafkat missitra deimma illaa. vetanenan, af al gav delet hi dina, missitraha nafka dina, (denafak) gevura illaa. vei tema, vehaya im shamoa delav hi dina. let kitra mikkol kitre malka, dela yitkelil dina verachame, kol shekken gevura deitkelil tav uvish.

Veillen arbaa natil lon vav, veitattar behu. veillen innun tefilin deanach kudesha berich hu. tanenan, hay vav salik veitattar beitroy, veachid lehay ulehay, veitattar bechullehu, veal da vav, emtzaita decholla, deella vetatta, leachazaa chachmeta shelemata mikkol sitroy.

(Tane rabbi abba, ketiv (Devarim 10:15)) rak baavotecha chashak Adonai. mikkan amar ribbi shimon, avahata innun reticha kaddisha illaa, uchetiv chashak Adonai. ta chaze, kema deit reticha kaddisha letatta, kach it reticha kaddisha leella. umay nihu, ha deamaran, reticha kaddisha kolla ikre, vecholla itkeshar da beda, veitavid kolla chad.

Rak baavotecha telata, ureticha arbea, 4 menalan. dichtiv (Devarim 10:15) vayyivchar bezaram acharehem. may mashma. leachlela behu david malka, deihu reviaa, leittakna birticha kaddisha. detanenan, avahata tikkuna ushelemuta decholla, vegufa behu ishtachlal veitbene, uvehu itachid. ata david malka, veshachlil kolla, veatkin gufa, veashlemeh behu. veamar ribbi yitzchak, kema dezachu avahata leitattera birticha kaddisha, kach zacha david leittakna besamcha reviaa dirticha.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv beh bedavid, (Shmuel 1 16:12) vehu admoni im yefe enayim vetov roi. may taama admoni. mishshum dechulaka deadveh garma leh. admoni dina vadday. im yefe enayim, dina berachame. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, chasde david, beatreh okimna. ella vehu admoni, kidamaran. im yefe enayim, illen avahata. ta chaze, yerushalayim vetziyyon, dina verachame. veaf al pi ken ketiv, (Melachim 1 8:1) ir david hi tziyyon. uchetiv (Hoshea 11:9) bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir, nishba kudesha berich hu shello yikkannes biyrushala 40 shel maala vechulei. ematay. amar ribbi yehuda, kad ithaddar malchu bet david leatreh letatta.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, 300 dirshima bitlat kishre, (8 kishrin remiza hi litlata uremiza learbaa, telat ha deamaran. arbaa lemeheve reticha kaddisha kachada. deha hu kelala detikkuna illaa umehacha mitparshan veitmashshechan tattae baavarechayyhev birtzuehon detalyayn behane shaare deresha detalyayn behu veitmashshechan minnayyhu kol inun acharanin ad daatakesharen beatrayyhu).

Tanenan, 6 natil innun illae deamaran, veillen tefillin deanach kudesha berich hu. begin kach bae bar nash leitpaara behu, aleh ketiv (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha, shem Adonai mammash. veillen innun tefillin deresha, tefillin didroa hi semala, deikre oz, veyarta meoz, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 13:16) vehaya leot al yadcha beHei, vehi hei deokimna. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael. veal da, hei batraa natla tefilin, dehi semala.

Leman (nusach acher uman) innun illen arbea, deinnun chad gufa, veal da kelilan bechad, uman innun. tiferet netzach hod yesod. vehi hei deyadcha, vechullehu achida bah, begin leitbarcha minnayyhu, uchelila mikkullehu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, i hachi ha ketiv (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray, vetanenan da kesher shel tefillin. amar leh, ha okmuha, veshappir hu, vecholla berira demilla. veal da mehay talyay retzua chad letatta, deha minah talyayn tattae, veittezanu minah. veal da itkere ot. kema deat amer (Bereshit 9:12) zot ot habberit. uchetiv (Shemot 13:16) vehaya leot al yadcha baAdonai veha okmuha.

(Devarim 6) shema yisrael. amar ribbi yesa, yisrael sava. ribbi yitzchak amar 70 ravreva, leachlela shivin shemahan, sahaduta decholla shema yisrael, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:2) shimu shamayim. uchetiv (Devarim 32:1) haazinu hashshamayim. uf hacha shema yisrael. vecholla chad milla hu. Adonai, resha decholla, binhiru deattika kaddisha. vehay hu deikre av. elohenu, amikta denachalin umabbuin, denafkin venagdin lecholla.
Adonai, gufa deilana shelimu desharashin. echad, keneset yisrael. vecholla chad shelemuta, veitkeshar da beda, vela ishtechach piruda, ella kolla chad.
Tane ribbi yitzchak, reticha kaddisha illaa, arba batte ditfilin deanach 6. kema deittemar. reticha kaddisha ochora, arba acharanin dichlilan bechad, deanach Adonai batraa kema deokmuha.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.

Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.

rashi: Zechor zot oyev vegomer. veachare shekkol teshuatenu becha, zechor zot, asher haoyev cheref otcha behashemido otanu:
targum: Idkar da beel devava megadef Adonai veama tippesha derachiku shemach:

rashi: Umeshallem lesonav el panav. bechayyav meshallem lo gemulo hattov, kede lehaavido min haolam habba:
ohc: Umeshallem lesonav vegomer. kashe lamma amar sonav leshon rabbim vegamar omer panav lehaavido leshon yachid? veulay ki taam amro leshon rabbim ki lo yeshallem larasha el panav ella kesheyyire ki lo hu bilvad sone ella gam habbaim mimmennu kayyotze bo, shebbaze en lo tikva, vehu amro umeshallem lesonav leshon rabbim. aval im lo yihye sone ella hu, vezaro habba mimmennu lo yihye sone, bera mezakke abba velo yeshallem lo lehaavido.

Vegamar omer bilshon yachid, ki beyachid medabber hakkatuv, ella sheheircha baddavar haamur bema sheamar sonav leshon rabbim, vechazar lomar lo yeacher vegomer, perush: veim en harasha ba berabbim ella hu levad sone velo habbaim acharav, yitchakkem Adonai immo beofen acher velo yeacher lo baolam hazze leshallem lo ansho kede shello yarshia od vetovad tikvato, ella yemaher leshallem lo mita shehu chayyav bah o yissurin kevan sheyyesh lo tikva sheyyizke beemtzaut beno.

Veamro el panav – al derech amram zichronam livracha (yerushalmi avoda zara 3:1:5) shehatztzaddikim matimam Adonai samuch lemitatam meen olamam, venafsham sevea vishenim mittoch simcha, veharshaim mare lahem haraa hamezummenet lahem kodem tzetam mehaolam (Ester Rabba parashat utemaen hammalka ushete), vehu amro lo yeacher lesono el panav – perush baolam hazze kodem sheyyittamnu panav beafar yarehu tashlumav velo yeacher ad boo shamma.
Chassalat parashat vaetchannan

rashi: Ashsha. leshon ashashit, ayin shemmeorah keha, vedome lo keillu hu roe derech zechuchit shekkeneged enav. umenachem persho leshon rikkavon, kemo (tehillim 31:11) "vaatzamay asheshu", vechen kol leshon ash:
Atka. nityashshena venizdakkena eni bichhiyyat or, umenachem chibbero im "vayyatek mishsham hahara" (Bereshit 12:8):
Bechol tzorray. bishvil tzarot shemmetzirin li:
targum: Chashchat min rugezi ayynay itbeliat bechol meikay:

ohc: Veattem haddevekim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar veattem betosefet vav kemosif al inyan rishon, velo yidmu hannidbakim baAdonai laholchim achare vaal peor. od amro haddevekim beHei hayedia, velo matzinu shekkadam zichron devekut ze sheyyutzdak lomar alav haddevekim.

Veulay sheyyitbaer al derech ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha besanhedrin (sanhedrin kach.) befasuk "venoach matza chen beene Adonai" (Bereshit 6:8) veze leshonam: "venoach" afillu noach shennishtayyer mehem lo haya keday, ella shemmatza chen, ad kan. kemo chen nitkavven bemaamar veattem, perush, vegam attem heyitem reuyim lehashemid, ella letzad heyotchem devukim, perush, nitkaravtem bitshuva venidbaktem baAdonai, baze attem chayyim.

Vedikdek lomar kullechem lehair shello al chelek mehem hu omer ella al kullam, vechen hu omer hakkatuv befarashat pinchas bemaase peor (Bamidbar 25:11) "velo chilliti et bene yisrael bekinati", ha lamadta sheomdim hayu lehishshamed kullam. vahagam sheppinchas hu shemmana mehem hakkillayon, im kol ze muchrach sheasu teshuva achar kach, sheim lo chen lo haya moil pinchas ella lechapper lema shekkevar asuhu velo lema sheatid.

Od yirtze betosefet vav lefi ma shepperashti beamro "asher halach achare vaal" vegomer, shennitkavven lomar hagam shello avad ella chashav bedato laavod, nitkavven beVav shel veattem lomar tosefet baddimyon harishon, kederech sheanash Adonai al hammachshava bema shellefanav hagam shello asu maase, kemo chen gam ken attem beinyan devekutechem baAdonai hammachshava baze hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase. vechen amru zichronam livracha (kiddushin 40.): machshava tova hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase, machshava raa en hakkadosh baruch hu metzarfah lemaase zulat baavoda zara.

Vedikdek lomar veattem haddevekim, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) befasuk (Shemot 33:16) "veniflinu ani veammecha", shebbikkesh moshe mehashshem shello yashre shechinato al ummot haolam, uferashnuhu sham shehakkavvana hu afillu yachshiru maasehem. vehu sheamar kan "attem", perush, attem hem haddevekim baAdonai velo ovde kochavim umazzalot, sheim haovde kochavim umazzalot yirtzu lehiddavek baAdonai lo yizku laze. ulederech ze maamar "haddevekim" hu gezerat haddibbur gam ken lemaamar "attem".

Haddevekim baAdonai elohechem. yitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 6 mehilchot yesode hattora veze leshono: veshiva shemot hem: havaya vechulei, kol hammochek afillu ot achat mishshiva shemot ellu loke. kol hannitpal laAdonai millefanav muttar lemachko vechulei, milleacharav kegon 20 shel elohecha, chem shel elohechem enam nimchakim, vahare hem kishar otiyyot shel shem shehashshem mekaddesham, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven lomar lahem bemaamar haddevekim baAdonai, perush, ulefi sheshshem ze hammeyuchad shem havaya en ot nidbeket venismechet lo milleacharav ella millefanav, kegon laAdonai, baAdonai, chaAdonai, veotiyyot ellu en bahem kedushsha umuttar lemachkam, veim ken tihye devekut yisrael baAdonai bederech ze sheen hashshem mekaddesham, laze gamar omer elohechem, perush, devekut ze sheattem devekim baAdonai enah kidvekut haotiyyot shemmillefanav, ella kaotiyyot shemmilleacharav, shehem chem shel elohechem, shehem kedoshim kishar haotiyyot shel hashshem.

Gam ramaz betevat baAdonai yiud naim, vehu shem ze eno mekaddesh milleacharav. ha lamadta sheddevekut yisrael hu bashshemot atzmam, mitachadim or nafsham beor shem hannichbad. uchede shello tavin shehakkavvana hu kaotiyyot hannitpalim millefanav veen bahem kedushsha, gamar omer elohechem. emor meatta ki kavvanat amro baAdonai hi beyichud haotiyyot, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 32:9) "ki chelek Adonai ammo", hare ki chelek echad hem yisrael mishshem havaya baruch hu, uvaze tatzdik perushenu ze. veulay ki yedabber hakkatuv keneged shete haderagot sheyyeshnam beyisrael zo lemala mizzo, vehaven:

Od nitkavven bemaamar haddevekim baAdonai elohechem al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 238.) ki haose mitzva shore shem havaya al haevar shebbo ose hammitzva, veamru ki mitzvot ase hem remuzim beshem havaya umitzvot lo taase remuzim beshem elohim, vehu amro kan veattem haddevekim al yede kiyyum mitzvot ase velo taase bishne shemot ellu, shem havaya veelohim, keamro "baAdonai elohechem".

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: kesheattem devekim baAdonai, perush shellibbechem chafetz bo uvemitzvotav, baze hu nikra elohechem beyichud, al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni sof parashat noach) befasuk "yoshev tehillot yisrael" (tehillim 22:4), shello nitratztza Adonai bechol mahalal tzeva hashshamayim ad sheamru bithillotav "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael", ki lo bachar shettityached elohuto ella al yisrael, velaze timtza sheen mitbarech velo mithallel belohe shamayim velo belohe haaretz velo belohe malachim ella elohe yisrael.

Chayyim kullechem hayyom. nimshechet lemala ulematta, nimshechet lemala al ze hadderech: elohechem chayyim, ki Adonai nikra (Devarim 5:23) elohim chayyim, venimshechet lematta gam ken: chayyim kullechem, vehakkavvana beshiur haddibbur al ze hadderech lehair shehachayyim nimshachim lahem mimmekor hachayyim, vehakkavvana baze shezzulat ze lo yikkare chayyim hagam sheyyitnoea veyochal vechulei, sheharshaim bechayyehem keruyim metim (berachot 18:) letzad shemmekoram mekor hammita. veze hu hachiddush shemmechaddesh lahem moshe bemaamar ze, shemmodiam shehem chayyim mimmekor hachayyim:

Veshiur kavvanat divre moshe hu bishte derachim: 1 hu al ze hadderech – mitztzad sheattem devekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim attem, chayyim kemo shekkatavnu besamuch. 2 al ze hadderech – taam shezzechitem lehiddavek baAdonai elohechem lefi sheattem chayyim, perush tzaddikim, shennishmartem mimmatamme haresha shehem bechinat hammavet, uvacharta bachayyim, velishnehem nitkavven hakkatuv.

Veamro kullechem – nitkavven lakkelalut happerati uchelalut hakkelali al ze hadderech: kelalut happerati – shekkol echad mehem haya kullo chay belo ever garua, al derech ma sheddarshu bechullin (zevachim 116.) befasuk "mikkol hachay" – have behema shechayyim rashe evareha veen bah mum. kemo chen ma shellefanenu hayu kullam temimim belo mum, vechen amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) shekkol sheamdu al har sinay lo hayu bahem sumin, dichtiv "vechol haam roim" vegomer velo vechulei, ad kan. ha lamadta shello hayu bahem mumin veamdu bechezkatam. venitkavven ben al mume hagguf ben al mume hannefesh. uchevar hairoti shemmum shebbagguf yaggid al pegam hannefesh, ki en mum sheen dimyono bannefesh, vaasher al ken pesalo Adonai levaal mum meal hammizbeach. veayyen bedivre hazzohar (chelek 3 4.). kelalut hakkelali – shello haya bahem echad sheeno hagun shello yikkare chay, ella kullam tzaddikim. veamro hayyom – lo hechlit maamar heyotam chayyim kullam ella hayyom, ki mi yomar asher yihye lemachar mitztzad maasehem, sheadam bechiri hu veen emuna bo ad yom lechto leeretz hachayyim.

rashi: O hanissa elohim. hachi asa nissim shum eloah lavo lakachat lo goy vegomer, kol hehin hallalu temihot hen, lechach nekudot hen bachataf pattach: hanihya, hanishma, hashama hanissa:
Bemassot. al yede nisyonot hodiam gevurotav, kegon "hitpaer alay" (Shemot 8) im uchal laasot ken, hare ze nissayon:
Beotot. besimanin, lehaamin shehu shelucho shel makom, kegon "ma ze veyadecha" (sham 4):
Uvemoftim. hem niflaot, shehevi alehem makkot muflaot:
Uvemilchama. bayyam, shenneemar "ki Adonai nilcham lahem" (sham 14):
Hen goyim kemar middeli. haovde kochavim umazzalot hamemaanim lehakkir et boram, veen chashuvin lo lehaamid mehem linviim legallot sodo:
Kemar middeli. ketippa mara hametaftefet mishshule haddeli, umishka tinnofet hammayim verokvin haetz, 151 109:
Ucheshachak moznayim. shehannechoshet maala ippush umishtachek:
Kaddak. avak dak:
Yittol. keavak hannissa veole al yede ruach, kaddak asher yinnatel:
targum: Ha ammaya ketippa midul ucheiul moznaya chashivin ha nagvata kedoka defarach:

rashi: Yitammeru. yishtabbechu, kemo "heemarta" veheemircha" (Devarim 26:17-18):
targum: Yevuun vimallun gidufin amrin milin diklana kol avde shekar:

rashi: Af bal nittau. af hare hem kemi shello nitu:
Af bal zorau. veod yater mikkan, sheyyeshorshu veyeakru keillu lo zoru. zeria pechuta minnetia:

Bal shoresh baaretz gizam. lichsheyyeakru, lo yashrish haggeza baaretz, sheyyehe machalif. kol 'shoresh shebbammikra tamo beot rishona unekuda haresh pattach, veze tamo lematta venakud kamatz, lefi shehu leshon poel, 421 109:
