targum: Afilu yifshun afilu yisgun afilu yitrabbun beara venehon veaf rugeze yeshalach behon veyivhatun umemre kealela lekasha yedabber yathon:

rashi: Vehayu haddevarim haelle. umahu haahava? vehayu haddevarim haelle, shemmittoch kach atta makkir behakkabba umedabbek bidrachav (sifre):
Asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom. lo yihyu beenecha chidyutegma yeshana sheen adam sofnah, ella kachadasha shehakkol ratzin likratah; deyutegma – mitzvat hammelech habbaa bemichtav (sifre):
ohc: Vehayu haddevarim vegomer. lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "veahavta et Adonai", yirtze lomar ki yasim haddevarim haamurim retiyya al libbo birot achat mishshelosha elle (moed katan koach.): ki yire chesron hallechem leish tzaddik, o chesron hachayyim, o chesron habbanim, yeda ki en haddavar letzad chesron hahesseg ma shehissig zulato, ella sheddevarim ellu chashuvim keayin negdo.

Od yirtze lelammed bene yisrael derech sheyyitkabbelu haddevarim etzlam leehov Adonai, ki haahava enah maase sheyyachriach haadam retzono laasot mitzvot hammelech, ella hu davar shettaluy ballev, vechol shehallev lo yargish davar sheyyifal bo hacheshek eno ohev, hagam sheyyachrichennu bechol min hechreach. laze baa haetza meel yoetz veamar vehayu haddevarim haelle vegomer al levavecha, perush kesheyyatmid simat haddevarim al libbo yivvaled belibbo cheshek taava haruchanit veyarutz libbo leahavat Adonai bechol asher tzivvahu. vedavar ze anachnu yatme deyatme anu margishim ki rabba taava belibbenu vecheshek elohe olam yoter mikkol hon olam uchevod malchut, vechol arev nirgash linmivza venames beerech chelek hammuat hammussag mehergesh havayat haddevarim al libbenu, ashrenu ma tov chelkenu. uchevar hairoti bidvarim ellu bechamma mekomot.

Od nitkavven hakkatuv lishlosha haderagot shehem kolel gidre haahava: haechad keneged hahergesh hu chemdat hallev, veechad keneged hatztzorech shehu mazon hammechayye et haadam, veechad begeder hashshiur ad kamma tzarich latzet yede chovat haahava. keneged geder hahergesh amar bechol levavcha, hinne hagam sheyyitavve haadam leechol o lehon lo yihye kol kach otzem haarevut, hagam shehannefesh chafetza leechol yachol adam limshol berucho limnoa atzmo mehaddavar benakel, ma sheen ken keshennichnas belibbo chemdat hallev veyitavve leishsha yafa, uma gam ki yitrabbe cheshkah bilvavo yafil bo hahergesh ad sheeno yachol limshol berucho lehattot libbo veyachof oto laasot ma sheen retzono asot. tze ulemad kamma nitatztzem yosef hatztzaddik lachof chemdat hallev bemaase eshet potifar usecharo yaggid lo.

Ucheneged gader ze amar hakkadosh baruch hu veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha, sheyyishtaddel lehachenis ahavat Adonai bilvavo, veyalhivennu beahavato ad gader sheyyassig hergesh belibbo kechol shiur sheyyachol hallev leharegish bo. velaze dikdek lomar bechol, lefi shehallev yachmod bechol ishsha, uveyoter benaa, uveyoter bichlilat yofi, uveyoter bemi sheen lemala mimmenna. vechiyyev hakkatuv shettihye haregashat hallev beahavato yitbarach baggader haggadol sheen lemala mimmennu. vedavar ze hu davar shehattoamo yeda mahuto vearva lo teimato en shiur lah. ulefi sheggader ze metziuto hu al yede hitorrut, kederech amram (Bamidbar Rabba 10:2) ayin roa velev chomed, aval zulat ze lo yitorer hallev meatzmo lachmod, laze heir Adonai bemaamar sheni begader hatztzorech veamar uvechol nafshecha, shehem devarim shehannefesh tzericha lahem kegon achila ushetiyya vechaddome shehaadam mitorer meatzmo lahem belo emtzaut davar. kemo chen tihye ahavat Adonai, vehu amro bechol nafshecha shemmittivo tihye ahavat Adonai kemaachol umashke. vehinne shene hadderagot ellu yeshnam begader hammitztaer vehammitgadder, shehammaachol achare achlo veachare shato yechdal mimmennu hachefetz bo, uchemo chen taavat libbo achar gemar maase derech gever bealma (Mishlei 30:19) yishtanne haddavar etzlo ad achar zeman. laze ba devar Adonai behaderaga shelishit begader hashshiur veamar uvechol meodecha, perush, bechol mamon sheatta chafetz bo. ucheshem shehammamon amar hakkatuv (Kohelet 5:9) "ohev kesef lo yisba kesef", ki kesheadam maggia liknot kinyan atzum az yitatztzem cheftzo lachpotz behone honot veholechet taavato ugedela. uchemo chen yetzav Adonai beahavato shello tishtaer vetugbal uchesheyyaggia gader echad tigdal bo haahava legader elyon mizze. ulederech ze shiur amro meodecha lo ma shekkana ella shechafetz liknot. uvaze yityashshev gam ken ma shehaya kashe bo im atta omer ma shekkanita im ken en mitzva zo shava bakkol, shehare adam ani eno ben mitzva zo, gam beanshe mamon lo tihye lahem hammitzva behashevaa, ma sheen ken bemitzvat levavcha venafshecha shehakkol shavim bo, ulefi darkenu yavo al nachon.

rashi: Kaasher dibber. vehechan dibber? "vehammoti et kol haam vegomer" (Shemot 23):
Ki meahavat Adonai. hare ki meshammesh bilshon ella – lo merubbechem cheshek Adonai bachem, ella meahavat Adonai etchem:
Umishshomro et hashshevua. mechamat shamro et hashshevua:
Hayyashar vehattov. zo feshara lifnim mishshurat haddin:
Hofia. hera vegalle lanu et nikmatcha:
targum: Elaha mare fureanuta Adonai elaha mare pureanuta hofa:

rashi: Veoti tzivva Adonai lelammed etchem. tora shebbeal pe:

ohc: Uvikkashtem vegomer bechol levavcha vegomer batztzar lecha vegomer. shene ketuvim habbaim ellu tzerichin beur. da ki yesh shete haderagot teshuva: yesh teshuva sheyyisrael osim meatzman sheyyakkiru chiyyuvam im habbore veyachofu yitzram, veyesh teshuva sheosim al yede yissurin asher yetzar lahem haoyev veyitzaku mikkeev lev. ucheneged shete haderagot dibber moshe el kol yisrael, keneged haose teshuva hagam shello shama kol noges amar uvikkashtem mishsham et Adonai elohecha, sheyyitorru hallevavot lechibbat elohehem, umatzata. vahagam sheyyesh beyadcha averot chamurot keamur besamuch "vaavadtem sham elohim acherim" vegomer, af al pi chen peturim attem mehayyissurin veday lachem hatteshuva. vehattaam – ki tidreshennu bechol levavcha, shetteshuva kazo hi teshuva shelema bechol lev uvechol nefesh.

Ucheneged teshuva habbaa mitztzad hayyissurin amar batztzar lecha umetzaucha vegomer veshavta vegomer, perush, mechamat hayyissurin asher yatzer lecha oyvecha. vechan lo hizkir "bechol levavcha" vegomer, ki beemtzaut hayyissurin hu shav. uma shechaser lashshavim mechamat yissurin bivchinat haderagat hatteshuva, mashlimin oto bivchinat hayyissurin atzman sheavru alehem, ki hayyissurin memarkin haavonot umetaharin et hannefesh. uma shechaser lakkat harishona mitztzad shello avru alehem yissurin, mashlimin oto bivchinat maalat hatteshuva. uchefi ze maamar "batztzar lecha" nimshach im ma shellefanav, veze shiuro: uvikkashtem vegomer umatzata, vehattaam ki tidreshennu vegomer, o batztzar lecha vegomer veshavta hagam shello tihye bechol levavcha vegomer. venatan hakkatuv taam lekabbalat Adonai teshuva shelema levaddah belo yissurin, o teshuva sheenah shelema al yede yissurin, "ki el rachum Adonai elohecha".

Od yitbaaru hakketuvim al ze hadderech: uvikkashtem mishsham – perush, ucheshettihyu ben haummot sham tevakshuhu vetitpallelu elav laddevarim hatztzerichim lachem lechayyotchem, veeno medabber bevakkashat haggeulla. umatzata – sheyyimmatze lachem, sheim lo chen yovdu bar minnan. veamar leshon yachid lomar shello lechullam yimmatze kesheyyikrauhu beeretz haammim ella lichide segulla, vehattaam ki tidreshennu vegomer – perush, tzarich mevakkesh Adonai hitatztzemut gadol, veulay yassigu habbakkasha beseder ze yechide am.

Veamro batztzar lecha – katuv ze medabber behavetachat haggeulla, ki batztzar leam yisrael shehu zeman haggalut, od lo sheyyimtzauhu kol haddevarim haelle haamurim besamuch, shehem hashemada min haadama vahafatza ben haummot vehameata sheyyishshaaru mete mispar, ze yihye beacharit hayyamim vehem chevle mashiach. velo yihye lahem kol hatztzarot bitmidut bizmannim arukkim ella beacharit hayyamim, umavticham sheyyeorer Adonai levavam az lashuv bitshuva, vehu amro veshavta ad Adonai, venatan taam lehavetacha zo "ki el rachum Adonai elohecha lo yarpecha" vegomer vichazzek libbecha lashuv vegomer.

Veulay shezzo hi taanat michael lifne Adonai shehevi bezohar chadash (daf 30), shehare bau acharit hayyamim umatzu otam kol haddevarim, velamma lo yeorer Adonai libbam lashuv, uferashti hammaamar bemakom acher, veenenu laAdonai tzofiyyot liftoach otzar ruach tahara lifkoach enayim ivrot ulehattot levavot am Adonai lehakkir neimut arevut yediduto:

Utzedaka tihye lanu vegomer. tzarich ladaat hakkavvana bemaamar tzedaka, veramban peresh shechozer el sechar hammitzvot, ki yihye betorat tzedaka meAdonai, ki avadim anachnu vechayyavim laavod veen lanu din sachar, ad kan, veen hakkatuv meyushshav al nachon lidvarav zichrono livracha, od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro lifne Adonai kaasher tzivvanu vegomer.

Achen hakkavvana hi lefi sheyyesh shete haderagot baavodat Adonai, 1 hi avoda miyyira, veze hi chiyyuv al kol hannivraim shekkol eved yare merabbo, al derech amro (Malachi 1:6) "im adonim ani ayye morai", vehu maamar hakkatuv (Devarim 10:12) "ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira". 2 hi avoda meahava, vehi mitzva rabba vaatzuma, aval en chiyyuvah letzad heyot haadam eved sheyyihye ohev, day shello yisna veyaavod hatztzarich, veze hu davar shechayyav haeved lerabbo, uchenegdo rabbo chayyav lezuno ulefarneso keyad rabbo, keneged chiyyuv hammuttal letzad heyoto eved amar hakkatuv shekkodem laze vaytzavvenu Adonai leyira et Adonai, vegamar omer letov lanu vegomer lechayyotenu vegomer, perush mitzvat Adonai baa bechiyyuv leyira kemishpat eved lemalko, vegam al Adonai lehetiv keyad hammelech lefarnasa ulechalkala lechayyotenu ki chayyav haadon befarnasat avdo.

Veamro kehayyom hazze – perush, keseder shehu ose hayyom hazze shehu zan umefarnes, morid hamman vegomer, umechasse, keamram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 7) shehayta kesutam gedela immahem kechomet vehaananim megahatzim habbegadim. ucheneged avoda meahava amar ze, eno bechiyyuv haeved ella bederech tzedaka tihye lanu ki nishmor vegomer lifne Adonai. rasham baze tachlit haahava al derech amram zichronam livracha (chovot hallevavot sear ahavat Adonai 81) veze leshono: haahava hi kelot hannefesh unetotah el habbore, vezo hi devekut hannefesh lifne or hanneerav hu Adonai elohenu.

Veamro kaasher tzivvanu, perush, lo letzad shum peniyya, ella laasot mitzvat Adonai, kederech amro (tehillim 40:9) "laasot retzoncha elohay chafatzti", shezze hu asot hammitzva beahava shelema. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat achare mot befasuk (Vayikra 18:2) "kemaase eretz mitzrayim" vegomer, vedavar ze bo yitztaddek adam vikav lesachar gam kefi haddin. vahagam shekkefi haemet alenu leshallem sachar lelohenu baruch hu shehitimanu arevut neimut metikut ahavato belibbenu, metukim vaarevim leen tachlit, ella sheyyittol adam sachar al hitatztzemuto ad shehissig taam bachayyim.
Od ramaz hakkatuv remez nelam, shebbeemtzaut shemirat hammitzvot tihye lanu chelkenu shechinato yitbarach hannikret tzedaka (Tikkunei Zohar 421), vehaven:

rashi: Mizbechotehem. shel binyan:
Umatztzevotam. even achat:
Vaasherehem. ilanot sheovdin otan:
Ufesilehem. tzelamim:

ohc: Asher hikka moshe vegomer betzetam mimmitzrayim. kashe, vahalo bishnat haarbaim hikka moshe eretz sichon? veulay shennitkavven lomar ki meet yetziatam mimmitzrayim haya muchan lifnehem lehakkoto, sheim lo haya maase hammeraggelim hayu makkim oto beshana sheniyya letzetam meeretz mitzrayim:

Od nitkavven lomar ki meet sheyyatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim, emot mavet naflu alav mehem, vehaya mukke veomed, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 80) shemmasoret beyadam vechulei, velaze samach maamar betzetam lemaamar hahakkaa, veachar kach amar "vayyirshu et artzo" lehaircha kidvarenu.

rashi: Venoshantem. ramaz lahem sheyyiglu mimmenna lesof shemone meot vachamishshim ushetayim shana keminyan "venoshantem", vehu hikdim vehiglam lesof shemone meot vachamishshim, vehikdim shete shanim livnoshantem", kede shello yitkayyem bahem ki avod tovedun, vezehu shenneemar (Daniel 9) "vayyishkod al haraa vayvieha alenu ki tzaddik Adonai elohenu" – tzedaka asa immanu shemmiher lahaviah shete shanim lifne zemannah (sanhedrin 38; gittin 88):
Mibbet avadim. ketargumo mibbet avduta – mimmakom sheheyitem sham avadim:

Vaetchannan. en chinnun bechol makom ella leshon mattenat chinnam – aappi sheyyesh lahem latztzaddikim litlot bemaasehem hattovim en mevakkeshim meet hammakom ella mattenat chinnam, (lefi sheamar lo vechannoti et asher achon amar lo bilshon vaetchannan); davar acher ze echad measara leshonot shennikret tefilla, kidita besifre:
Baet hahiv. leachar shekkavashti eretz sichon veog dimmiti shemma huttar hanneder:
Lemor. ze echad migg mekomot sheamar moshe lifne hammakom eni mannichacha ad shettodieni im taase sheelati im lav (sifre):
ohc: Vaetchannan el Adonai baet hahiv lemor. tzarich ladaat amro baet hahiv. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre Devarim 26) kesheraa shennafal sichon veog lefanav vechulei, ledivrehem chozer lema shellefanav shehi milchemet sichon veog, ulefi ze taam hammaamar lomar shezzulat ma shehaya baet hahi lo hayiti mitpallel ki haggezera kevar nigzera.

Venire lomar behair od amro lemor, verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (sifre) sheamar moshe laAdonai hashiveni al devaray im ani nichnas laaretz, veze derech derash. achen perush amro "baet hahi" hu zeman shennishba Adonai al dor hammidbar shello yiru et haaretz sheamar befarasha shellemala, uchelalo lemoshe bichlal shevuat haggezera, kemo sheamar (Devarim 1:37) "gam bi hitannaf Adonai biglalchem". baet hahi hitchannen laAdonai levattel gezerato ulehattir hashshevua, karamuz bemaamar "atta hachillota", vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha leshon hattarat shevua, kaasher avaer besamuch. vetaam hammaamar hu lehodiam leval yachsheduhu shello hitpallel ella al atzmo levattel gezerato velo chash ledoro veheelim ayin mimmennu vetam kol haddor hahu. laze amar baet hahi perush, kodem shennitkayyema haggezera hitchannen laAdonai.

Vahagam shebbitchillato lo matzinu shello hizkir ella al atzmo velo ammo, af al pi chen kavvanato hayta bechachma shehitpallel al atzmo lehattir shevua shealav, veachar kach yomar lefanav levattel gam al yisrael, veyihye haddavar kal lehassig middin neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo (nedarim 66.). vehu amro lemor perush, en tachlit haddavar baddevarim hanneemarim ella lemor od devarim acherim. veze asa bechachma, ki yoter yihye nakel lehitkabbel tefillato al atzmo lehattir shevuat haggezera shealav, leheyoto naki vetzaddik, mehattir shevuat gezerat yisrael shehem baale heavon, vechol divre moshe yaggidu tzidkat Adonai asa.

Od nitkavven ledayyek arbaa tenaim hatztzerichin lekabbalat tefilla: echad, sheyyitpallel keani haddofek al happetach, kederech amro (Mishlei 18:23) "tachanunim yedabber rash". 2, sheyyevakkesh mimmekor harachamim. 3, zeman hattefilla, kederech amro (tehillim 69:14) "vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon". 4, shettihye tefillato meforeshet velo tihye sovelet perush bilti hagun, uchemaase shehuva bammidrash (Ester Rabba 87:24) behahu goy veyisrael vechulei, veyalda behemto shel goy veanas yisrael leharekivo al ketefo vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven moshe bemaamaro kan: vaetchannan – leshon tachanunim, ze keneged tenay rishon. el Adonai – shebbikkesh mimmekor harachamim, ze keneged tenay sheni. baet hahi – perush baet hayyedua lekabbalat tefilla shehi et ratzon, ki mi yodea et haratzon kemoshe. veefshar shezze haya beet asher amar lo Adonai "hachel rash" eretz sichon veog, veze mechuvvan ledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru leachar shekkavash eretz sichon veog vechulei, ze keneged tenay shelishi. lemor – perush, peresh amarav kammitztarech shello yisbelu devarav davar bilti hagun, ze keneged tenay revii. uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru "baet hahi" kesheraa milchemet sichon veog, taam amro lemor nimshechet im "atta hachillota". uchevar katavti bechamma mekomot ki kesheeno omer haddibbur bilshon atzmo sheamaro ella kolel hammechuvvan belashon acher, hu omer "lemor" – perush, kavvanat hammaamar hi zot. kemo chen bema shellefanenu amar "lemor" lehaircha al ze. veyesh merabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru (yalkut shemauni 19) "baet hahi" kesheamar lo (Bamidbar 20:12) "lo taviu et hakkahal" vegomer, veyesh sheamru (midrash Rabba) kesheamar lo (Bamidbar 27:18) "kach et yehoshua" vegomer. veefshar shebbechol haittim hitpallel veal kol et mehem hu omer "baet hahi", veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

rashi: Veshinnantam. leshon chiddud hu, sheyyihyu mechuddadim beficha, sheim yishalcha adam davar lo tehe tzarich legamgem bo ella emor lo miyyad (sifre; kiddushin 30):

Levanecha. ellu hattalmidim, matzinu bechol makom shehattalmidim keruyyim banim, shenneemar (Devarim 14) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, veomer (Melachim 2 2) bene hanneviim asher bet el, vechen bechizkiyyahu, shellimmed tora lechol yisrael, ukeraam banim shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 29) banay atta al tishshalu. ucheshem shehattalmidim keruyim banim (shenneemar banim attem laAdonai elohechem) kach harav karuy av, shenneemar (Melachim 2 2) avi avi rechev yisrael vegomer (sifre):
Vedibbarta bam. shello yehe ikkar dibburecha ella bam – asem ikkar veal taasem tafel (sham):

Uveshochbecha. yachol afillu shachav bachatzi hayyom, tal uvekumecha, yachol afillu amad bachatzi hallayla, tal beshivtecha bevetecha uvelechtecha vadderech – derech eretz dibbera tora, zeman shechiva uzeman kima (sham):
Hitannaf. nitmalle rogez:
Al divrechem. al odotechem, al iskechem:
ohc: VaAdonai hitannaf vegomer levilti vegomer ulevilti vegomer. chazar lomar od maamar ze, velo hispik ma sheamar befarashat devarim dichtiv (Devarim 1:37) "gam bi hitannaf" vegomer, gam kafal lomar levilti shete peamim, lomar gezera acheret shennigzera alav millevad sheyyamut bammidbar, od gazar alav shello yaalu atzmotav lehikkaver baaretz kederech sheasa hu leatzmot yosef uchederech sheasu kol yisrael lishar hashshevatim (yerushalmi sota 1:10), vehu amro levilti avri perush bachayyim, ulevilti vo perush leachar mita "el haaretz hattova", vehu ma sheamar od besamuch anochi met vegomer enenni over et hayyarden perush ben kodem mita ben leachar mita. vegamar omer keneged yisrael attem ovrim velo leachar mita levad ella afillu bachayyim, vehu amro virishtem vegomer, vedibber bederech lo zo af zo.

Veamro al divrechem, keamram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 2), mashal lemi shenneevdu lo maot ufizzer benehem dinar zahav vechulei, kemo chen et sheyyaamod moshe yaamdu immo kol dor hammidbar, hu hotziam mimmitzrayim, hu yotziem mehammidbar viviam laolam habba leatid lavo im hatztzaddikim, ad kan. vehu amro "al divrechem", shezzulat taam sibbatam lahaviam laolam habba lo haya nishba leval yikkansu atzmotav shel moshe laaretz hattova.

rashi: Haidoti vachem. hinni mazminam lihyot edim shehitreti vachem:
Rak hishshamer lecha … pen tishkach et haddevarim. az, keshello tishkechu otam vetaasum al amittatam, techashvu chachamim unevonim, veim teavvetu otam mittoch shichcha, techashvu shotim:
Mezuzot betecha. mazezat ketiv, sheen tzarich ella achat:
Uvisharecha. lerabbot shaare chatzerot veshaare medinot veshaare ayarot (yoma 11):

ohc: Enechem haroot vegomer achare vaal vegomer. perush, attem reitem hachumera shebbaavoda zara yater al kol haaverot, sheafillu otam shello avaduha ella shechashvu belibbam vehalchu acharav leavdo, hagam shello avaduhu adayin – hishmidam Adonai, vehu al derech amro (kiddushin lat:, Yechezkel 14:5) "lemaan tefos yisrael" vegomer:

rashi: Ki anochi met vegomer enenni over. meachar shemmet mehechan yaavor? ella af atzmotay enam ovrim (sifre Bamidbar 27):
Navel. kamash:
targum: Yavesh isba netar nitzeh are rucha min kodam Adonai neshavat beh bechen keisba chashivin rashiaya beama:

rashi: Chug. leshon "mechuga" (Yeshayahu 44:13), ugal, 526 109:
Veyoshveha. lefanav kachagavim:
Chaddok. kiria, 60 109:
targum: Deashre bitkof ruma shechinat yekare vechol yatve ara chashivin kodamohi kekamtzin dematach kizer shemaya ufarsinun kemashkan yekara levet shechinta:

rashi: Veahavta. ase devarav meahava, eno dome haose meahava laose miyyira, haose etzel rabbo miyyira, keshehu matriach alav mannicho veholech lo (sham):
Bechol levavcha. bishne yetzarecha (sifre; berachot 54); davar acher bechol levavcha shello yihye libbecha chaluk al hammakom (sifre):
Uvechol nafshecha. afillu hu notel et nafshecha (sifre; berachot 54):

Uvechol meodecha. bechol mamoncha, yesh lecha adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo (Bereshit 57), lechach neemar bechol meodecha. davar acher — uvechol meodecha bechol midda umidda shemmoded lecha, ben bemidda tova ben bemiddat puranut, vechen david hu omer (tehillim 116) kos yeshuot essa tzara veyagon emtza vegomer (70 sifre):
ohc: Veahavta. amar betosefet vav, lomar millevad mitzvat shema yisrael shehu kabbalat ol malchut shamayim hi mitzvat ahavat Adonai. od yirtze lehair lehakkodem laahava al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 56.) en adam massig geder haahava ad shettakdim bo hayyira, vehu amro veahavta millevad geder hayyira. veamro et Adonai perush al yede haahava adam mitdabbek baAdonai, vehu amro "et Adonai".

Od yirtze sheal yede ahavat Adonai yassig madrega zo sheyyihye Adonai meyached shemo alav beyichud, kederech amro (Bereshit 28:13) "elohe avraham elohe yitzchak", uferush shekkol echad rauy bifne atzmo sheyyityached shem elohuto alav. vetimtza sheavraham beer bo hakkatuv shehaya ahuv, dichtiv (yeshaya 41:8) "zera avraham ohavi", uchemo chen ramaz hakkatuv kan shekkol sheahuv Adonai yikkare Adonai elohav beyichud, vetevat Adonai nimshechet lefaneha uleachareha.

Od yirtze leorer lev ish yisrael leahavat Adonai al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni sof parashat noach) befasuk "yoshev tehillot yisrael" (tehillim 22:4), shello bachar Adonai mikkol hattehillot zulat keshehilleluhu veamru lefanav "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael", az yashav al kisse malchut olam. vehu amro veahavta et Adonai letaam ze shello bachar lihyot ella elohecha. uvehair haadam libbo lifratim kaellu titnattek nafsho vetittar mimmekomah behitorrut nifla veram beahavat hanneehav yitalle rum tiferet kevodo.

Od ulay shennitkavven leorer lev haadam bishlosha mine ahava sheyyeshnam behakkara lannivraim, vehem: ahavat hattov, ahavat hearev, ahavat hammoil. laze ba devar Adonai lishlashtam, veahavta et Adonai – beshem ze heir hallev livchinat ahavat hattov bema shehu tov haramuz bashshem, keamro (tehillim 145:9) "tov Adonai lakkol", gam becheshek hearev besod (tehillim 34:9) "taamu ureu ki tov Adonai", ki chol hannefesh asher yochiach shem ze lemulah en arevut bechol hannivraim sheyyikkanes elav beerech hannishtavv, veze lecha haot amro (Shir HaShirim 5:6) "nafshi yatza vedabbero". gam taskil befasuk (Bamidbar 33:2), "al pi Adonai", ki titnattek hannefesh mehagguf velo targish bappereda lehafelagat hergesh hearev mehattov. hare shamanu ahavat hattov veahavat hearev mittevat Adonai. veahavat hammoil remazah beamro "elohecha", al derech amro (tehillim 22:4) "yoshev tehillot" kemo shekkatavti besamuch, uvaze nichlal gam ken ahavat hammoil ki vaze hirvachnu olam umeloo, kemaamar shelomo (Kohelet 12:13) "ki ze kol haadam", kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella litzvat laze (shabbat 30:).

Bechol levavcha uvechol vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre) baze ma sheamru, yeuyyan sham divrehem. venire shennitkavven Adonai bemaamar ze lehasir tina millev ohavav, vehu sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (moed katan koach.) bene chayye umezone lav bizchuta talya milleta ella bemazzala, ad kan. vehinne shelosha devarim ellu hem kelalut cheshek haadam vecheftzo baolam: hachayyim, vehabbanim, vehammezonot, vehechaser echad mehenna bar minnan yikkare met. ushelashtam enam teluyim lehassigam beemtzaut avodat Adonai veahavato, veze yesovev haharchaka meohave Adonai. uma gam behitkabbetz lehaohev shenayim mehem – choser habbanim vehaoni, yitchammetz levavo bekirbo, vahagam sheyyitchazzek im levavo, levavo lo yishma lo ki hammuregash elav yarchikennu mishshemoa leehov.

Laze ba devar Adonai vetzivva lo al haddavar hazze, sheyyaarich ahavat Adonai belibbo bishlosha devarim hagam sheyyittelem mimmennu. keneged habbanim amar bechol levavcha, al derech amro (Bereshit 22:2) "et bincha vegomer asher ahavta" vegomer, vehaahava kazo hi ahava hammemallet lev adam vecheshko. ucheneged chayye amar uvechol nafshecha, ucheneged mezone amar uvechol meodecha, sheyyaarich bedato shelashtam yachad baAdonai, ki hu tov leyisrael measara banim, veshulchan gavoah elyon hu meod, kemaamar hattanna (avot 6:5) sheshshulchancha gadol mishshulchanam, vehachayyim mimmennu totzot chayyim, veaf ki achare mot hatztzaddik yikkare chay, keamro (Shmuel 2 23:20) "uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay", hare sheafillu achar mita yikkare chay (berachot 18.).

O yomar al ze hadderech, ki ba hakkatuv leshaer shiur haahava shemmechuyyav kol ish yisrael leehov habbore, veamar shehu beshiur hahergesh asher yavo belev haadam beet asher tassig yado lishlosha devarim keechad, kemo shettomar adam shehaya chasuch banim veani venata lamut, uva navi bidvar Adonai uvissero ki yakum mechalyo, gam amar elav hinne ishtecha hara veyoledet ben, vechi revach gadol nizdammen lo lehaashir bahem. adam kaze ma meod yafli ahavat haadon been shiur, vetihye haahava murgeshet belibbo becheshek mufla al asher hetiv immo kamma maalot tovot. kemo chen yetzav Adonai al kol ish yisrael asot beahavato tamid, vehu amro veahavta et Adonai vegomer bechol levavcha, perush keillu natan lecha kol machsorcha bechol levavcha shehem habbanim, vedikdek lomar bechol lehair dimyon hammashal shehu chaser mehabbanim vayyittenem Adonai lo, uchemo chen uvechol nafshecha shennatan lecha nafshecha achar haggiacha leshaare mavet, uvechol meodecha keillu natan lecha kol mamoncha sheatta chafetz, veamar "kol" lehair dimyon hammashal.

Vehinne hammaskil beinyan cheshek Adonai, kol ze davar kal hu beerech ma shehannefesh chosheket babbore. vehimshalti davar ze leadam gadol umufla binchasim sheratza lalechet lemakom rachok letzad sakkanat makom shehaya bo, veasaf kol nechasav bikniyyat margalit gedola beelef alfe dinare zahav, vesam lederech peamav leir rechoka asher sham nachon libbo batuach bemamono vehono. vekodem shehiggia lair asher pana bedato lalechet shamma, kalta tzedato veen dinar bechiso, vehaya mistappek bedallut uveoni gadol veshiflut rav ki afes kasef. vehinne ze haish, hagam shehu mithallech bedochak vetzaar, im kol ze libbo sameach vechilyotav allizim ki rav ono vehono, veyatza mimmakom hammistakken uvo yavo verinna nose haeven gedola yikrat haerech. ken haddavar hazze, adam shezzacha bidvekuto yitbarach veahavato uvo kibbetz kol mamono vehono, vayyivez beenav kenot davar baolam hazze letzad sakkanat hammakom, nosaf al miut shavyo, velakach lo Adonai lelohim – en lecha keniyya baolam kekinyan ze, lemala mehaeven yekara shebbammashal, ki mi yidme lo umi yishve lo. veadam kaze, lu yihye sheyyihye dachuk umitztaer beyamim muatim elle lo baolam hazze, nachon libbo batuach baAdonai or olam veyismach libbo veyagel kevodo. uvehaggia limchoz cheftzo shehu olam hakkayyam vehabbatuach, hinne secharo itto. umeatta chibbat hakkodesh hu hayyotzer udevekuto bo, halo hu banav vechayyav umamono uveyeter seet.

rashi: Aira shachar. derech shear melachim, hashshachar meorram, vaani meorer et hashshachar; sheani kam chatzot layla (tehillim 119:62), shehannevel vehakkinnor meorreni; kemo sheamru rabbotenu (berachot 3:): kinnor haya taluy lemala mimmittato shel david; kevan shehiggia chatzi hallayla, ruach tzefonit menashshevet bo, vehu menaggen meelav:
targum: Shabbach nivla vechinara ashabbach bikritzta:

rashi: Asche vechol layla mittati. leshon "sechi umaos" (Eicha 3:45), "vehayta nivlatam kassucha" (Yeshayahu 5:25) – memaes ani mittati bidmaot. umenachem chibbero im "kaasher yefares hassoche lischot" (Yeshayahu 25:11), veim "me sachu" (Yechezkel 47:5):
Bedimati arsi amse. alachleach veartiv kemo mayim:
targum: Eshtalhet betinchati amalel betzaari bechol lelya al shivuyi vedimati dargashi atmesh:

rashi: Habbet labberit. asher karatta et avotenu:
Neot chamas. neve chamas, leshon mador:
targum: Istakkol likyama digzarta laavahatan arum itmeliu venehon chashocha feris al ara veoniuta vachatofin:

rashi: Chatzuvim. lefi shehu mekom terashin uselaim nofel bo leshon chatziva:
Kol. meet hakkadosh baruch hu omer elay: "kera":

Veamar. ruchi elav: "ma ekra?" vehakkol meshivo: "zot kera: kol habbasar chatzir" – kol hammagbihim tehafech gedullatam vetihye kechatzir. (davar achar: kol habbasar chatzir) – sof adam lamut, lefichach im amar laasot chesed hare hu ketzitz hassade asher yemolel veyivash veen lismoch alav, sheen beyado lekayyem shemma yamut, shekkesheyavesh chatzir navel tzitz, ken keshemmet haadam batla havetachato. aval devar elohenu yakum ki hu chay vekayyam uveyado lekayyem, lefichach al har gavoah ali uvasseri mevasseret tziyyon (Yeshayahu 40:9), ki mippi hachay leolam hi havetachat habbesora:
Vechol chasdo ketzitz hassade. ki "chesed vegomer chattat" (Mishlei 14:34):
targum: Kal daamar itnabbe umetev vaamar ma itnabbe kol rashiaya keisba vechol tukefhon kemotza dechakla:

rashi: Vayyitabber Adonai. nitmalle chema:
Lemaanchem. attem geramtem li, vechen hu omer (tehillim 106) "vayyaktzifu al me meriva vayyera lemoshe baavuram":
Rav lach. shello yomru harav kamma kashe vehattalmid kamma sarvan umaftzir (sota 13); davar acher — rav lach, harebe mizze shamur lecha, rav tuv hatztzafun lecha (sifre):
ohc: Vayyitabber Adonai vegomer velo shama vegomer. kafal lomar "vayyitabber" velo shama", gam hifsik betevat lemaanchem ben maamar "vayyitabber" lemaamar "velo shama", shehaya lo lomar "vayyitabber Adonai bi velo shama elay lemaanchem". gam amar tevat lemaanchem achar shekkevar amar lemala (Devarim 1:37) gam bi hitannaf Adonai biglalchem. yitbaer al pi ma shepperashnu bema sheamar "baet hahi lemor", shennitkavven lehitpallel al atzmo vegam al yisrael. laze keneged ma shennitkavven bitfillato al yisrael amar vayyitabber Adonai bi lemaanchem, perush lemaan ma shennogea lachem, ucheneged ma shehitpallel al atzmo amar velo shama elay, perush lema shennogea li. uvaze lo amar leshon evra ki sheelat moshe al atzmo hi sheelat chacham betaana hannishmaat kemo shekkatavnu lemala, ma sheen ken yisrael shehiktzifu et Adonai venitchayyevu kelaya baavonotenu harabbim, laze amar "vayyitabber".

O yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyitabber Adonai bi lamut chutz laaretz lemaanchem, mittaam hayyadua, kede sheyyaamdu immo laolam habba, keamram zichronam livracha. velaze dikdek lomar vayyitabber leshon evra, al derech amro (Tzefanya 1:15) "yom evra hayyom hahu" shehu yom hammita. veamro velo shama elay shello ratza Adonai sheyyikkanes laaretz kol ikkar, afillu bitnay sheyyetze mimmenna achar kach veyikkaver bammakom hahu shebbo nikbar im mete midbar, kemo shepperashnu lemala bemaamar "ebera na".

Vayyomer vegomer rav lach vegomer al tosef. kafal lomar "rav lach al tosef", ba lehashiv lishne devarim habbaim bitfillat moshe: keneged ma shehitpallel al atzmo amar lo rav lach, ramaz lo betevat "rav" ki kelum taam tefillat moshe laavor el haaretz hu kede lekayyem mitzvot hatteluyot baaretz, laze heshivo sheeno tzarich laze, ki yesh lo rav tuv asher yitten lo Adonai, vehu amro "rav lach" veencha tzarich leshum tosefet zechut; ucheneged ma shehaya mitpallel al yisrael hishtiko bigara veamar lo "al tosef dabber" vegomer:

O nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech, ki chol zechut shettaggia levae haaretz min hammitzvot hatteluyot baaretz yesh lecha chelek bechullan, uma ze hu hachelek? sheatta hu hammetzavve otam laasot, vehu amro rav lach, perush harabbanut shel kiyyum hammitzva lecha hi, veim ken yesh lecha chelek im kol echad bechol maase asher yaasu sham, vaasher al ken al tosef dabber baddavar hazze.

Od nitkavven bemaamar rav lach lehashiv al taanat "ebera na" shepperashnu sheratza lomar sheyyaavirehu mehammalchut mishshum malchut yehoshua, laze amar rav lach perush, haggedulla veharabbanut hi meyoedet umeyuchedet lecha kol zeman sheatta benimtza, velo efshar latet haggedulla letalmidcha bechayyim chayyutecha, umeatta en tikkun letaam "en malchut nogaat bachavertah" vechulei (berachot moach:), ulederech ze hammaamar "al tosef" tzarich leatzmo veeno meyuttar.

Od nire lefaresh al ze hadderech "rav lach" legufa, veamro al tosef nimshach im ma shelleacharav shehu maamar "ale rosh happisga" vegomer, perush lefi sheamar lo Adonai "ale rosh" vegomer shennitkabbela chatzi tefillato sheamar "veere et haaretz hattova", chash Adonai sheyyomar moshe osif lishpoch sichi, veze lecha haot ki Adonai shama koli besichi, laze amar lo "al tosef" vegomer baddavar hazze perush bedavar ze sheani omer, vehu ma sheggamar omer ki lo taavor perush, davar ze muchlat hu.

rashi: Horeta. ketargumo "itchazeta"; keshennatan hakkabba et hattora patach lahem shiva rekiim, ucheshem shekkara et haelyonim kach kara et hattachtonim, verau shehu yechidi, lechach neemar "atta hareta ladaat":
Al yashov dach nichlam. al yashov dach millefanecha, bitfillato, nichlam:
targum: La yetuv misken machsif anya vachashocha yeshabbechun shemach:

rashi: Ushemartem. zo mishna:
Vaasitem. kemashmao (sham):
Ki hiv chochmatchem uvinatchem vegomer. bazot techashvu chachamim unevonim leene haammim:
Kol ge yinnase vehahar yishpal, hare derech chalaka veshava venocha:
Veharchasim. harim hassemuchim ze laze, umittoch semichatan morad shebbenehem zakuf veeno meukkam, sheyyehe noach lered velaalot (harchasim meturgam "gedudav", leshon gova kemo 'gedude hannahar):
Harchasim. kemo "veyirkesu et hachoshen" (Shemot 28:28):
Levika. kanepaneyya 109, eretz chalaka veshava:
targum: Kol chelaya yeramun vechol tur verama yimachun vihe chifla lemeshra uvet gidudin levika:

rashi: Hamesukkan teruma. o im ba laasoto shel etz, hamelummad lehavechin ben etz hammitkayyem lishar etzim shelo yirkav maher yivchar:
Hamesukkan. hammelummad, kemo (Bamidbar 22:30) "hahasken hiskanti":
Teruma. haferasha, berirat haetzim:
targum: Oran bare aa dela achid beh rikva bachar nagar uman bee leh leatkana tzelam dela yitztele:

ohc: Adonai elohenu karat vegomer. hinne lo beer moshe ma berit hu ze, im berit shekkartu yisrael lekayyem torat Adonai dichtiv (Shemot 24:8) "hinne dam habberit asher karat Adonai immachem al kol haddevarim", o berit shekkarat Adonai leyisrael shello yachalifem beumma acheret dichtiv (Shemot 34:10) "hinne anochi koret berit neged kol ammecha" vegomer, ufershu zichronam livracha shekkarat lahem berit al zot shello tishre shechinato al haummot. vehaddaat machraat sheal berit ze hu omer, vehu ma sheramaz beamro Adonai elohenu karat immanu, perush, al sheyyihye elohenu, velo lezulatenu karat immanu berit, vealav chozer maamar "habberit hazzot" sheamar achar kach. uchefi ze kavvanat hammaamar leshevach yisrael hammussag meAdonai lahem, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Veatta po vegomer. perush, lefi shello asu yisrael lemoshe shaliach lekabbel pikkude Adonai ad atta, laze Adonai gamar baadam ukevao leshaliach veamar lo "veatta po" vegomer, vaadabbera elecha et kol hammitzva vegomer. veulay shennitkavven lomar shebbehaggia hammitzva meAdonai lemoshe keillu nitkabbela leyisrael, shehare asauhu shaliach, uchedin sheliach haishsha lekabbel kiddusheha shekkevan shekkibbelam hashshaliach keillu bau leyad haishsha ki yado keyadah, kemo chen kesheyyekabbel moshe hammitzva keillu kibbeluha yisrael. vehu amro vaadabbera elecha, uvehaggia haddavar elecha atta todia lahem veasu otah, vehu amro "telammedem veasu".
Veyadata hayyom. tzarich ladaat ma yediat yom miyyamim, ma yashiv el libbo? veulay shennitkavven lehearot hatztzerichin lehachenia hayyetzer hashshochen belev haadam.

1) Al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 5.): im paga becha menuvval ze vechulei, veim lav yizkor lo yom hammita, uvaze yihye nichna levavo. vehu amro veyadata – yitten bedato hayyom hayyadua shehu yom hammita, uvaze vahashevota el levavecha – lahashivo el derech hattov vehayyashar. vedikdek lomar levavecha leshon rabbim, lirmoz lishne yetzarim – yetzer hattov veyetzer hara:

2) Al derech amram zichrono livracha (socha nov.) shelleatid lavo yavi hakkadosh baruch hu et hassatan veshochato leene kol yisrael, vetzivva moshe sheyyitten haadam bidiato hayyom hahu haggadol shebbo yishlof Adonai charbo veyishchat 100 harasha, uvaze yashiv el levavo lederech hayyashar ki yikkana hassatan lefanav.

3) Od yirtze sheyyizkor lo hayyom haggadol shehu yom haddin, ma yaase ki yakum el vechi yifkod ma yeshivennu, vechamma tigdal cherpato lifne kahal veeda elyonim vetachtonim, uvaze "vahashevota" vegomer.

4) Al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra 84.) lamma hachamma babboker paneha adummim vechulei, lefi sheoveret al pitchah shel gehinnam vechulei, vehu amro veyadata ten libbecha ladaat maase hayyom vetire hakkara bashshemesh ki yesh din leovre retzono, uvaze tashiv el levavecha vegomer:

Adonai) al derech amram anshe emet shonim besh, ki bechinat hakkedushsha tikkare yom, uvechinat hazzarut tikkare layla, veal yede maase adam yikkached mibbechinat yom veyihye chelko bemiddat layla, velaze hitpallel david veamar "mippachad ballelot" (tehillim 91:5), vehu amro veyadata hayyom, perush, hishtaddel ladaat midda zo shennikret hayyom, uvaze atta meatzmecha tatte levavcha lederech hannachon.

6) Al derech amram zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar (11 178.) veze leshono: man innun mare chushebana? innun divchol lelya avdin chushebana benafshayyhu bema deavdin behahu yoma umetakkenin archayyhu vechulei, ad kan. vehinne im haadam ose kaddavar hazze devar yom beyomo, yargish bemaasav haraim veyashuv al hashshegagot veyitvadde al heavar, vezulat ze, letzad miut haregashato bahem yatmid asot kahem ugedolim mehem, vegam ki yashuv lo yizkor et asher avaruhu lehitvaddot alehem. velaze tzivva moshe bemaamar veyadata hayyom, perush shebbechol yom yeda maasehu shel oto yom, vehu derech mare dechushebana, uvaze vahashevota el levavecha shello yatmid bahem, veen tzarich lomar shello yosif lehara.

7) Al derech amram besefer hazzohar (Zohar 9 233:) ki yom shehannefesh baa meolam haelyon, mashbiah Adonai al hattora umatre bah beonshin merubbin uveyiudim merubbim im tetiv, veayyen besefer hazzohar. ucheneged yom ze amar veyadata hayyom, perush, hayyom shennasa, sheyyizkor yom nesiat nafsho meolam haelyon bechamma hateraot, veze yashiv el libbo vechulei:

8) Al derech amram zichrono livracha (chagiga 12.) ki olam hazze yikkare layla veolam haelyon yikkare yom, vehinne letzad sheyyire haadam devarim menuggadim baolam hazze, tzaddik vera lo rasha vetov lo leen cheker, yattehu levavo mibbechor battov hannitzchi, veyarehu harshaim baolam hazze shemmasrichin umarvichin, veyomar elav halo tire ki tov hu. laze amar veyadata hayyom shehu olam hammityaches elav yom, vahashevota el levavecha teshuva nitztzachat ki Adonai bocher hakkiyyum lididav umeshallem lesonav vechulei.

9) Al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat pach.) befasuk (Bereshit 1:31) "vayhi erev vegomer yom hashshishshi", shehitna hashshem im maase vereshit al yom mattan tora vechulei, vehu ma sheramaz beamro veyadata hayyom, perush hayyom hannichbad shennigla al har sinay ma nora maasav veshealav ba hattenay im haolam, uvaze tashiv levavcha lederech hattora. ulederech ze amro ki Adonai hu haelohim nimshach im ma shellemala "vahashevota el levavecha", sheal yede hayyom hahu hukkar lechol haolam ki en elohim zulato bashshamayim vegomer veal haaretz, ucheamram zichronam livracha (mechilta parashat anochi Adonai) befasuk (Yeshayahu 48:16) "lo merosh basseter dibbarti".

10) Yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 25,12) shakul shabbat keneged kol hattora kullah, vehinne lefi sheyyavo hayyetzer veyomar laadam: "ma kochacha ki teyachel lekayyem kol hattora kullah shehi shelemut haadam?" uma gam adam sheavaruhu raot rabbot, yarchikehu hayyetzer: "ma tuchal letakken et asher paalu yadecha meharaot?" laze amar moshe veyadata hayyom – oto shekkatuv bo "hayyom" shehu hashshabbat, dichtiv (Shemot 16,25): "ki shabbat hayyom", ten datecha alav uvo tashiv el levavecha ki hu shakul keneged kol hattora, veze yoil listor shete teanot: ben letakken ma sheavaruhu mehammeradim ben lehashelamat hannefesh, sheal yede shemirato hare hu keillu kiyyem taryag mitzvot.

rashi: En de baer. al mizbecho:
Vechayyato. shel levanon, en de ola. davar acher: ulevanon en de baer vegomer. lechapper al avon haummot:
targum: Veilane livnan la yesafkun leadlaka vechevata devah let hi kemisat laalata:

rashi: Az yavdil. natan lev lihyot chared laddavar sheyyavdilem, veaappi sheenan koltot ad sheyyuvdelu otan shebbeeretz kenaan, amar moshe mitzva sheefshar lekayyemah akayyemenna (makkot 10):
Beever hayyarden mizrecha shamesh. beoto ever shebbemizracho shel yarden:
Mizrecha shamesh. lefi shehu davuk, nekuda resh bachataf, mizrach shel shemesh – mekom zerichat hashshemesh:
Temunat kol. temunat kol davar:
Asher tzivvecha Adonai. asher tzivvecha shello laasot:
Ebera na. en na ella leshon bakkasha:
Hahar hattov hazze. zo yerushalayim:
Vehallevanon. ze bet hammikdash (sifre):
ohc: Ebera na veere vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro na, gam lamma hutzrach lomar veere vegomer, halo kesheyyaavor hainyan meatzmo muvan sheyyire vechulei. veulay shennitkavven lehashiv teshuva al haddevarim hammonim biato laaretz, keamram zichronam livracha shehem shenayim, 1 lefi shehiggia zemanno shel yehoshua limloch (tanchuma) veen malchut nogaat bachaverta afillu kimlo nima, 2 shetztzafa hakkadosh baruch hu sheatidin yisrael lachato veyitztarech lehashelich chamato alehem, vechashav Adonai lemashken bishvilam habbayit hammekuddash karamuz betevat "mishkan mishkan" keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 131), uvaze yesh tikva vetachlit tov leyisrael, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim 79:1) befasuk "mizmor leasaf elohim bau goyim" vegomer, mizmor – kina mibbae leh, ella shehishlich chamato al etzim vaavanim velo hishlichah al yisrael vechulei, ad kan. veim haya moshe bone bet hammikdash amru zichronam livracha (sota 9.) shello hayta umma velashon sholetet bo, veze yesovev lishpoch chamato alehem lechallotam, uchemo shepperashti befarashat devarim befasuk (Devarim 1:37) "gam bi hitannaf".

Laze nitkavven moshe bidvarav lehassig al shene devarim ellu, keneged hammalchut sheenah nogaat vechulei amar ebera na perush, ebera kederech haovrim shello bederech serara vechavod, ucheneged mechush am bene yisrael kede sheyyihye lahem bet hammikdash lefidyon nafsham, amar veere, perush, lo livnot ella lirot levad, uvaze huseru shene hammechushim. vedikdek lomar tevat na perush hen atta yaavor mimmalchuto kede lehassig tikva zo.

Od nitkavven levakkesh sheyyemaher laavor kol od sheyyesh shahut bayyom sheadayin lo kalu lo yamav. ulema shekkatavti beferush "baet hahi" shennitkavven el zeman haggezera shel hammeraggelim, nitkavven lomar shemmemaher laavor bizman ze sheadayin yamav rabbim, umittoch haddevarim taskil shennitkavven levattel gezerat yisrael, ki gezeratam hayta sheyyamutu bammidbar velo yamutu mitat karet ad sheyyihyu kullam bene shishshim shana, veim yikkanes moshe az haddavar muvan meatzmo sheyyikkansu kol yisrael shello gazar Adonai alehem sheyyamutu mitat karet:

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,13) ki haggoel hammekuvve laam hammekavvim hu moshe atzmo, uvesefer hazzohar (chelek 2 120) gam ken remazuha bappasuk "ma shehaya hu sheyyihye" (Kohelet 1:9), vehen hannavi moshe yada haddevarim ki gala Adonai sodo el avdo neeman beto sheyyavo zeman acher sheyyaavor et hayyarden el haaretz vegomer, laze dikdek bitfillato ki ma sheshshoel hu sheyyaavor atta, vehu amro ebera na bazzeman hazze.

Od nire lefaresh amro ebera na, shennitkavven lehashiv gam al taam habba bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba) lamma moshe met bechutza laaretz, shehu mishshum mete midbar lahaviam laolam habba, mashal vechulei yeuyyan sham devarav, laze amar ebera perush derech haavara, lo lehishtakkea rak ebera veraglay, uchesheyyaggia hazzeman sheyyomar lo Adonai karvu yamecha lamut, yavo el hammakom asher yomar Adonai elav:

Od nitkavven belashon ebera, al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki.) kol haholech arba ammot beeretz yisrael yesh lo chelek laolam habba. laze amar lo ebera na, perush, atta bachayyim letoelet nafshi lattaanug hammekuvve shehu olam habba.

Asher beever hayyarden. hutzrach lomar kach, lefi sheyyesh eretz tova shehi eretz haelyona, kederech amro (tehillim 116:9) "ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim", vehutzrach lefaret hahar hattov vehallevanon, ledivrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (sota yad.) shekkavvanat moshe haya lekayyem mitzvot hannohagot baaretz, laze peret kol hammekomot, lomar shechafetz hu lekayyem kol hammitzvot hannohagot bechol hammekomot.

Od nitchakkem moshe lomar kaddevarim haelle, leval yihye makom laAdonai lomar sheyyire mishsham et haaretz velo yitztarech laavor, laze perat et kol hammekomot sheen metziut lirot kol ze merachok im lo yaavor:

rashi: Yom asher amadta. musav al mikra shellemala mimmennu asher rau enecha – yom asher amadta bechorev asher raita hakkolot veet hallappidim:
Yilmedun. yelfun – leatzmam:
Yelammedun. yeallefun – laacherim:
ohc: Veashmiem et devaray vegomer leyira oti kol hayyamim. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kamu.) yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zohamatan, uferashti befarashat yitro sheppesikat zohamatan hayta meemtzaut gevurot divre elohim ad sheyyatzta nishmatam, vezehu hasarat zohama mehem, vehu maamar veashmiem et devaray perush, aseret haddibberot shebbau bigvurot, dichtiv (Shemot 20:1) "vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim". vetaam sheasiti ze leyira oti kol hayyamim beemtzaut hefsek zohamatan mehem, shehu hammonea et haadam milliro et Adonai. veze sibba sheyyisrael lo maru et kevodam vesavlu kamma tzarot yamim rabbim en mispar veal mishmeret yirat Adonai omdim, ki paska zohamatan, veteva nafsham leyira et Adonai, ki chol sheen zohama mavdelet beno leven Adonai, mittivo liro Adonai hannichbad baruch hu.

rashi: Cherpatcha. giddufecha, kemo zot oyev cheref:
targum: Kum elaha netze matzutach idkar kelana deamach min malka tippesha kol yoma:

rashi: Lemor. musav al devar Adonai immachem bahar mittoch haesh, lemor anochi Adonai vegomer veanochi omed ben Adonai uvenechem:
ohc: Anochi vegomer. perush, chelek dibber Adonai immachem panim befanim, vechelek shehu levad measeret haddibberot dibbarti ani bishlichut, vetaam shello dibber Adonai immachem hakkol panim befanim "ki yeretem" vegomer:
Velo alitem bahar lemor. perush, veasar lachem Adonai alot bahar bishvil lemor "anochi Adonai" vegomer:

rashi: Leelef dor. ulehallan (Devarim Adonai) hu omer "laalafim". kan shehu samuch etzel leshomre mitzvotav, hu omer leelef, ulehallan shehu samuch etzel leohavay, hu omer laalafim (sota 31):
Leohavav. ellu haosin meahava:
Uleshomre mitzvotav. ellu haosin miyyira:
ohc: Uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota lo.) shelleosim miyyira leelef dor, uleosim meahava alafim, keamro (Shemot 20:6) "veose chesed laalafim leohavay" vegomer. venire ki lo kefel levad yaggid alafim, ki bevadday sheose meahava en ketz lischar maasav, velaalafim haamur beohavav leshon rabbim yacholnu lomar ad mea elef. vetaam sheamar setam, ki en shiur shave laahava, veyesh ben ohev leohev kifle kiflayim, ella katan shebbaohavim kiflayim kegadol shebbayyereim.

rashi: Bammassa. kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim shennissuhu vammayim, shenneemar hayesh Adonai bekirbenu (Shemot 17):
Et mi noatz vayvinehu. et mi min haovde kochavim umazzalot noatz, kemo shennoatz im hanneviim, kemo shenneemar beavraham "vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham vegomer" (Bereshit 18:17):

Vayvinehu vaylammedehu beorach mishpat. et mi min haovde kochavim umazzalot asa ken, shellimmedo chachma kemo sheasa leavraham, shennatan lev lehakkiro meelav ulehavin battora, shenneemar: "vayyishmor mishmarti" (Bereshit 26:5), veomer "lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer" (Bereshit 18:19), vechilyotav hayu novot chachma, shenneemar: "af lelot yisseruni chilyotay" (tehillim 16:7). (et mi noatz vayvinehu. haish lehakkadosh baruch hu, hen kol goyim lefanav kemar middeli veech yelammedu lo):
targum: Lehon divon min kodamohi asabbar chuchema vealfinun orach dedin vihav livnehon orayta veorach desucheltanu livne venehon hodinun:

rashi: Mi vara elle. kol hatztzava asher tiru bammarom:
Merov onim. sheyyesh lo, veshehu ammitz koach, ish mehatztzava lo nedar shello yikra beshem:
targum: Zekufu leruma enechon vachazu lemidchal kodam man divra ilen deappek beminyan chele shemaya lechulehon beshimhan kare masge gevuran utekof chel chad misidre la mitakkav:

rashi: Nachamu nachamu. chozer al nevuotav haatidot, lefi shemikkan vead sof hassefer divre nechamot, hifsik parasha zo benam leven happuranut. nachamu attem neviay, nachamu et ammi:
targum: Neviyaya itnabbiu tanchumin al ami amar elahachon:

rashi: Kaasher tzivvecha. af al kibbud av vaem nitztauu vemara shenneemar (Shemot 15) sham sam lo chok umishpat (sanhedrin 56):
Vaavadtem sham elohim. ketargumo, mishsheattem ovdim leovdehem keillu attem ovdim lahem:
Nasach. lo "massecha" (Shemot 32:4):
Nasach charash. charash shel barzel noscho mibbarzel o minnechoshet, veachar kach hatztzoref merakkeo betasse zahav umetzappehu milmala:
Uretukot. shalshelaot:
targum: Ha tzilma nagra aved vekenaa bidhav mechappe leh veshalshelan dichsaf kenaa meached leh:

rashi: Vezot hattora. zo shehu atid lesadder achar parasha zo:
Adonai elohim. rachum baddin:

Atta hachillota lehareot et avdecha. petach, lihyot omed umitpallel aappi shennigzera gezera; amar lo mimmecha lamadti, sheamarta li (Shemot 32) "veatta hannicha li", vechi tofes hayiti vecha? ella liftoach petach, shebbi haya taluy lehitpallel alehem, kemo chen hayiti savur laasot achshav (sifre):
Et godlecha. zo middat tuvecha, vechen hu omer (Bamidbar 14) "veatta yigdal na koach Adonai":
Veet yadcha. zo yemincha shehi peshuta lechol bae olam:
Hachazaka. sheatta chovesh berachamim et middat haddin bechazka (sifre):

Asher mi el vegomer. encha dome lemelech basar vadam sheyyesh lo yoatzin vesankattedrin hamammechin beyado kesherotze laasot chesed velaavor al middotav, atta en mi sheyyimche veyadcha im timchol li utevattel gezeratcha; ulefi feshuto atta hachillota lehareot et avdecha milchemet sichon veog, – kedichtiv (Devarim 2) "ree hachilloti tet lefanecha", – hareeni milchemet 31 melachim:
ohc: Adonay elohim. amro adonay, al derech ma sheamar eli (Shmuel 1 3:18) "adonay hu hattov beenav yaase", perush, shehefsed haeved vehatzelachato hi nogaat laadono, vechevan shekken – hattov beenav yaase vadday. vehu amro "adonay", perush, hatzelachati vetovati lecha hu.

Veamro 26 benikkud elohim, Rashi zichrono livracha peresh veze leshono: "adonay elohim" – rachum baddin, ad kan. veraiti laramban shekkatav al devarav veze leshono: velo hishgiach harav ki hashshem harishon katuv beAlef dalet vehashsheni katuv beYod hei vechulei, ad kan. vaani omer shello nitkavven Rashi al shem adnut ella al shem havaya, shehu katuv 26 venakud benikkud elohim, vechach hem divre hammidrash (sifre), veze leshono: 26 rachamim, elohim din, ad kan. perush, hakketiva shehi 26 – rachamim, hakkeria shehi elohim – din, uvaze en kan hassaga.

Vetaam sheamar shem ze shebbo rachamim vedin, lefi ma shepperashti beamro "lemor" shennitkavven bitfillato lomar gam al yisrael, laze amar din verachamim. din – lema shennogea el bittul gezerat moshe, keamram zichronam livracha (tanchuma): mashal lemelech shebbikkesh lissa ishsha, shalach sheluchin lirotah, halchu vechulei, bau veamru lo "en keura mimmenna". shama hashshoshvin, amar lo: "mari, en naa mimmenna baolam". ba lissa otah, amar avi hannaara lishluche hammelech: "nishba ani sheen echad mikkem nichnas kevan shebbizzitem otah". ba shoshvin likkanes, amar lo: "af atta lo tikkanes". amar lo hashshoshvin: "ani lo reitiha, veaf al pi chen amarti lammelech en naa hemenna" vechulei. kach amar moshe lifne Adonai vechulei, ad kan. hare ki betaana chazaka ba lomar sheshshurat haddin notenet ki alo yaale el haaretz, vehu ma shennitkavven bezichron shem elohim. veramaz bichtiva shem harachamim lema shennogea levittul haggezera meal yisrael, kemo shepperashti betevat "lemor", venitchakkem lehazekir shem haddin lefi shebbannigle lo hitpallel ella al atzmo, veramaz shem harachamim bannistar lefi shettefillat yisrael hayta bannistar etzlo bechoach achar sheyyihye naane bishvil atzmo.

Od efshar, ki letzad shebba betaana lizkot kefi haddin, huchrach leshattef middat harachamim, ki mi ze yitztaddek lifne melech olam betoen venitan, uchetiv (tehillim 143:2) "ki lo yitzdak lefanecha kol chay", laze mittek haddin bemiddat harachamim.

Atta hachillota vegomer. tevat "hachillota" pershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre bishlosha derachim: leshon hatechala, uleshon tefilla al derech amro (Malachi 1:9) "challu na fene el", uleshon hattara. veze leshon sifre: "atta hachillota" – atta hittarta nidri beshaa sheamarta li (Shemot 3:10) "hotze et ammi" vegomer, veamarti lecha kevar nishbati leyitro vegomer. davar acher – atta patachta li petach lehitpallel, sheamarta li "heref mimmenni" vegomer, vechi tafus hayiti becha vechulei. uchefi ze mefaresh "hachillota" leshon tefilla. davar acher – hitchalta petach beshaa shennichnasti lenachalot bene gad uvene reuven, ad kan. kashe, bishlama taanat "hitchalta" vegam taanat "atta patachta li lehitpallel" hem divre taam lattefilla, aval taanat petach hahattara ma reaya mevi mimma shehittir lo shevuato leyitro? shane shevuat yitro shehaya lah petach veyeshnah behattara, vehappetach hu shebba elav devar melech shilton lalechet bishlichuto, veen lecha petach gadol mizze. ma sheen ken shevuato yitbarach en tzodek bah petach, shekkol happetachim galuy vetzafuy lefanav vehu maggid mereshit acharit.

Veyitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 6 mehilchot shevuot, veze leshono: mi shennishba velo nicham uva lekayyem shevuato, im rau bet din shehetter shevua zo mikkiyyum mitzva o shalom ben adam lachavero vechulei, bet din nosim venotnim immo ad sheyyitnachem vechulei umattirim lo, ad kan. umashma shehagam sheen petach zo etzlo petach, af al pi chen mitchakkemin alav lehitcharet. vehu ma shennitkavven moshe betaanato lifne Adonai: atta hachillota, shehu hittir lo shevuato keshennishba leyitro, hagam shello haya chafetz lehattir. veharaya – sheshshivat yamim Adonai amar lo (Shemot 3:10) "lecha veeshlachacha el paro", vehu lo haya rotze meeze taam sheyyihye, venasa venatan Adonai immo ad shennitratztza lidvar mitzva vehalach vehittir nidro. uchemo chen yattir Adonai shevuat gezerat moshe, vahagam sheen kan petach, yesh kan devar mitzva lehareoto et haaretz hattova, keamro "ebera na veere" vegomer.

Veim tomar: ma dimyon din shekkatav rambam lishelat moshe, ki din rambam hammattir hu hammekayyem hammitzva velaze mattirin lo, aval ma shellefanenu Adonai nishba uvehattarato moshe hu sheose mitzvat halichat haaretz. laze dikdek moshe bidvarav veamar et avdecha, veyadua ki ma shekkana eved kana rabbo.

rashi: Keroe. asher edro yire, bizroo mekabbetz telaim uvecheko nosam:
Alot yenahel. "minikta beniach medabbar" (targum yonatan), hatztzon hammenikot:
Yenahel. kemo 'menahel:
targum: Keraaya deedre rae bedare machnash imrin uvechene mesovar rakkichin menikata beniach medabbar:

rashi: Uree veenecha. bikkashta mimmenni veere et haaretz hattova, ani mare lecha et kullah shenneemar (Devarim 32) "vayyarehu Adonai et kol haaretz":
ohc: Uree veenecha. hutzrach lomar tevat veenecha, uma gam achar sheamar besamuch sa enecha, nitkavven lomar lo ki ma sheshshaal lirot al yede halichato laaretz keamro ebera veere, yaase lo Adonai nes veyire beemtzaut enav levad belo halicha kol ma sheshshaal lirot achar sheyyaavor, vehu davar sheen en hazzulat tuchal lirot, vehu ma sheddikdek bemaamar enecha bechinnuy.

Od yirtze, lefi sheyyimmatzu chachmot sheyyakrivu harachok al yede davar emtzai shemmesimin oto ben enehem lemul mekomot harchokim vikarvem veyirem keillu hem lefanav, velishlol davar ze amar Adonai elav "uree veenecha" mammash, perush belo emtzaut davar acher.

rashi: Lo tosifu. kegon chamesh parashiyyot battefillin, chameshet minin ballulav, vechamesh tzitziyyot, vechen "lo tigreu" (70 sifre 80 raa):
Shamor. uvarishonot hu omer "zachor", shenehem bedibbur echad uveteva achat neemru, uvishmia achat nishmeu (mechilta):
Kaasher tzivvecha. kodem mattan tora bemara (shabbat 87):
ohc: Shamor et yom vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (rosh hashshana 27.) zachor veshamor bedibbur echad neemru. uledivrehem efshar lomar ki amro kaasher tzivvecha lahairam al shamor shennitztauu gam aleha mippi Adonai yom hammaamad. vehakkavvana beshamor amru zichronam livracha (mechilta pasuk zachor) lishmor milleacharav. veyesh ladaat lamma lo neemra sham shamor im zachor, veulay shennitkavven lehaferidam leval yachshevu shemmaamar shamor hu al zeman shebba alav maamar zachor shehu millefanav al ze hadderech sheyyizkor lishmor hashshabbat, uvema shehifridam heir shehem shete mitzvot, achat bahachenasa veachat bayyetzia, veulay ki leolam lo amar Adonai ella zachor ella sheachat nishmaat mechavertah limvine daat, uchesheamar Adonai zachor nitkavven sheyyizkor bintinat daat alav leval yihye lo shiggayon bo, umimmotza davar atta lamed sheggam al leacharav hu mitzva, vehu ma shepperesh moshe bema sheamar shamor, sheggam hi nichlelet bezachor, veze katavti bederech efshar.

Vayyikra moshe. ulay lefi sheyyarshu kol haaratzot hahem, hayu yisrael mefuzzarim bechol hammekomot hahem, laze hutzrach likrot lechullan. o efshar shead atta haya medabber im haanashim, uchesheratza lomar aseret haddibberot kara gam lannashim vehattaf kemaamad har sinay, keamro "kol yisrael".

rashi: Ketzon tivcha. ketzon shel tabbach:
targum: Arum metuletach itketalna kol yoma itchashavna cheana dimsira lenichsa:

rashi: Ufen tissa enecha. lehistakkel baddavar velatet lev litot acharehem:

Asher chalak Adonai. lehair lahem (Megila 9); davar acher leelohot, lo menaan millitot acharehem ella hechelikam bedivre havelehem letardam min haolam, vechen hu omer (tehillim 36) "ki hechelik elav beenav limtzo avono lisno" (avoda zara 55):
Vetachat ki ahav. vechol ze tachat asher ahav:

Vayyotziacha befanav. keadam hammanhig beno lefanav, shenneemar "vayyissa malach haelohim haholech vegomer vayyelech meacharehem" (sham). davar acher, vayyotziacha befanav – bifne avotav, kema shenneemar "neged avotam asa fele" (Tehillim 78); veal titma al shehizkiram bilshon yachid, shehare chetavam bilshon yachid – vayyivchar bezaro acharav:
Elle haedot, asher dibber. hem hem asher dibber betzetam mimmitzrayim, chazar ushenaah lahem bearvot moav:
Mimmecha mippanecha. sarsehu vedarshehu: lehorish mippanecha goyim gedolim vaatzumim mimmecha:
Kayyom hazze. kaasher atta roe hayyom:
Vezacharta ki eved hayita vegomer. al menat ken pedaacha shettihye lo eved vetishmor mitzvotav:
ohc: Vezacharta vegomer. hem divre moshe, vehakkavvana ki yom hashshabbat yesh bo gam ken heara laadam lizkor yetziat mitzrayim, keshehu shovet belo shibud yargish ki Adonai hu hammeniach leammo mikkol tzarehem veyitten libbo lekabbel gezerot hammotzi meavdut. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (fesachim 117:) mikkan shetztzarich lehazekir bekiddush hayyom yetziat mitzrayim:

Veim tomar lamma hishmit taam hashshabbat sheamar Adonai bedibberot rishonot shehu "ki sheshet yamim" vegomer? taam ze hu taam hammitzva meikara, lo taam hachiyyuv, umoshe amar taam chiyyuv emunat taam hammitzva, al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha uchetavnuhu bemakom acher ki yetziat mitzrayim gilleta emunat beriat haolam (Shemot Rabba 12), vehu ma sherasham beamro vezacharta vegomer vayyotziacha vegomer beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya, vesham raita ki hu adon hakkol, uvaze yitammet lecha taam haamur bedibberot rishonot "ki sheshet yamim" vegomer.

rashi: Ukeshartam leot al yadecha. ellu tefillin shebbazzeroa:
Vehayu letotafot ben enecha. ellu tefillin shebbarosh, veal shem minyan parashiyyotehem nikreu totafot, tat bechatpi shetayim pat beafrike shetayim (sanhedrin 4):
Ki yishalcha vincha machar. yesh machar shehu achar zeman:
Chukkim umishpatim tzaddikim. hagunim umekubbalim:
Meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem. hu haddin larchokim, ella lefi sheatta roe et sevivotecha toim acharehem, hutzrach lehazehir alehem beyoter:
Velo tinaf. en leshon niuf ella veeshet ish:

Velo yasaf. metargeminan "vela pasik" (ulefi shemmiddat basar vadam enan yacholin ledabber kol devrehem binshima achat umiddat hakkabba eno chen — lo haya fosek, umishshello haya fosek lo haya mosif) ki kolo chazak vekayyam leolam (sanhedrin 17); davar acher — velo yasaf lo hosif leheraot beoto pumbi:
ohc: Et haddevarim vegomer. velo amar "kol", ki yesh mehaddevarim haamurim shello dibberam Adonai, kegon maamar "kaasher tzivvecha", gam maamar "vezacharta":

Kol devarim attem shomim. amro kol devarim, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:2) sheamru shekkol dibbur shehaya yotze mippi Adonai haya notzar mimmennu malach, vehaya omed al haadam veomer lo: "atta mekabbeleni" vechulei, vehaya mechabbeko vechulei, ad kan. uchefi ze yitbaer hakkatuv al nachon kol devarim, perush, haddevarim asher dibber Adonai shehayu nivraim mehem malachim, kol otam malachim shennikraim devarim attem shomim. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat yitro shello shamu yisrael mippi haggevura ella "anochi" vegomer velo yihye lecha" vegomer, aval hashshemone dibberot, hagam sheyyatzu keechad yachad aseret haddibberot, lo yachlu lisbol lishmoa ella shetayim, vehashshemone amdu hammalachim shennechtzevu mikkolo yitbarach bahem ad shechazra nishmatam, vechazru veshamum mippi hammalachim shehem haddevarim atzman, vehayta kol mitzva umitzva shehu malach umalach omed al haadam veomer lo: "atta mekabbeleni" vechulei.

Utemuna enchem roim vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lomar al hattemuna zulati kol shehi hashshemia. ulefi ma shekkatavti bappasuk shellifne ze shehammalach shehu haddibbur atzmo haya medabber im kol echad vehayu yisrael roim oto, vechen timtza sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta Shemot 20:15) befasuk "vechol haam roim et hakkolot", umeatta chash moshe sheyyachshevu chas veshalom ki ze hu elohe yisrael asher rau enehem, laze amar utemuna enchem roim zulati kol perush, levad hakkol hu sheheyitem roim temunato shehaya medabber immachem veomer "atta mekabbeleni" vechulei:

rashi: Velo techonnem. lo titten lahem chen, asur lo laadam lomar "kamma nae goy ze". davar acher, lo titten lahem chaniyya baaretz (avoda zara 20):
Al titten lechayyat. ligdude haummot, kemo "vayyeasfu felishtim lachayya" (Shmuel 2 23:11):

Nefesh torecha. tor shellecha. veyonatan tirgem leshon "torim" uvene yona" (Vayikra 1:14). hattor hazze, mishshemmet hazzachar, ben zugah, enah mizdavveget leacher. af yisrael lo hechelifucha beel acher, af al pi sherichakta mehem vehayu kealmana (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:63):
Chayyat aniyyecha. nefesh aniyyecha:
targum: La timsor lefalche mazaraya dimtilin lechevat bara nafshat mealfe oraytach chayehon daaniyach la titneshe lealmin:

rashi: Hayyom laasotam. ulemachar, laolam habba, littol secharam (eruvin 22):

ohc: Min hashshamayim vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv hu, lefi ma shepperashti befarashat yitro befasuk "vaydabber elohim" (Shemot 20:1) vahairoti alav lemala befasuk (Devarim 4:12) "utemuna enchem roim" vegomer yityashshev al nachon, ki aseret haddibberot bau lahem bishte haderagot al ze hadderech: shete dibberot shehem "anochi" velo yihye lecha" higgiu haddevarim leyisrael meAdonai lahem bechoach haddevarim uvetigbartam, uchenegdam amar min hashshamayim hishmiacha et kolo, vehattaam leyasserekka perush, lemarek zohamatcha, ze haya sibba lehaavarat mehem kol zohama kemo shekkatavnu kamma peamim, ushemone dibberot tashlum haasara shamu otam mehaddevarim atzman sheyyatzu mehaadon baruch hu, uchenegdam amar veal haaretz heracha et ishsho hu reiyyat hakkolot shehem lahavot esh shennechtzevu bidvar Adonai, verau otam yisrael dichtiv (Shemot 20:15) "vechol haam roim et hakkolot", uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 4:12) "utemuna" vegomer.

Veamro udevarav shamata mittoch haesh, lidvarenu yavo al nachon, ki hashshemone dibberot shamu otam mittoch haesh haamura, shehu malach esh lohet, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 4:12) "utemuna".

rashi: El kanna. mekanne linkom, aneparemanet belaaz, mitchare al ragzo lehippara meovde aza:
Venashal. leshon hashelacha vehattaza, vechen "venashal habbarzel" (Devarim 19):

Veat tedabber elenu. hittashtem et kochi kannekeva, shennitztaarti alechem verippitem et yadi ki raiti sheenchem charedim lehitkarev elav meahava, vechi lo haya yafe lachem lilmod mippi haggevura velo lilmod mimmenni?:
ohc: Veshamanu veasinu. amro veshamanu, lefi shehem amru lemoshe lehashiv laAdonai al maamar "baavur yishma haam bedabberi immach" (Shemot 19:9) shertzonam lishmoa mippi Adonai velo mippi talmid, laze atta chazru veamru setira ledivrehem harishonim "veshamanu" vegomer, veamro veasinu, kiyyemu vekibbelu hayyehudim laasot kol devarav keillu shamu mippi hashshechina.

rashi: Lo et avotenu bilvad karat Adonai vegomer. ki ittanu vegomer:
ohc: Lo et avotenu karat vegomer. Rashi peresh bilvad, vekashe im laze nitkavven hakkatuv lo haya tzarich lomar, shekkevar amar "karat immanu". ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk "Adonai elohenu" vegomer shechozer labberit shello yashre shechinato al haummot (Shemot 34:10) yitbaer al ze hadderech, lo et avotenu karat habberit kol ikkar, shello matzinu shennishba lehaavot shello yashre shechinato al umma acheret. uchefi ze lo hispik bemaamar "karat immanu" sheyyachol lehitparesh gam immahem veeno lishlol haavot, laze chazar lomar "lo et avotenu", vehakkavvana baze shezzachu yisrael devarim shello huvtechu bahem haavot.

Kullanu chayyim. kashe, vahalo kol otan shekkarat Adonai immahem habberit enam chayyim, shemmetu bammidbar? gam lo kol otam sheimmahem haya medabber hayu az, shehare noldu kamma vechamma belch shana shennitakkevu vammidbar. veyesh leyashshev sheamar al hachelek, ella shehaddavar dachuk. od, ma ba lelammedenu betevat kullanu chayyim? en bah chiddush.

Veulay yesh lomar shennitkavven lomar shekkullam nisharu chayyim, hagam sheddibber Adonai immahem panim befanim vegomer mittoch haesh velo met echad mehem, vehu ma sheamru levassof "mi chol basar asher shama kol elohim chayyim medabber mittoch haesh kamonu vayyechi", uchefi ze maamar "kullanu chayyim" nimshach im ma shelleacharav velo im ma shellefanav.

rashi: Leyamim rishonim. al yamim rishonim:

Ulemiktze hashshamayim. vegam sheal lechol habberuim asher mikkatze el katze, zehu peshuto; umidrasho, melammed al komato shel adam shehayta min haaretz ad hashshamayim, vehu hashshiur atzmo asher mikkatze el katze (sanhedrin 38):
Hanihya kaddavar haggadol hazze. umahu haddavar haggadol, hashshomea im vegomer:

Lo yarpecha. millehachazik becha beyadav, uleshon lo yarpecha leshon lo yafil hu – lo yitten lecha rifyon, lo yafrish otcha meetzlo, vechen "achaztiv velo arpennu" (Shir HaShirim 3) shello ninkad erpennu; kol leshon rifyon musav al leshon mafil umitpael, kemo "harepe lah" (Melachim 2 4) – ten lah rifyon, "heref mimmenni" (Devarim 9) – hitrappe mimmenni:
Vanneshev baggay vegomer. venitzmadtem laaza, veaappi chen veatta yisrael shema el hachukkim, vehakkol machul lecha, vaani lo zachiti limmachel li:
ohc: Vanneshev baggay vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv ma ba lehodia bemaamar ze, uma kesher yesh lo lo im ma shellefanav velo im ma shelleacharav. verabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre yishshevu hakkatuv vehevio Rashi zichrono livracha, uledivrehem zichronam livracha lo nityashshev kavvanat amro vanneshev kevan shello ba ella lehodia maase peor, gam maamar mul bet peor en lah mashmaut im lo ba hakkatuv ella lehazekir avodat peor, haya lo lomar "vattitztzamed levaal peor" (Bamidbar 25:3).

Venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi gemar inyan shehitchil bo bitchillat happarasha "vaetchannan el Adonai" vegomer, vegamar omer shello hoil bitfillato laavor et hayyarden veneshev baggay, en yeshiva ella akkava ad olam. veamro baggay lefi sheeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot dichtiv (Bamidbar 13:17) "alu ze bannegev". veamro bet peor ramaz echad mittaame kevurato sham (pirki derabbi eliezer perek 46) kede sheyyihye mul avon peor leval yarim rosh lekatreg al yisrael:

rashi: Panim befanim. ara verechya: kach amar moshe, al tomru ani mate etchem al lo davar, kederech shehassarsur ose ben hammocher lallokeach, hare hammocher atzmo medabber immachem (Pesikta rabbati):
Mikkur. kur hu cheli shemmezakkekim bo et hazzahav:
Velo titavve. vela terog, af hu leshon chemda, kemo nechmad lemare (Bereshit 2) dimtargeminan dimraggag lemichze:

ohc: Bechol hadderech vegomer lemaan tichyun vetov lachem vehaarachtem vegomer. perush "tichyun" – arichut yamim baolam hazze, veamro vetov lachem – tovat olam habba, veamro vehaarachtem vegomer – shello yiglu yisrael meal haaretz leolam.

Velisvarat rabbi yaakov (kiddushin lat:) sheamar sechar mitzva baolam hazze lekka, nire sheyyode Rabbi yaakov bemi shehu tzaddik gamur veshamar kol hattora sheyyizke gam baolam hazze, velo amar Rabbi yaakov ella beadam sherubbo zechuyyot. vechen timtza sheamru sham bekiddushin keshehiksha meotah barayta sheamra kol mi sherubbo zechuyyot meriin lo vechulei veheemid bashshas kerabbi yaakov.

Umimmenna yesh lanu ladun mimma sheamar kol mi sherubbo zechuyyot, ha lamadta davka mi sheyyesh beyado averot ella sherabbu zechuyyotav hu sheomer alav meriin lo vechulei, aval mi shekkullo zechuyyot yode ki yetiv lo Adonai gam baolam hazze. vehu ma sheomer bechol hadderech asher tzivva vegomer, dikdek lomar bechol lehair shemmedabber bemi sheshshomer hakkol, uleish kaze yeshno baolam habba keamro "lemaan tichyun vetov" vegomer, gam yeshno baolam hazze vehu amro vehaarachtem yamim baaretz asher tirashun, velo amar "vehaarachtem yamim" setam shennefaresh shennitkavven laolam shekkullo aroch.

Noten lecha kol hayyamim. perush, lefi sheamar lahem "lemaan taarich yamim al haadama", chash moshe sheyyomru shehakkavvana hi sheal yede maasehem hu she maarich yemehem al haadama, umimmotza davar atta lamed shehigbil Adonai yeme netinat haaretz kederech shehigbil chayye haadam, dichtiv (Iyov 14:5) "im charutzim yamav", vehivticham lehaarich yemehem kesheyyelchu bederech yashar. laze gamar omer uveer asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha kol hayyamim, perush ki mattenat Adonai hi leolme ad, lo lizman mugebal. umeatta amro ulemaan taarich yamim, perush, shello yamutu vah bekatzrut shanim, al derech amro (Devarim 11:21) "lemaan yirbu yemechem" vegomer. veamro kol hayyamim hi haamadat haaretz beyad yisrael.

rashi: Yevoshu veyibbahalu vegomer. mahu yashuvu yevoshu paam sheniyya? amar rabbi yochanan : leatid lavo hakkadosh baruch hu dan et harshaim umechayyevan laggehinnom, vehem mitraamin alav, vehakkadosh baruch hu machaziran vechozer umare gilyonin shellahem vedan otam umitchayyevin, vehu machaziran laggehinnom. hare busha kefula. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani omer : leatid lavo kol umma kora leloheha veen one, vechozrin vekorin lehakkadosh baruch hu, veomer lahem: illu elay keratem techilla, hayiti one etchem. achshav asitem avodat gillulim ikkar veoti tefela, lefichach eni one, shenneemar "yishveu veen moshia" (tehillim 18:42) – zo avodat gillulim, veachar kach "el Adonai velo anam" (sham). lechach neemar: yashuvu yevoshu:
Raga. bimat zeman:
targum: Yivhatun veyitbahalun lachada kulehon vaale devavi yetuvun yivhaton keshaa:

rashi: Keayin negdo. keayin hem beenav, veen chashuvin lefanav:
targum: Kol ammaya kilma ovadehon gemira veshetzaa inun chashivin kodamohi:

ohc: Veatta yisrael vegomer. ulay shennitkavven keneged shene devarim sheeru lo: echad beinyan hakkaat hassela she amar lo ledabber vehu hikka, vechashav laasot hammitzva bizrizut gadol. 2 beinyan zimri sheshshagag velo nitammetz laasot din kannaim pogim, velo zachar bekiddush hashshem shehizmin Adonai lefanav letakken maase harishon asher lo kiddesh hashshem kemo shepperashnu haddevarim bimkoman, vahagam sheddan lefanav pinchas, heshivo (sanhedrin 82.) karyana deiggarta leheve parvanka, vezacha pinchas baddavar venatal berit hashshalom shehaya muchan lemoshe.

Veefshar ki tamo shel moshe hu lefi sherafu yadav mechizzuk yadayim sheasa barishona, veulay shechash ki lo amar Adonai "kannaim pogim bo" ella im raahu, aval levakkesh acherim lifgoa bo – lo, venishmar veyashav velo asa kederech sheasa bassela shennizdarez lehakkot veyatzta lo takkala, veachar haemet shagag baze. velaze ba lehazehiram laam bene yisrael im shene haddevarim shebbahem shagag venimna mealot el har Adonai tzevaot ir az lanu vanneshev baggay mul vegomer, veamar lahem veatta yisrael shema el hachukkim shehem hammitzvot shehem chukkim, veze dimyon maase hassela sheamar lo Adonai dabber lassela shebbo nichva, vedavar ze yityaches elav chukka. veamro veel hammishpatim keneged hammishpatim sheheerich Adonai betorato shehem dimyon mishpat boel arammit shekkannaim pogim bo sheshshagag bo moshe, umeemtzaut shenehem nigzera alav gezera kannizkar.

Vegamar omer lemaan tichyu uvatem virishtem et haaretz, velo yikre lachem kaasher kara li sheenenni over et hayyarden. vegamar omer lo tosifu lehazehiram shello yeera lahem kederech sheera lo, al derech ma sheamru babbarayta (torat kohanim resh parashat achare mot) haya rabbi eliezer moshlo lerofe shennichnas etzel chole vechulei, veechad amar lo al tochal tzonen veal tishkav vechulei shello tamut kederech shemmet peloni, ze zerzo yoter min harishon, ad kan. kemo chen bema shellefanenu nitkavven moshe lezarez shello yeera lahem kemo sheera lo al ma shehosif lehakkot hassela. veamar lo tosifu, perush, ma sheani omer lachem "shema el hachukkim vegomer lemaan tichyu uvatem" – tenay hu haddavar shello tosifu vegomer, sheim yosifu kederech sheasa hu bemaase hassela – lo yavou vegomer kederech shennigzera alav gezera bishvil ze.

Veamro velo tigreu vegomer lishmor, perush, bevo leyadam devar mishpat shezzachar bitchillat devarav "veel hammishpatim", lo yigreu mimmennu kederech sheasa hu beinyan zimri, shennishmar millevakkesh lifgoa bo vegara hammishpat, vehu amro velo tigreu, hagam shettihye kavvanatchem lishmor, perush, shehaggeraon yihye bo tzad hashshemira lehishshamer leval yaharog boel haarammit.

rashi: Lo merubbechem. kifshuto; umidrasho lefi sheen attem magdilim atzmechem kesheani mashpia lachem tova, lefichach chashak … bachem

Ki attem hameat – hamemaatin atzmechem, kegon avraham sheamar (Bereshit 18) "veanochi afar vaefer", uchegon moshe veaharon sheamru (Shemot 16) "venachnu ma", lo chinvuchadnetztzar sheamar (Yeshayahu 14) "eddamme leelyon", vesancheriv (sham 36) sheamar "mi bechol elohe haaratzot", vechiram sheamar (18 28) "el ani moshav elohim yashavti" (chullin 89):
Ki attem hameat. hare ki meshammesh bilshon deha:
ohc: Ki attem hameat. lo hispik maamar "lo merubbechem", sheaz yeshno benishma sheenam merubbim ella shavim, talmud lomar "attem hameat".

rashi: Mi madad vegomer. kol ze haya bo koach laasot, vechol shekken sheyyesh bo koach lishmor havetachot hallalu:

Beshoolo. bahalichato, shenneemar "darachta veyam susecha" (Chavakuk 3:15). beshoolo kemo "bemishol hakkeramim" (Bamidbar 22:24) – shevil. davar acher: 'shaal shem keli hu, vechen "beshaale seorim" (Yechezkel 13:19):
Tikken. 288 109, leshon midda uminyan, kemo "vetochen levenim tittenu" (Shemot 5:18):

Vechol bashshalish. umadad bishlishiyyot: shelish midbar, shelish yishshuv, shelish yammim uneharot. lashon acher: bashshalish miggudal vead amma, shelishi laetzbaot. umenachem peresh shehu shem keli, vechen "vattashkemo bidmaot shalish" (tehillim 80:6):
Veshakal bappeles harim. hakkol lefi haaretz: har kaved taka beeretz kasha, vehakkallim beeretz rakka:
targum: Man amar ilen kayam amar vaaved dechol me alma chashivin kodamohi ketippa vishola umishchat shemaya keilu bezerta metaknin veafra deara keilu bimchila itkal veturaya keilu matkal takilin veramata kad bemoznaya:

rashi: Uvishmo tishshavea. im yesh becha kol hammiddot hallalu, sheatta yare et shemo veoved oto, az bishmo tishshavea, shemmittoch sheatta yare et shemo tehe zahir bishvuatcha, veim lav — lo tishshavea:

Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. Adonai shehu elohenu atta, velo elohe haummot, hu atid lihyot Adonai echad, shenneemar (Tzefanya 3) ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai, veneemar (Zecharya 14) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad (70 sifre):
ohc: Shema yisrael Adonai elohenu vegomer. taam kefel Adonai shete peamim velo hispik lomar al ze hadderech "Adonai elohenu echad", nitkavven lishte haderagot sheyyesh laAdonai, haachat shehu elohenu, vehashsheniyya shehu echad. vehakkavvana baze ki anu mekabbelin elohuto yitbarach alenu lema shemmimmennu, hagam sheillu haya bammetziut shehayu elohot harebe en anu bocharim ella beshem ze 26 hu elohenu, uvaze nichlal kamma peratim: 1 ahavat hattov, ahavat hammoil, ahavat hearev. veod lo shehu echad veen zulato eloah baolam, vetaam ze gam ken yaspik lehitchayyev lehishtabed lo ulemitzvotav, hagam shehaya bammetziut shello hayu hatteamim shemmitztziddam becharnuhu leeloah.

Nimtzenu omrim shebbeechad mishshene hatteamim yaspik lehishtabed lemaamarav ulemitzvotav, asher al ken amar Adonai elohenu Adonai echad bishte chalukkot shekkol echad keday leatzmo. veim haya omer hakkatuv "Adonai elohenu echad" haya benishma ki ma shehem mekabbelin elohuto alehem hu leheyoto echad veen od millevaddo, yitchayyev haeved laavod et rabbo veen manos mimmennu lirtzono veshello lirtzono, velo chen anu im elohenu, sheanu chafetzim beelohuto ahavat hattov bema shehu tov nosaf al heyoto echad umeyuchad:

rashi: Vetzav et yehoshua. al hatterachot veal hammassaot veal hammerivot:
Vechazzekehu veammetzehu. bidvarecha, shello yerach libbo lomar keshem shenneenash rabbi alehem, kach sofi leanesh alehem, mavticho ani ki hu yaavor vehu yanchil (70 sifre):

Ki hu yaavor. im yaavor lifnehem yinchalu, veim lav lo yinchalu; vechen atta motze kesheshshalach min haam el haay vehu yashav, "vayyakku mehem anshe haay vegomer" (yehoshua 7) vechevan shennafal al panav amar lo "kum lach" – kam lecha ketiv, atta hu haomed bimkomcha umeshalleach et banay lammilchama, lamma ze atta nofel al panecha? lo chach amarti lemoshe rabbecha im hu over ovrin veim lav en ovrin (sifre):
ohc: Vetzav et yehoshua. tzarich ladaat ma hi mitzva zo, uvesifre amru (pinchas 136) veze leshono: tzivvahu al haggivonim, davar acher tzivvahu al hammerivot vechulei ad kan. veen ze meforash bakkatuv, zulat im nomar shehem divre kabbala. veefshar lomar bifshat hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru en tzav ella malchut, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 13:14) "vaytzavvehu Adonai lenagid" vegomer, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat (Shemot 6:13) "vaytzavvem el bene yisrael" vegomer. kemo chen ba maamar Adonai kan lemoshe shebbechayyav yimloch yehoshua al yisrael vichazzekehu bemalchuto leene kol yisrael.

rashi: Al panay. bechol makom asher ani sham, vezehu kol haolam. davar acher — kol zeman sheani kayyam. aseret haddibberot kevar perashtim:
Ki mala tzevaah. tirgem yonatan: "atida detitmeli meam galuvtaha", kemo "ki mala mitztzevaah". veyesh potrin tzevaah kemo (Iyov 7:1) "halo tzava leenosh ale aretz":
Nirtza. nitpayyes:

Ki lakcha vegomer. "are kabbilat kas tanchumin min kodam Adonai keillu lakat al chad teren bechol chattataha". ulefi feshuto yittachen lefaresh ki lakcha pureanut kiflayim, veim tomar heach middato shel hakkadosh baruch hu leshallem leadam kiflayim becheto, matzinu mikra male (Yirmeyahu 16:18) "veshillamti rishona mishne avonam vechattatam":
targum: Malilu al libba dirushelem veitnabbu alah are atida detitmele meam galvataha are ishteviku lah chovaha are kabbilat kas tanchumin min kodam Adonai keilu lakat al chad teren bechol chatataha:

rashi: Ki yasir et bincha meacharay. beno shel goy kesheyyissa et bittecha yasir et bincha asher teled lo vittecha meacharay, limmedanu shebben bittecha habba min haggoy karuy bincha, aval ben bincha habba min haggoya eno karuy bincha ella benah, shehare lo neemar al bitto lo tikkach ki tasir et bincha meacharay:
Halo tedu. mosdot haaretz mi yesadah, veoto haya lachem laavod:
targum: Hala yedatun hala shematun hala itchavaa min avla ovad sidre vereshit lechon hala tistakkelun lemidchal kodam min divra yesode ara:
