rashi: Mevasseret tziyyon. "neviyyay dimvasserin letziyyon", uvemakom acher hu omer: "ragle mevasser" (Yeshayahu 52:7), zachu – kal kezachar, lo zachu – tash kinkeva, umeacher peamav ad hakketz:
targum: Al tur ram saku lechon neviyaya di mevasrin letzion arimu vechela kalchon di mevasrin lirushelem arimu la tidchalun amaru lekirvaya devet yehuda itgeliat malchuta deelahachon:

rashi: Meal shamayim. vechatuv echad omer ad shamayim (tehillim 57:11)? pershu rabbotenu (fesachim 50:): kan beosin lishmah, kan beosin shello lishmah:
targum: Arum rav meilave shemaya tuvach vead shachke mate kushetach:

rashi: Ki dikkitanu bimkom tannim. ki ze meshammesh bilshon kaasher: veaf kaasher hishpaltanu beeretz arava veshucha (Yirmeyahu 2:6), midbar mekom tannim, vechissita alenu vetzalmavet choshech, af bechol zot im shachachnu shem elohenu, hu yachakor zot, ki hu yodea taalumot vegomer:
targum: Arom amachtana baatar yerudin vachafita alana vetula demota:

rashi: Bechazak yavo. al haummot lippara:
Hinne secharo itto. mezumman itto latztzaddikim:
Ufeullato. sechar peulla shealav litten lahem:
targum: Ha Adonai elohim bitkof mitgele utekof dera gevurete shalta kodamohi ha agar avde memre ime dechol ovadehon gelan kodamohi:

ohc: Leyira oti velishmor vegomer. taam shello samach lichlol hashshemira bichlal maamar leyira, ulay ki lefi shemmitztzad hayyira yatza perat echad ra, shezze haya sibba sheasu yisrael et haegel kesherau ki voshesh moshe nafal alehem emata vafachad, kevan sheen moshe sheyyihye shaliach ledabber immahem, yashuv Adonai ledabber immahem kevarishona. laze miharu laasot haegel lechashvam sheyyihye leemtzai vidabber alehem et divre Adonai. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma, ki tissa) shehaegel haya medabber mammash vetau bo leemtzai. laze dikdek Adonai bemaamaro veamar leyira oti velishmor mitzvotay, shettihye hayyira lahem gam ken lishmor velo yishgu bahem mitztzad hayyare Adonai.
Lemaan yitav vegomer. perush, ki amro "mi yitten" vegomer lo letzad hammoil leamro, ella leahavat hattov lehanneemar alav.

Hetivu kol asher dibberu. perush, shekkibbelu al atzmam laasot divre hannavi ulehatzdiko, veal ze gamar omer "mi yitten vehaya" vegomer. veamru zichronam livracha (avoda zara 5.) sheshshagag moshe shello amar lo "ten atta", sheillu haya omer ken lo hayu mehareharin achar moshe, lo beshilluach meraggelim velo bemachloket korach.

rashi: Asher beever hayyarden. shehu bammizrach, shehaever hashsheni haya bammaarav:
Mi tikken. et ruach hakkodesh befi hanneviim? Adonai tikkeno, vechday hu leheamen:
Veish atzato yodiennu. rucho, ken tirgem yonatan. ulefi mashmao: veish atzato musav lerosh hammikra mi tikken et rucho, umi ish atzato asher yodiennu lehakkadosh baruch hu etza?
targum: Man takin yat ruach kudesha befum kol neviyaya hala Adonai vetzadikaya avde memre pitgame reute hodinun:

rashi: Vaaneni. shekkol ammecha vididecha teluyin bi:
targum: Min biglal deyishtezvun rechimach perok yeminach vaane yati:

rashi: Kol ruach hakkodesh kore bammidbar:
Pannu derech Adonai. derech yerushalayim, lashuv geliyyoteha letochah:
targum: Kal demachle bemadbera panu orach min kodam ama dayya kevisha bemeshra kivshin kodam kenishta deelahana:

rashi: Samel. tzura:

targum: Armalta vegiora yiktelun veyatme yeratzchun:
Hala elaha yevashkar da arum hu chakkim temire libba:
Amach Adonai yeshufun veachsantach yemaskenun:
Shemia kodam Adonai bauti Adonai tzeloti yekabbel:
In ashlina shum elahana upparisna bitzlo yedana lituta defalche kochvaya:
Uleman tedamun kodamay uteshavon yemar kadisha:
Dimsar shiltonin lechulesha dayane ara kilma aved:
Itnatal dayan ara ativ gumela visha al gevtanaya:
Metul delet bemota dachranach bishol man yode lach:
Mit rashiaya avadu eshtonohi uppitgama deelahana kayam lealmin:
Ode kodamach beamaya Adonai vaashabbechinach beumaya:
Zuru mini kol avde shekar arum shemia kodam Adonai kal bachuti:
Uleman attun medamin kodam el uma demut attun mesadrin kodamohi:
Itromem ilave shemaya elohim veal kol yatve ara aykarach:
Ad ematay rashiaya Adonai ad ematay rashiaya yetvun beshalvata:
Veyitgele yekara dayya veyechezun kol bene visra kachada are vememra dayya gezar ken:

bart: Hameharher ballayla. veroe shebba al haishsha, ucheshenneor mishshenato matza vesaro cham velo matza tippat keri:
Tame. devadday raa keri ella shenneevad bemiuto vabbeged:

Happoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi tehora. kegon sheshshimmesha vachamishi veshabbat, ufalta veshabbat, lo shena shimmesha vitchillat lel chamishi deishtahe hazzera bemeeha arba onot shelemot lel chamishi veyom chamishi lel shishshi veshishshi, lo shena shimmesha chamishi im chashecha, delo ishtahe ella miktzat chamishi velel shishshi veshishshi, delo ikka ella shete onot shelemot. shehaona hi o yom o layla:

Rabbi yishmael omer. ba lachalok velomar defoletet bashshelishi leshimmushah temea, aval poletet barvii, tehora. mihu mode hu demiktzat hayyom kechullo, delo hikpida tora ella veminyan hayyamim velo veminyan haonot:
Ufeamim shehen arba onot shelemot. kegon im shimmesha velel (revii) [chamishi] im chashecha, pelitatah temea ad techillat lel shabbat:
Ufeamim shehem chamesh onot. kegon im shimmesha vitchillat yom revii baalot hashshachar, ufelitatah temea ad lel shabbat:
Peamim shehen shesh. kegon sheshshimmesha vitchillat lel revii vehi temea ad techillat lel shabbat, nimtzeu shesh onot shelemot:

Rabbi akiva omer leolam chamesh. onot. veim yatza miktzat ona rishona, notnim lah miktzat ona shishshit lehashelim chamesh onot, dechol happoletet betoch chamesh onot shelemot, temea. vahalacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya:
Ben hashshemashot. beerev shabbat bereshit kodem shennishlema habberia:
Pi haaretz. livloa korach vaadato:
Ufi habbeer. beerah shel miryam shehayta holechet im yisrael bammidbar bechol hammassaot. veyesh omrim, sheppatcha piha veamra shira, shenneemar (Bamidbar 21) ali veer enu lah:
Pi haaton. ben hashshemashot nigzar aleha shettedabber im bilam:
Vehakkeshet. leot berit shello yihye od mabbul:
Vehamman. sheyyarad leyisrael arbaim shana bammidbar:
Vehammatte. shennaasu bo haotot. veshel senappirinon haya:
Vehashshamir. kemin tolaat, beriyyato kisora, keshehayu marim oto al haavanim harshumot baddeyo, hen nivkaot mealehen. uvo pittechu avne haefod vehachoshen, dichtiv behu bemiluotam:
Hakketav. tzurat haotiyyot shehayu chakukim balluchot:
Vehammichtav. shehayu nikraim mikkol haarbaa tzedadim:

Vehalluchot. shel senappirinon hayu, arkan shishsha, verachban shishsha, veavyan shelosha. keeven achat shearkah verachbah veavyah shavin, venechleka lishtayim. veniglalim hayu, vachatzuvim miggalgal chamma:

Af hammazzikin. ellu hashshedim. shelleachar shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu adam vechavva haya mitassek bivriatan, ucheshebbara ruchotehen lo hispik livro gufehen ad shekkiddash hayyom, venisharu ruchot belo guf:
Veelo shel avraham avinu. nigzar alav ben hashshemashot sheyyihye neechaz bassevach bekarnav bishat haakeda:

Af tzevat bitzvat asuya. targum melkacheha tzivyataha. hatztzevat enah naaset ella bitzvat acheret, verishona mi asaah, al karchacha meeleha naaset bide shamayim, venivret ben hashshemashot. veze nidcha baggemara beferek makom shennahagu (fesachim daf ned), veamru, efshar shehatztzevat harishona naaset bidfus, shehittichu hannechoshet baesh vehitztzikuhu betoch haddefus venaaset hatztzevat miyyad:

Terisin. mochre vesamim yesh lahen chanuyyot haasuyot kemin tevot, veomdot bashshuk, veenan mechubbarot lakkarka. uterisin hen delatot shessogrin bahen pitche otan tevot, ufeamim shemmesallekim otan terisin mippetach hatteva veshotchin alehen hassammemanin shebbachanut:

Mattirin af lehachazir. bitrisin sheen lahem tzir kelal kulle alma lo felige dishri afillu linol bahen petach [bayit shebbetoch] hechatzer. uvitrisin sheyyesh lahen tzir min hatztzad kulle alma lo felige deasur linol bahen afillu pitche chanuyyot, dedame levinyan. ki felige bitrisin sheyyesh lahen tzir baemtza keen belita vetochavin otah bechor shebbeemtza dofen petach hachanut, bet shammay savre gazrinan tzir baemtza attu tzir min hatztzad, uvet hillel savre lo gazrinan bitrise chanuyyot, veshare lehachazir, mishshum devae laafoke tavlin, vei lo sharet leh leahadore lo patach, veate leimmenue missimchat yom tov:
Haeli. yad shel etz gadol harebe veagol shekkotshim bo et harifot vedomehen. umippene kavdo vegadlo en torat keli alav:
Lekatztzev. lachatoch:
Uvet hillel mattirin. mishshum simchat yom tov, veaf al pi sheen alav torat keli:
Lifne vet hadderisa. sheyyidresu alav bene adam, kede shello yafsid:
Velo yagbihennu. letaltelo leachar hafeshatato:
Uvet hillel mattirin. dei lo sharet leh lo shachet kede shello lehafesid haor, umimna missimchat yom tov:
Lo et hakkatan. velo kol mide delav tzorech achila:

Uvet hillel mattirin. deamre mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech achila, huttera nammi shello letzorech achila. vehu sheyyihye bah tzorech mitzva kegon hane dachashive bematnitin, o tzorech hanaa, kegon mippetach beto vechayyotze bahen. laafoke hotzaat avanim vechayyotze baze, divha modu bet hillel deasur:
Shammay omer kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. mishshum derabbi eliezer omer arba nashim dayyan sheatan, tane nammi shammay omer kol hannashim, laafoke midderabbi eliezer:

Dayyan sheatan. nashim haroot dam dayyan sheatan letamme tohorot shennagu bahen mishsheat reiyyatan vaelach, velo amrinan mikkamme hachi nammi haya dam vechatle bet harechem heemiduhu vehayta temea mikkodem. dechol hannashim metammeot babbayit hachitzon veaf al pi shello yatza haddam lachutz, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) dam yihye zovah bivsarah, af al pi shehu babbasar velo yatza lachutz, temea. vetaama deshammay delo chayesh dilma mikkamme hachi hava dam, sheim atta omer ken, libbo shel adam nokfo tamid bishat bia uforesh meishto venimtzeta mevattel benot yisrael mipperiyya ureviyya:

Mippekida lifkida. badka hayyom umatza tehora, uvadka lesof shavua umatza temea, choshshin lemaggaah mibbedika rishona vaelach, shemma im silluk yadeha raata vechatle bet harechem heemiduhu. ulevittul periyya ureviyya lo chayshinan, dedavka letohorot hu dimtamminan lehu mippekida lifkida, velo levalah. veshammay omer, letohorot nammi lo metamminan, deim ken libbo nokfo uforesh nammi mittashmish:
Lo chedivre ze. shammay demekel tefe veeno ose seyag lidvarav:
Velo chedivre ze. hillel demachmir yoter midday. devadday kulle hay yamim rabbim lo mokmi katle bet harechem dam:

Meet leet memaet al yad mippekida lifkida. shene zemannim huzkeru beishsha letamme tohorot lemafrea, vehallech achar hakkal shebbishnehen. im mippekida lifkida yoter al meet leet, hallech achar meet leet velo tetamme ella tohorot shennaga meetmol bashshaa hazzot. veim meet leet yoter al mippekida lifkida, kegon shebbadka atzmah shacharit umatza tehora vearvit matza temea, lo metammeinan ella hanach tohorot demibbedikat shacharit vaelach. vetaamayhu derabbanan, lefi shechachamim tikkenu livnot yisrael sheyyihyu bodkot shacharit vearvit, shacharit lehacheshir tohorot shel layla, vearvit lehacheshir tohorot shel yom. veim badka shacharit umatza tehora, arvit umatza temea, hifsida tohorot shel yom, vezo sheyyashva yamim rabbim velo badka ketakkanat chachamim, hifsida ona achat yetera, mishshum kenas. uchede lehashevot middotehem shel chachamim shello tachalok ben hecha devadka shacharit lehecha devadka batzohorayim, lo ratzu lechallek ulemaet ulehosif bazzeman, venatnu zeman kavua meet leet, shello litten divrehem leshiurin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Al yad. achar. kemo veal yado hechezik, shehu kemo veacharav, besefer ezra [nechemya 3]:
Veset. kavua, shennikba lah zeman haorach shalosh peamim uvadka bishat vestah umatza temea:
Dayyah sheatah. velo chayshinan dilma mikkamme hachi hava, devadday orach bizmanno ba:
Vehameshammeshet beiddim. shebbadka atzmah beiddim, dehaynu besadin, kodem tashmish uleachar tashmish:

Hare zo chifkida. baggemara moke lematnitin detarte katane vehachi kaamar, umeshammeshet beiddim kelomar mitzva al ishsha shetteshammesh bishne iddim, echad lifne tashmish veechad leachar tashmish. vahare zo kifkida, haed shel achar tashmish hare hu kifkida. umemaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida, demahu detema shemma tire tippat dam kechardal utechappenna shichvat zera velo leheve kifkida, kamashma lan. veim shimmesha batzohorayim beiddim, uvadka achare chen baerev umatza temea, lo metammeinan tohorot demibbedikat shacharit ad tashmish, shehare bishat tashmish badka umatza tehora. veaf al gav divdika shekkodem tashmish la chashiva bedika mealleyata, shemmittoch shehi behula leshammesh enah machneset haed lachorim velassedakin, bedika baed shelachar tashmish bedika mealleyata hi vachashiva kifkida kedaamaran:
Mishshum shelosha chelim. sheim perash echad mehen enan shivre kelim, ella kol echad mehem chashuv keli bifne atzmo vetame, af al pi shebbeodan barechayim hen mechubbarim venirim kichli echad:
Mishshum keli kibbul. hattachtona shemmekabbelet avak shechikat happilpelim derech nikve hakkevara, temea mishshum keli kibbul, shekkeli etz sheyyesh lo bet kibbul hu:

Umishshum keli mattachot. haelyona shekkotshin vetochanin bah happilpelin, temea mishshum keli mattechet, demishshum keli etz lekka litmuya, difshutehen tehorin, ella mishshum tzippuyah hattachton shehu shel mattechet:

Umishshum keli chevara. emtzait shehi makkefet et hakkevara. mishshum keli etz lo metammea, deen kibbulah kibbul, ella chachamim gazru tuma al hakkevara mishshum keli arug. vaafillu en hakkevara shel mattechet, metammea mishshum keli kevara:

Beemure hargalim. bamme sheamur regalim, kelomar bakkarbanot haamurim baregel, hayu kol hammishmarot shavot, kegon chaze veshok shel shalme chagiga shel kol yachid veyachid, veorot shel olat reiyya veshel musefe tzibbur veshel seire chattaot:
Uvechilluk lechem happanim. kesheera shabbat baregel. shebbeshabbat mesallekin oto umesadderin acher, kedichtiv (Vayikra 24) beyom hashshabbat yaarchennu:

Uvaatzeret. kesheera beshabbat, veyesh bo chilluk chametz shel shete hallechem vechilluk lechem happanim shehi matztza, omrim lo lechol echad keshennotnim lo chelko belechem happanim helach matztza, ucheshennotnim lo chelko bishte hallechem omrim lo helach chametz. lefi sheen cholkim karban keneged karban, ella mikkol karban kol echad notel chelko, kidnafka lan millechol bene aharon tihye ish keachiv (sham 7), lefichach modiin oto shennotnim lo chelko ben bechametz ben bematztza:
Mishmar shezzemanno kavua. leshammesh beshabbat zo shechal haregel lihyot betochah:
Makriv temidin. shehare enan bishvil haregel:
Nedarim unedavot. shennadru venadvu kol hashshana vehevium baregel:

Vechol karbenot tzibbur. laatoye par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avodat kochavim sheshshaggu bet din vetau behoraa veasu rov hakkahal al pihem. veim era ken baregel, mishmar shezzemanno kavua makrivin oto:

Makriv et hakkol. laatoye kayitz hammizbeach, keshehu batel shekkalta hakeravat hattamid veen meviin sham neder o nedava, lokchin mimmeot hammotarot mishsheyare hallishka vekonin mehen karbenot olot umakrivin otan, vehen nidvat tzibbur. veaf ellu im karvu baregel, mishmar shezzemanno kavua makriv otan:

Ben millefaneha ben milleachareha. im chal yom tov leachar hashshabbat, af al gav delo hava leh shabbat betoch hechag, afillu hachi hoil utzerichin lehakedim biatan meerev shabbat bishvil yom tov, shehare beshabbat lo yuchelu lavo, cholkim belechem happanim. vechen im chal shemini lefaneha beerev shabbat, af al pi sheen hashshabbat betoch hechag, cholkim, hoil velo yuchelu lalechet:

Kol ahava shehi teluya vedavar batel. sheeno mitkayyem, kesheyyitbattel haddavar shehaya sibba leotah ahava, gam haahava betela. vechol ahava sheenah teluya bedavar batel ella bedavar kayyam, kegon ahavat hatztzaddikim vehachachamim, enah betela leolam. keshem shehaddavar shehu sibba leotah ahava enah batel, kach en haahava betela:
Ahavat amnon vetamar. mippene yafyah:
Ahavat david veyonatan. lehashelim retzon konam. deamar lo yehonatan ledavid atta tihye lemelech al yisrael vaani eheye lecha lemishne:
En molichin challa. beyom tov. af al pi shemmuttar behaferashatah lo sharu leh beholachatah, ella tikkun issato hittiru lo velo yoter:
Mattanot. hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva:
Gezera shava. lav davka, dechullah midderabbanan gazru mishshum gezera deen magbihin terumot umaasrot beyom tov. ella dumeya digzera shava:
Mattana lakkohen. meesrim vearba mattenot kehuna:

Keshem sheen molichin et hatteruma vechulei. hach matnitin iddachya la baggemara, delo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel shemmolichin challa umattanot. lo nechleku ella beholachat teruma, shebbet shammay omrim en molichin, uvet hillel omrim molichin. amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay, challa umattanot mattana lakkohen, uteruma mattana lakkohen, keshem shemmolichin et hammattanot kach molichin et hatteruma. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im amartem bechalla umattanot shezzakkay baharamatan, shennatnu chachamim koach ureshut behaferashatan, lefi shehachiyyuv shellahen ba beyom tov delashin veshochatin beyom tov, vechevan shehutteru otan shel yom tov sharinan lehu leholich afillu otan shennaasu meerev yom tov, tomru bitruma sheeno zakkay baharamatah, shehare i efshar sheyyavo chiyyuv teruma lakkeri beyom tov, lefi sheen chiyyuv teruma ella mishsheat mericha bichri, veen memarchin beyom tov, hilkach en molichin teruma beyom tov:
Vehattaava. hamevakkesh lemalot taavato baachila ushetiyya uveila vechayyotze bahen:
Vehakkavod. sheyyechabbeduhu bene adam:
Lo yachem adam chammin leraglav. ochel nefesh hittira hattora, velo lehaveir ur bishvil rechitza:

Uvet hillel mattirin. demittoch shehuttera haveara letzorech achila, huttera nammi shello letzorech achila kesheyyesh bah tzorech ezo hanaa. ufesak halacha, dechammin shehuchemu beyom tov rochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav, aval lo kol gufo, degazru yom tov attu shabbat. vechammin shehuchemu meerev yom tov rochetz bahen kol gufo beyom tov:
Heve gole limkom tora. im en talmide chachamim bimkomcha:
Veal tomar shehi tavo acharecha. talmide chachamim yavou lechan:

Shechaverecha yekayyemuha veyadecha. veal tismoch shechaverecha kesheyyavou mibbet harav yekayyemu hattora beyadcha, shettilmod mehem ma shellamdu hem min harav. ella heve gole atta veatzmecha limkom harav, sheeno dome shomea mippi talmid leshomea mippi harav. perush acher, shechaverecha yekayyemuha beyadecha, mippene ma ani omer lecha heve gole limkom tora, shechaverecha yekayyemuha beyadecha, sheafillu atta charif umefulpal beyoter lo titkayyem hattora becha ella al yede chaverecha shettissa vetitten immahem, vehayenu dimsayyem veel binatcha al tishshaen:
Af al pi sheamru. ishsha sheyyesh lah veset dayyah shatah:
Tzericha lihyot bodeket. bechol yom shacharit vearvit kishar nashim:
Chutz min hannidda. mishsheraata yom echad, temea shiva, veenah tzericha bedika kol shiva, shehare belo reiyya hi temea kol shiva:
Vehayyoshevet al dam tohar. delamma lah bedika, afillu tire, dam tohar hu:

Umeshammeshet beiddim. af al pi sheyyesh lah veset, tzericha livdok lifne tashmish uleachar tashmish. vedavka keshehi asuka betohorot, demiggo devaaya bedika letohorot, baya nammi bedika levalah. aval ishsha sheenah asuka betohorot, levalah lo baya bedika:

Uvetula sheddameha tehorim. arba lelot levet shammay, ulevet hillel ad shettichye hammakka shel beila, vehi enah tzericha leshammesh beiddim, shehare damah tahor, vaafillu nishtannu marit dameha, hoil veshimmesha, demishshum tashmish nishtanna. aval shacharit vearvit, tzericha bedika hecha delo shimmesha achar beila rishona, shemma nishtannu mare damim shellah mimmare dam beila rishona. veim nishtannu mare damim shellah, temea, sheraglayim laddavar sheen ze dam betulim:

Shacharit uven hashshemashot. shacharit lehacheshir tohorot shel layla, sheim timtza tehora teda shello raata ballayla, velichshettimtza arvit temea yatzu ellu missafek. vechen ben hashshemashot lehacheshir tohorot shennitasseka bahen bayyom:
Uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah. shemmechina atzmah leshammesh im balah:

Rabbi yehuda omer af bishat avaratan milleechol batteruma. af leachar sheachlu batteruma, tzerichot livdok atzman, letakken sheyare terumot shebbifnim. sheim timtza achshav tehora, keshettivdok arvit kemishpatah vetimtza temea, lo yihye sheyare hatteruma bichlal tuma lemafrea, shehare badka leachar haavaratah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Lehodia kamma erech appayim lefanav. af atta al titma sheheerich leummot haolam kol hashshanim hallalu shehen mishtaabbedin bevanav, sheyyoter heerich laddorot shemmeadam vead noach, veachar kach nishtefu:

Vekibbel alav sechar kullam. asa maasim tovim keneged ma shehaya rauy sheyyaasu kullam, lefichach nitztzolu kullam bizchuto. uchemo shennatal alav ol mitzvot baolam hazze keneged kullam kach kibbel baolam habba sachar keneged kullam, shekkol adam yesh lo shene chalakim, echad began eden veechad baggehinom, zacha notel chelko vechelek chavero began eden, nitchayyev, notel chelko vechelek chavero baggehinom (chagiga 15:):
Asara nissim naasu laavotenu bemitzrayim. shennitztzolu meeser makkot. vechullam hayu bammitzriyyim velo beyisrael:

Vaasara al hayyam. echad, vayyibbaku hammayim. sheni, shennaasa hayyam kemin ohel venichnesu yisrael letocho, dichtiv (Chavakuk 3) nakavta vemattav rosh perazav. shelishi, shennaasa karkait hayyam yavesh belo chomer vetit, dichtiv (Shemot 14) uvene yisrael halchu vayyabbasha. revii, shekkarkait hayyam sheddarchu bo hammitzriyyim shehayu rodfim achare yisrael nitchalchel venaasa chomer vetit, dichtiv (Chavakuk 3) chomer mayim rabbim. chamishi, shehammayim hannikpaim bekarka hayyam lo hayu chaticha achat ella chatichot ketannot, keen levenim veavne habbinyan mesuddarim ze etzel ze, kedichtiv (tehillim ad) atta forarta veazzecha yam, shennaasa keen perurim. shishshi, shennitkashshu hammayim hannikpaim venaasu kashim kislaim, kedichtiv (sham) shibbarta rashe tanninim al hammayim, vehammitzriyyim nikreu tanninim. shevii, shennigzar hayyam lishnem asar gezarim kede sheyyaavru kol shevet veshevet bederech echad levaddo, vehayenu dichtiv (sham 136) legozer yam suf ligzarim. shemini, shekkafu hammayim kesappir veshoham uzechuchit, kede sheyyiru hashshevatim ellu et ellu, sheammud haesh haya meir lahem, vezehu shenneemar (sham 18) cheshchat mayim ave shechakim, kelomar kibbutz hammayim haya koovi shechakim keetzem hashshamayim latohar. teshii, shehayu yotzim mimmennu mayim metukim shehayu shotim otam, vezehu shenneemar nozlim. asiri, shelleachar sheshshatu mehem ma sheratzu, hannotarim mehem hayu nikpaim venaasim aremot, dichtiv (Shemot 15) neermu mayim nitztzevu chemo ned nozlim:
Eser makkot hevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzriyyim bemitzrayim. 114 374 13:

Veeser al hayyam. hen keneged eser nefilot shebbeshirat vayyosha. rama vayyam, yara vayyam, tubbeu veyam suf, tehomot yechasyumu, yardu vimtzolot, tiratz oyev, taharos kamecha, yochlemo kakkash, kissamo yam, tzallu kaoferet, hare eser nefilot. vetivlaemo aretz eno becheshbon hannefilot, shezzo hi tovatan shezzachu likvura:

Asara nisyonot nissu avotenu lehakkadosh baruch hu vammidbar. shenayim bayyam, echad bayrida, sham neemar (sham 14) hamibbeli en kevarim bemitzrayim, veechad baaliyya, vayyavou marata vayyilonu. echad birfidim, vayyarev haam im moshe. shenayim bamman, lo tetzu veyatzu, ish al yoter mimmennu vayyotiru. shenayim basselav, barishon beshivtenu al sir habbasar, basselav hashsheni vehasafsuf asher bekirbo. echad baegel. veechad bammitonnim. uvamraggelim, vehu asiri, sham neemar vayyenassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli:
Maher lishmoa umaher leabbed yatza secharo vehefsedo. demeachar sheshshocheach ma shellomed ma hanaa yesh bema shehu maher lishmoa, nimtza hefsedo gadol missecharo:

Kashe lishmoa vekashe leabbed yatza hefsedo vishcharo. shemmidda tova sheyyesh bo yetera al hammidda hannifsedet, hoil uma sheshshama achar hakkoshi hu zocher veeno shocheach. venafka minna, sheim yesh lefanenu shene talmidim veen lanu lesappek mazon ella leechad mehem, nakdim hakkashe leabbed al hammaher lishmoa:
Ze chelek ra. lo hava shayyach lemitne hacha chasid o rasha, sheen ze davar hattaluy bivchirato shel adam, ella chissaron shehaya bo meikkar beriyyato:
Beyoshvim lifne chachamim. leel bearba middot battalmidim ayre beinyan hazzikkaron vehashshichcha, vehasheta mayre beinyan hassevara hayeshara uvererat haddavar hatztzodek mehabbilti tzodek:
Sefog. hu sofeg et hammayim, ben achurim ben tzelulim, kach yesh mi shellibbo rachav umekabbel kol ma sheshshomea, veen bo koach livror haemet min hashsheker:
Mashpech. keli shennotnim al pi chavit o al pi hannod kesherotzim lemaloto yayin o shemen:
Shemmachnis bezo umotzi vezo. kach yesh mi shemmekabbel kol ma shellomed uchevolo kach polto:
Meshammeret. motzi kol ma sheshshomea bevet hammidrash, vekolet davar shel battala:

Nafa. leachar shemmotziim hassubbin vehammursan min hakkemach hannitchan venishar hakkemach haddak im hassolet haggas vehu hechashuv, maavirin oto benafa dakka meod veyored mimmenna kol oto hakkemach haddak shehu keen afrurit levana venishar hassolet haggas hechashuv. vechen hayu osin lammenachot. kach yesh mi sheyyesh bo koach livror ulelabben shemuotav, vekolet haemet min hashsheker vehabbatel:
Uvet hassetarim baish. deish eno makpid. vaafillu ishsha en makpedet ella nesua kedifrishit:

Vesheeno makpid alav eno chotzetz. vehu shello yihye al rov gufo. ufesak hahalacha leinyan chatzitza, rubbo umakpid alav, chotzetz devar tora. miuto, kelomar im haddavar hachotzetz hu vemiut hagguf, af al pi shemmakpid alav, eno chotzetz min hattora, aval chachamim gazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid, veal miuto hammakpid nammi mishshum rubbo hammakpid. velo gazru al miuto sheeno makpid attu miuto hammakpid, dehi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera:
Temea. hattippa shel shichvat zera sheppalta:
Tehora. vaafillu tuma derabbanan lekka:
Velo chibbeda et habbayit. lo kinnecha et atzmah ad shello yishshaer bah lachluchit shel shichvat zera:
Keillu lo tavla. dechayshinan shemma tiflot tippat shichvat zera shennishar lah beoto makom:
Lichsheyatil mayim tame. shemma nishtayyer min hakkeri vetoch haamma veyotze im hashsheten:
Beyeled uvevari tahor. sheyyotze vechoach veen mishtayyer. vead kamma karuy yeled, kol sheomed al raglo achat vecholetz minalo venoel minalo, vaafillu ven shemonim shana. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Zimmen shechorim umatza levanim. ha milleta difshita hu velo itzterich lematneh. ella hachi kaamar, zimmen shechorim ulevanim umatza shechorim bimkom levanim ulevanim bimkom shechorim. vehachi perusha dematnitin, zimmen shechorim beken ze umatza bo levanim, zimmen bashsheni levanim umatza bo shechorim, mahu detema hane inhu veithafich ithafoche, ka mashma lan:
Shenayim umatza shelosha. veeno makkir hammuchanin, kullan asurim:
Shelosha umatza shenayim muttarim. haechad halach vehashshenayim nisharu. velo amrinan keshem shehaechad halach ken halchu kullam vehane acharine ninhu:
Zimmen betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken. uvetoch hakken lo matza kelum, asurim:

Veim en beoto shovach ella hen hare ellu muttarin. veaf al pi sheyyesh shovach acher karov lo betoch chamishshim amma, im en oto shovach beshura shel shovach ze beshave ella bekeren zavit, lo amrinan mehahu shovach hakkarov atu. shehaggozalot kol zeman sheenam porchim ella medaddin beraglehen enan medaddin ella keneged hakken shellahen beshave, sheim roin kinnehen keshehofchim laachorehem medaddin, veim lav en medaddin:
Hayillodim lamut. mi shennolad kevar atid hu lamut:
Vehammetim. atidim lichyot velaamod leyom haddin, elle lechayye olam, veelle lacharafot ulediron olam:
Vechayyim liddon. omdin lihyot niddonim leyom haddin:
Leda. meacherim:
Ulehodia. laacherim:
Ulehivvada. lehavin meatzmo:
Hu hayyotzer. shekkol haolam hu beyado kechomer beyad hayyotzer. uma taam, lefi shehu habbore shebbara et kol haolam kullo meayin, lefichach yachol laasot bo kirtzono:
Hu hammevin hu haddayyan. achar shehevin kol maasehem mevian baddin lefanav:
Hu vaal din. shehu tovea et hachotim:
Vehu atid ladun. laolam habba:

Velo masso fanim velo mikkach shochad. sheeno nose fanim afillu letzaddik gamur shello yaanisho al avera kalla shebbat leyado. veeno lokeach shochad hammitzva bishvil haavera. ella noten sachar al hammitzva veonesh al haavera. kach peresh harambam:
Veda shehakkol ba lefi cheshbon. peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol. kach averot kallot keshehen merubbot olot lecheshbon gadol:

Sheal karchacha atta notzar. shehanneshama enah rotza latzet min happargod, makom tahor shehanneshamot munnachot sham, velikkanes bime ishsha bemakom tame, umalach ba umotziah beal karchah umachnisah bime haishsha:
Veal karchacha atta nolad. bishat halleda eno rotze latzet, umalach motzio beal karcho:
Veal karchacha atta chay. yesh adam medukka beyissurim verotze lamut veeno yachol:
Ellu chotztzin. chute tzemer vechute fishtan vehartzuot. shehabbanot mekalleot bahen sear shebberoshan, vehen mehuddakot bassear shebbarosh umonot hammayim millikkanes bassear:

Shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda beshel tzemer, aval bechutin shel sear modim lo chachamim, lefi shehammayim nichnasim bahen. vedavka chutim shebbarosh chotztzin. aval shel tzavvar, en chotztzim, sheen ishsha choneket et atzmah:
Tehora mittumatah. mittumat nidda, umutteret levaalah:
Aval temea al gav rukkah. shennitlash al hammaot kodem tevila, utemea mittorat magga, derukkah metamme vemagga uvemassa:
Natna searah befiha. velo vau hammayim bisarah:
Kartza siftoteha. dachaka siftoteha veyoter zo vazo:
Keillu lo tavla. vaasura levaalah kemo shehayta:
Haochez beadam uvechelim umatbilan temein. devimkom achizato lo vau mayim:
Veim hediach yadav bammayim tehorim. lefi shehammashke sheal yadav mitchabber leme hammikve veshuv en kan chatzitza:
Rabbi shimon omer yerappe vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Bet hassetarim. kegon toch haozen vetoch hachotem vetoch happe:
Bet hakkematin. shel shechi veshel erva. i nammi, kematin shel zaken uzekena shebbesaram nikmat:

En tzarich sheyyavou vahen mayim. dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim, vechi vishtifat yadayim nithar hazzav, vahalo tevilat kol hagguf bemayim chayyim hu tzarich, ella lomar lecha ma yadav bannire, af kol besaro vannire, perat levet hassetarim. veaf al pi chen amru chachamim leolam yelammed adam betoch beto shettehe ishsha medicha kemateha vishat tevila, dinhi deen tzerichin lavo vahen mayim, makom harauy leviat mayim bainan:

Mechabbedin ben hammittot. sheochlin sham. shergilim lehasev veleechol al gabbe mittot. umippene shehu makom muat lo chayshinan shemma yashve gummot kidchayshinan gabbe bayit shehu gadol vei efshar shello yihye sham gumma:
Mugmar. levona al gabbe gechalim lehariach bah. aval legammer et hakkelim divre hakkol asur:

Mekullas. keraav uvene meav teluyin chutza lo [betziddo] keshetztzolehu, vehayu osim zecher lappesach dichtiv beh (Shemot 12) rosho al keraav veal kirbo. mekullas, kegibbor ze shekkele zenav immo. targum vechova nechoshet, vekulesa dinchasha. verambam peresh mekullas, mechubbad, leshon killus:

Vachachamim osrin. bishlashtan. kibbud, mishshum ashvuye gummot. umugmar, mishshum delav tzorech lechol nefesh hu, sheeno ella lammefunnakim velammeunnagim ulemi sherecho ra. mekullas, mippene shennire keochel kadashim bachutz. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hachi garsinan noach lichos venoach lirtzot yatza secharo vehefsedo, kashe lichos vekashe lirtzot yatza hefsedo vischaro. adam shekkoes maher al kol davar, af al pi shehu chozer umitratztze mehera, hefsedo merubbe missecharo, sherov maasav mekulkalim meachar shehu noach lichos al kol davar vedavar. aval hakkashe lichos, af al pi sheyyesh lo midda raa shehu kashe lirtzot, yatza hefsedo hammuat shehu kashe lirtzot bischaro hamerubbe shehu kashe lichos, verov maasav metukkanim. veit degarse ippecha. vegirsa zo niret li ikkar:

Asara nisyonot. echad, ur kasdim, shehishlicho nimrod lechivshan haesh. sheni, lech lecha meartzecha. shelishi, vayhi raav. revii, vattukkach haishsha bet paro. chamishi, milchemet hammelachim. shishshi, maamad ben habbetarim, sheherahu shibud malchuyyot. shevii, hammila. shemini, vayyishlach avimelech vayikkach et sara. teshii, garesh haama hazzot veet benah. asiri, haakeda:
Mishshene tzedadim. sheover mishshene evre habbeged:
Shel bannaim. talmide chachamim sheoskim bevinyano shel olam. vekafde al revav shebbevigdehem, deamar rabbi yochanan kol talmid chacham shennimtza revav al begadav chayyav mita:

Veshel bur. garua meam haaretz. velo kafed al lichluch shebbivgadav ella im ken yotze meever leever. umardaat daamaran leel dechotzetz, hayenu sheover mishshene tzedadin. delo tehe mardaat chashuva mibbigdo shel am haaretz. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Baasara maamarot. tisha vayyomer, uvereshit nammi maamar hu, dichtiv (tehillim log) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu:

Shemmeabbedim et haolam. shekkol hameabbed nefesh achat miyyisrael keillu ibbed olam male, veharshaim shebbaavonam meabbedim et nafsham keillu meabbedim et haolam. kach matzati. veli nire, shemmeabbedin et haolam mammash, shemmachriim et kol haolam kullo lechaf chova, venimtza haolam aved bishvilam:
Shennivra vaasara maamarot. veeno dome hameabbed melacha shehi naaset beyom echad limlacha shehi naaset beharebe yamim:
Arba nashim dayyan sheatan. deenan regilot lirot dam:
Aval halacha kerabbi eliezer. vehachi massik baggemara dahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Arba middot benotne tzedaka. kelomar bintinat hatztzedaka, velo benotne tzedaka mammash, deha ikka behu mi sheeno noten. vechen besamuch beholche levet hammidrash, hayenu bahalichat bet hammidrash:

Eno raa beshel acherim. deyodea shehatztzedaka meashsheret veeno rotze sheacherim yitashsheru. perush acher, yesh mi shechas al mamon kerovav yoter meal mamono, veaf al pi shehu noten eno rotze shekkerovav yittenu, shello yeabbedu et mamonam, vehayenu eno raa beshel acherim dumeya deeno raa beshello divsefa:
Shevuat shav. levattala, shello letzorech:
Chillul hashshem. haover avera befarhesya beyad rama. i nammi, shebbene adam roim velomdim mimmaasav:
Veal hashematat haaretz. shechorshim vezorim bashsheviit:
Mippene maasar ani shebbashshelishit. shebbimkom maaser sheni shemmafrishim bishar shanim shel shemita, bashshelishit uvashshishshit mafrishin maasar ani:
Gezel mattenot aniyyim. leket shichcha ufea peret veollot:

Lifluf shebbaayin. belach eno chotzetz, beyavesh, chotzetz. veshechutz laayin dilel, ben belach ben beyavesh, chotzetz. vetaama have, dechutz laayin adam makpid ben belach ben beyavesh. betoch haayin, beyavesh makpid, belach eno makpid:

Keshut shel katan. kemin sear nolad bivsar hakketannim, keen sear hannolad bekishshuin shekkorin 247 baaravi, veoto sear karuy vilshon mishna keshut shel kishshut, kach sear shel katan haddome lo karuy cheshut shel katan, vehannashim korot lo sear shote:
Lo tame. im naga tuma veoto sear lo nitma hakkatan:
Velo metamme. im haya hakkatan tame veachat meavot hattumot, venaga adam beoto sear velo naga bivsaro, lo nitma hannogea, dela chashiv sear ze yad lehachenis tuma ulehotzi:
Borer ochel veochel. melakket haochel echad echad min happesolet:

Borer kedarko becheko. uvilvad shello yihye torach bererat happesolet merubbe. aval im torach bererat happesolet merubbe al torach bererat haochel, kegon shehappesolet dak beyoter, af al pi shehaochel merubbe beshiuro al happesolet, modim bet hillel shebborer et haochel umanniach et happesolet, dilmiute betircha adif:
Af mediach veshole. shemmevi keli male kitnit venoten alav mayim, vehappesolet tzaf al pene hammayim umesir oto beyado. shole, kemo shal nealecha (Shemot 3). veen halacha kerabban gamliel:
Bemadoch shel etz. aval lo shel even. umihu bemadoch shel etz niddochin kedarkan veen tzarich shinnuy, mippene shehen mefigin taaman im niddochin meetmol:
Vehammelach befach. shel cheres yeduchennu:

O beetz parur. hu hakkaf shemmaggisim bo hakkedera. demelach bae shinnuy, shehaya lo laduch meetmol, sheeno mefig taamo. vahalacha shehabba laduch melach beyom tov matte hammedocha al tziddah vedach al yede shinnuy. vehattavlin niddochin kedarkan veen tzerichin shinnuy:
En meshallechin beyom tov. doron ish lereehu:
Ella manot. davar muchan sheeno asuy lehannicho lemachar, kegon chatichot basar vedagim:

Uvet hillel omrim kulei. velo sharu bet shammay ella lishloach al yede adam echad o shenayim, aval shelosha bene adam o yoter nose mincha asur, deavsha milleta tuva venirin kemolichin limkor bashshuk:
Aval lo tevua. sheenah reuya laachila, shehare tzericha techina, veen tochanin beyom tov:
Verabbi shimon mattir bitvua. sheyyachol lechatshah bemachteshet ketanna vivashshelah maase kedera. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Matbilan ad mekom hammidda. vehashshear en tzarich tevila, dechol haomed lechatech kechatuch dame. velo have chatzitza limkom hachatach atzmo, devet hassetarim dechelim en taun biat mayim kemo veadam. viterim bet hassetarim dechelim al bet hassetarim deadam, deillu vet hassetarim deadam nehi deen teunim biat mayim bainan rauy leviat mayim, uvet hassetarim dechelim afillu rauy leviat mayim lo tzeriche, deen adam makpid sham:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Matbilan ad mekom hammidda. ad arbaa legadol vead asara lekatan, vehashshear tahor veen tzarich tevila, vaafillu chalta midda lachatzi tabbaat shebbashshalshelet en tzarich lehatebil ella ad chatzi tabbaat:
Rabbi tarfon omer ad sheyyatbil et kol hattabbaat. shekkalta hammidda lechetzyo. veen halacha kerabbi tarfon:
Holech veeno ose. holech levet hammidrash lishmoa veeno shone velomed velo mevin:
Ose veeno holech. lomed veshone bevet hammidrash shebbeveto:
Golem. leshon galme kelim, shello nigmera melachtan. kach adam sheeno nigmar bedato lo bemiddot velo bechachma karuy golem:
Eno medabber lifne mi sheggadol mimmennu vechachma. shekken matzinu beelazar veitamar shello ratzu ledabber bifne avihen keshekkatzaf alehem moshe, veheshiv aharon:
Veeno nichnas letoch divre chavero. shello [yearbevennu]. dichtiv (Bamidbar 12) shimu na devaray, hametinu li ad sheadabber. kal vachomer lehedyot:
Veeno nivhal lehashiv. kede shettehe teshuvato kahalacha. vechen beelihu hu omer (Iyov 36) kattar li zeer vaachavvecha:

Shoel kainyan umeshiv kahalacha. ledavar echad hu nimna kan. vehachi perusho, hattalmid shoel kainyan kelomar beoto inyan shehem asukim bo, veaz harav meshiv kahalacha. aval im yishal hattalmid shello keinyan, hu mevi larav sheyyashiv shello kahalacha. al derech sheamar rabbi chiyya lerav (shabbat daf 3) ki kae rabbi behay massechta lo teshayleh bemassechta achariti. vechen atta motze baanashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam sherau et moshe osek behilchot happesach veshaalu lo beoto inyan:

Veomer al rishon rishon. vechen matzinu behakkadosh baruch hu sheamar lo moshe (Shemot 3) mi anochi ki elech el paro, hi harishona. vechi otzi et bene yisrael, hare sheniyya. veheshivo hakkadosh baruch hu al harishona ki ehye immach, veal hashsheniyya, behotziacha et haam mimmitzrayim taavdun et haelohim:

Veal ma shello shama omer lo shamati. im posek din min hassevara middato lo yomar kach shamati merabbotay. umatzinu beanshe charan (Bereshit 29) kesheshshaal mehem yaakov hashalom lo, amru lo shalom, vehinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon, kelomar, ze anu yodim, veim tishal yoter, hinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon vehi taggid lecha, ki anachnu lo yadanu yoter mizze:

Umode al haemet. veaf al pi sheyyachol lehaamid et devarav al yede teanot shebbeyado. vechen matzinu bemoshe (Vayikra 10), keshessilleko aharon veamar lo, im shamata bekadshe shaa en lecha lehakel bekadshe dorot, vayyishma moshe vayyitav beenav, hoda velo bosh lomar lo shamati, ella shamati veshachachti:
Vechillufehen baggolem. chilluf haddevarim hallalu shebbechacham hem baggolem:

Kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot. ona benonit hi sheloshim yom. umikkevan sheavru aleha shalosh onot benoniyyot achar shehiggia samuch leziknatah, dayyah shatah. vesamuch leziknatah nikra, kol shekkorim lah ima ima mechamat ziknatah veenah makpedet:
Kol ishsha. vaafillu enah zekena, veavru aleha shalosh onot velo raata, dayyah shatah:

Meubberet umenika sheavru alehen shalosh onot. aval lo avru alehen, lo. udelo ketanna kamma deamar meubberet mishsheyyivvada haubbar, umenika mishshennolad. veen halacha lo kerabbi eliezer velo kerabbi yose:
Matbilin et hakkol. shechayyav adam letaher atzmo baregel. vechol ma shetztzarich tevila, ben adam ben kelim, matbilin millifne hashshabbat:

Kelim millifne hashshabbat. shekkevan shehem reuyin leachar tevila ledavar shello hayu reuyin lo kodem tevila, i matbil lehu beshabbat uveyom tov hava leh metakken mana veasur. veshabbat denakat hacha lehodiacha kochan devet hillel, daafillu beshabbat sharu lehatebil adam, mishshum denire kemeker uchemitztannen verochetz letaanug velo leshem tevila:
Al neyar chadash. shehu mitkayyem. kach girsat hayyaldut enah mishtakkachat:
Anavim kehot. shello nitbashshelu kol tzarkan umakhot et hashshinayim. kach chachmat hayyeled lo nityashsheva kol tzarkah veen devarav mitkabbelim umityashshevim al hallev:
Yayin miggitto. sheshshemarav meoravim betocho. kach chachmat hayyeled taarovet sefekot yesh bah:

Rabbi omer al tistakkel bakkankan. rabbi paleg adrabbi yose berabbi yehuda, veamar ki kemo sheyyesh kankan chadash male yayin yashan kach yesh yeled shettaamo ketaam zekenim, veyesh zekenim pechutim bemaalat hachachma min hayeladim:
Kol yedot hakkelim. kegon yad hakkardom vechayyotze vah shehichnisah babbarzel:
Shello chedarkah. beikkum:
Velo merkan. lo gamar hachenasatan. leshon umerak achar shechita al yado, bemassechet yoma [daf lev]:
O shemmerkan. sheggamar hachenasatan venishberu:
Keli shehitbilo derech piv keillu lo taval. dechol keli shebbitchillat hachenasato vammayim kofehu al piv, en hammayim nichnasin letocho leolam afillu machniso chullo, ad sheyyattennu:

Belo hazzibborit. shello hitbil bet yado, o davar nosaf sheyyesh bakkeli veachat mikketzotav. ulehachi karu leh zibborit, sheeno ikkaro shel keli. veen hammayim bain bahen ad sheyyattennu al tziddo. vechol hane dematnitin kullehu taama [kede] sheyyavou hammayim bechullan:

Kalmarin. keli shemmannichin bo et haddeyo. vechen korim oto vilshon romi 376. veyesh mehen sheppihen shokea letochan kede shello yishshafech haddeyo afillu im yehafech al piv. veim hitbilo chedarko, en hammayim nichnasim bechalal hashshakua shesseviv piv mibbifnim, lefichach tzarich lenakkev min hatztzad:
Kilke hallev. sear shebbechaze cheneged hallev shennistabbech venaasa cheen sharsherot, vehen nimasot min hazzea:

Uvet hassetarim baishsha. mippene shehassear neechaz umistabbech beoto makom mechamat hazzea vehattinnuf vehallichluch. vedavka veishsha nesua shemmakpedet al atzmah shello titganne al baalah hu devet hassetarim have chatzitza, aval bifnuya deenah makpedet, lo have vet hassetarim chatzitza:
Lifluf. tzoat haayin:
Gelid. rir hayyotze min hammakka shemmityabbesh venaasa gelid:
Useraf hayyavesh. im haya al besarah min hasseraf hannotef mehailanot o min happerot, venityabbesh sham:
Gilde tzoa sheal besaro. shennityabbesha venaaset gelid:
Vehammilmulin. kesheyyadav shel adam meluchlachot betit o vevatzek o vezea umolel yado achat al chavertah naasa al yado chemin gargirim shel seorim:
Beshel mareka. tit hashsharuy beloven betza, asuy letakken bo hakkelim shennisdeku, sheen hammayim memachin oto. mareka, leshon tamruke nashim. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Yitdot derachim. tit shennitmaech al yede hilluch bene adam shemmehallechim alav. ucheshehu lach nikra getz yeveni, ucheshehu yavesh, nikra yetad hadderachim, shekkashe lehallech alehen venire chimhallech al gabbe yetedot:
Sheen tovlin bahem. im haya vammikve tit kaze:
Velo matbilin otan. im haya al besaro. veyesh mefarshim, velo matbilin otam im nitmeu memav, delo salka hashshaka vimkom hattit:
Hakkumkemus. keli nechoshet shemmechammemim bo hammayim, umechamat heashan vehashshalhevet sheola al gabbav naasa sevivav pechamin:
Ella im ken yeshafshef. happechamin sheal gabbav:
Meshallechin kelim tefurin. dachazu lemalbush. vesheenan tefurin chazu leachsuye:
Kilayim. keshehen kashshin sheen mechammemin muttar lishkav alehem:

Sandal mesummar. shel etz mechuppe masmerim. sheggazru chachamim alav shello lenaalo beshabbat veyom tov mishshum maase shehaya shennehergu haruge malchut al yado, kammevoar bemassechet shabbat perek bamme ishsha yotza [daf 60]:
Velo minal sheeno tafur. vaafillu hu mechubbar bitedot shel etz vechayyotze bahen:
Af lo minal lavan. beatreh derabbi yehuda lo hayu noalim minal lavan ad shemmashchirim oto:
Shetztzarich umman. lehashechiro:

Kol shenneotin bo. hachi kaamar, kol shenneotin bo bachol kemot shehu veeno tzarich limlacha acheret, af al pi sheen neotin bo beyom tov, kegon tefillin, shebbechol lovshin otan kemot shehen uveyom tov en lovshin otan, meshallechin otan beyom tov:
Tikkun gadol. shehayu makkifim otah gezuzteraot, umoshivim hannashim lemala vehaanashim millematta, kede shello yavou lide kallut rosh:
Berashehen. berosh kol menora:

Hayta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka vetohorot. ha delo tane hayta asuka betohorot ufarsha veraata, vekatane hayta yoshevet bammitta, leashmoinan demishshum deyesh lah veset vedayyah shatah, hammitta nammi tehora, kiddekatane vechullan tehorot, ha im en lah veset, dimtamminan meet leet, hammitta nammi temea, kemishkav nidda atzmah shemmetammea tuma chamura letamme adam letamme begadim shealav:
Af al pi sheamru. ishsha sheen lah veset metammea meet leet:
Enah mona. yeme nidda ella mishshaa sheraata:
Uvamme amru. arba nashim dayyan sheatan:
Biriya rishona. sheraata habbetula, vehameubberet vehammenika, vehazzekena leachar sheavru aleha shalosh onot mechamat ziknatah:
Aval bashsheniyya metammea meet leet. shehare chazra lekadmutah lihyot dameha metzuyin bah:
Meones. kegon dekaftza veraata, o mechamat pachad, o sheachla davar hammaggir dam:

Parato yotza virtzua shebben karneha. lenoy. veamru chachamim masseoy hu veeno tachshit lah. velo parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta ella shel shechenato, veal shello micha bah nikret al shemo:
Umekardin beyom tov. kemin megera ketanna shel barzel sheshshinneha dakkot umechakkechin umegardin bah habbehema, veaf al gav deaved chavura:
Barechayim shellahen. ketannot haasuyot lechach:
Mekartzefin. bimgera shel etz sheshshinneha gassot veen osin chabbura:

Af lo mekartzefin. degazrinan kirtzuf attu kirud. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya bishlosha devarim hallalu, ella bimkardin et habbehema bilvad, mishshum divha kam leh beshittateh derabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkavven muttar, vekayma lan kevateh. vachachamim diflige aleh savre kerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkavven asur, veenah halacha:
Kol hayyad hammarba livdok. shebbodeket tamid shemma raata:
Uvaanashim. shebbodek atzmo tamid beammato, shemma yatza mimmennu keri:
Tikkatzetz. shemmitchammem umargish keshemmemashmesh baamma, umotzi shichvat zera levattala:
Vehassuma. enah mishna udechuya hi. ella hi bodeket leatzmah umara lechavroteha:
Veshennitrefa datah. mechamat choli:
Metakkenot otan. bodkot otan umatbilot otan:

Hachi garsinan, hatztzenuot metakkenot lahen shelishi letakken et habbayit. kelomar livdok lifne tashmish ulehachin atzmah levalah. vehu haddin lechol hannashim keditnan beferek kamma uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah, veha denakat tzenuot, mishshum ditznuot ed shebbodeket bo lifne tashmish ze en bodkot bo lifne tashmish acher, lefi shemmetunnaf vechaha marit libbuno bivdika rishona, veshuv en niret bo tippa kechardal:

Betza shennolda veyom tov. [beyom tov] shelachar shabbat askinan. vetaamayhu devet hillel deamre lo teachel, mishshum dechol betza demityalda haidna, meetmol gamra la, venimtzet shabbat mechina leyom tov, vehattora amra (Shemot 16) vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu, usetam shishshi chol hu, chol mechin leshabbat, vechol mechin leyom tov, deyom tov nammi ikre shabbat, veen yom tov mechin leshabbat velo shabbat mechina leyom tov. vahachana ki hach devetza af al gav devide shamayim hi, mikkarya hachana. umihu shabbat veyom tov dachashive, baaya seudatan hazemana bechol, veen echad mehen mechin lachavero afillu bahachana devide shamayim, aval seudat chol lo chashiva velo baaya hazemana, hilkach beechad beshabbat bealma sheeno yom tov let lan lemesar betza shennolda bo lefi shennigmera beshabbat, disudat chol lo atzrechah rachamana zimmun mibbeod yom. veasru betza shennolda bechol yom tov, veaf al pi sheeno achar shabbat, gezera mishshum yom tov sheachar shabbat. vechen asru betza shennolda bechol shabbat legamah chayya, gezera mishshum shabbat sheachar yom tov. veshabbat veyom tov hassemuchim ze laze, betza shennolda baze asura baze. vechen shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. aval shene yamim tovim shel galuyyot, demimma nafshach echad mehem chol, betza shennolda baze mutteret baze:

Seor bechazzayit. leinyan achila kulle alma lo felige deze vaze bechazzayit, middefatach hakkatuv bisor vesiyyem bechametz, seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ki kol ochel machametzet (Shemot 12), lomar lecha zehu seor vezehu chametz, keze ken ze. ki felige leinyan biur, bet shammay savre middechatav rachamana letarvayhu, seor vechametz, velichtuv chametz sheen chimmutzo kashe vaafillu hachi chayyav levaer vekal vachomer lasseor shechimmutzo kashe, ella shema minnah shiuro shel ze lo cheshiuro shel ze, velo yalfinan biur meachila. uvet hillel savre ze vaze bechazzayit, deyalfinan biur meachila. umishshum dehanach telat mille mikulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel gabbe yom tov, tana lehu hacha gabbe hadade:
Bechakkotevet. temara:
Peraksin. levush hattachton sheal habbasar, vehu fatuach bakketefayim, ucheshellovsho koshro al hakkatef, uvishat hefshet mattiro:
Vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach. hakkematim sheyyesh bisfato haelyona, kede sheyyavou hammayim ben otam hakkematim:
Lematteach. lefashtan ulemashchan. kemo vayyimtachem kaohel lashavet (yeshaya 40):
Ushenatzin shel sandal. retzuot shekkoshro vahen:

Sheyyevabeu. keshemmatbil adam beged bemayim, olin kemin avabuot bammayim. ucheshehen mechubbasim umashke tofeach alehen, mishshehitchilu hammayim levabea, taharu, lefi shehushsheku hammayim habbeluim bo leme hammikve. aval keshehen neguvim en hammayim bain bechullo ad sheyyanuchu mibbibuan. shekkesheadam matbil sadin veen yachol leshatcho sheen hammikve rechava chol kach, tochavo vammayim keshehu mekuppal umittoch kach mevabeim hammayim, ucheshennachin mibbibuan beyadua shebbau hammayim bechullo:

En beyadenu. kemo lo hava beyadeh (yevamot 105.). kelomar en haddavar hazze yadua lanu maddua derech reshaim tzalecha umippene ma hatztzaddikim medukkaim beyissurin. perush acher, en lanu bizman haggalut lo mishshalva vehasheket sheragil hakkadosh baruch hu latet larshaim kede letardan min haolam habba, veaf lo min hayyissurim hameyuchadim latztzaddikim shehen yissurim shel ahava sheen bahen bittul tora. kelomar yatzanu mikkelal reshaim, sheen lanu hashshalva sheyyesh larshaim, velichlal tzaddikim lo higganu, shehayyissurim shellanu enan shel ahava keyissure hatztzaddikim:
Heve makdim shalom lechol adam. vaafillu lenachri bashshuk:
Veheve zanav laarayot. ligdolim mimmecha:
Velo rosh lashshualim. lakketannim mimmecha:
Kishre heani. begadav shel ani shennikreu ukesharan, hakkesher hahu eno asuy lehattir leolam, hilkach eno tzarich lehattiro vishat tevila kede sheyyavou alav mayim:
Vehannimin. nimin ufetilin shettolin al sefat hassadin lenoy veosin bahen kesharim, veenan asuyin lehattir leolam:
Vachavat shel sandal. aznayim sheyyesh lirtzuot shel sandal, en tzarich lehattir hakkesher shellahen bishat tevila, sheen oto kesher asuy lehattir:

Bizman shehi chotza. shehakkesher chotzetz, sheen hammayim nichnasim letochah. veematay yihye ze, keshehakkesher mehuddak yafe veaz eno asuy lehattir. ulefi shehu asuy lehitkayyem, en tzarich lehattiro vishat tevila:
Veshel zeroa. kesher shel tefilla shel yad:
Bizman sheenah ola veyoredet. demihaddak hakkesher harebe, veen hartzua ola veyoredet bo:
Veazne hachemet. azne hannod yesh bahem kesharim mehuddakin:
Tarmul. kis gadol shel or shennosin haroim. uvilshon mikra karuy yalkut:
Yafa shaa achat bitshuva. letzorech teshuva umaasim tovim:
Mikkol chayye haolam habba. lefi shebbeoto zeman en hatteshuva umaasim tovim mehannim laadam, sheen haolam habba ella lekabbel sachar al ma shekkiyyem baolam hazze:

Yom tov harishon shel chag vechulei. esrim vearba mishmarot shel kehunna hayu bammikdash, vechullan olot laregel vezochot bachovot habbaot mechamat haregel, veshesh esre mishmarot makrivim shesh esre behemot, shehem shelosha asar parim veelim shenayim vesair echad, nisharu shemone mishmarot learbaa asar kevasim, shesh mishmarot min hashshemone hayu makrivin shene kevasim kol achat mehem, hare shenem asar kevasim, vehashshear shehem shete mishmarot hannotarot makrivot echad echad:

Bashsheni. shennitmaet echad min happarim venishtayyeru tesha mishmarot learbaa asar kevasim. chamishsha mehen hayu makrivin shenayim shenayim, hare asara. vehashshear shehem arba mishmarot hannotarot makrivot kol achat keves echad:

Bashshelishi. shennitmaet od par echad min happarim, venisharu eser mishmarot learbaa asar kevasim, arba mishmarot makrivot shenayim shenayim, hava lehu shemone. vehashshear echad echad, shishsha kevasim leshesh mishmarot:

Bashshevii kullan shavin. hammishmarot, umakrivot kevasim shavot, shekkol achat makrevet achat, shehare enam ella shiva parim veelim shenayim vesair echad leeser mishmarot, nishtayyeru arbaa asar kevasim learba esre mishmarot:

Bashshemini chozrim lappayis kevargalim. par echad, ayil echad veshiva kevasim, shekkerevim bashshemini, en kerevim keseder karbenot hechag lefi seder hammishmarot, ella kol hammishmarot baot umefayyesot alehen, kemo shemmefayyesot bishar regalim. veseder happayis meforash beyoma perek barishona:
Amru mishmar shehikrivu parim hayyom. lo hayu makrivim parim lemachar, shehammishmarot shehikrivu etmol kevasim lo hayu mannichim otan, ella chozrot chalila:
Velo era keri lechohen gadol. lefi shehi tuma hayyotza miggufo, haya haddavar megunne umechoar yoter mishshear tumot:
Velo kibbu geshamim esh atze hammaaracha. veaf al pi shehammizbeach bemakom megulle haya:
Velo natzcha haruach et ammud heashan. shello yehe mittammer veole:

Velo nimtza fesul baomer uvishte hallechem uvelechem happanim. sheim haya nimtza bahem pesul kodem mitzvatan lo haya efshar lehakeriv acherim tachtam. shehaomer niktzar ballayla velo hayu marbim liktzor. ushete hallechem neefim meerev yom tov veen afiyyatan docha yom tov. vechen lechem happanim neefa meerev shabbat:
Tzefufim. leshon tzaf al pene hammayim. merov hakkahal hayu nidchakim ish beachiv ad shehayu raglehem netulot min haaretz veomdim baavir:
Umishtachavim revachim. bishat hishtachavaya naasa lahem nes umishtachavim berevach kol echad rachok mechavero arba ammot, kede shello yishma et chavero keshehu mitvadde umazkir avonotav:

Tzar li hammakom shealin birushalayim. garsinan. lefi shehaya hammakom mazmin lahem parnasatan velo hutzrach echad mehem latzet mishsham velomar parnasati [dechuka] veeni yachol ladur birushalayim. veyesh sefarim shekkatuv bahen keshealin. veal haolim laregel neemar, shello haya echad mehem metzer keshehaya lan birushalayim mechamat dochak hammakom. kemo tzar li hammakom gesha li veesheva (yeshaya mat):
Hakkar. hu sheshshochev alav:
Hakkeset. hu shemmesim tachat meraashotav:
Sheyyavou vahen hammayim. letochan. shedderech kar vecheset shel or lehachenis ulehotzi ma shebbetochan:
Keset agulla. uketanna sheosim hassarim tachat meraashotehen:
Hakkaddur. 126:
Vehaemum. defus sheosim alav et hamminal. vehu asuy meor umemalleim oto vesear o vemochin:
Vehakkamea. shel ketav o shel ikkarin mechuppe or:
Utefilla. shel yad o shel rosh:
Enan tzerichim sheyyavou vahen hammayim. lefi sheen derech lehachenis ulehotzi ma shebbetochan:
Heve zahir battalmud. sheyyehe talmudecha bedikduk vechahalacha:
Sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon. im tite behoraa mittoch shello dikdakta betalmudecha vetavo lehattir et haasur, hakkadosh baruch hu maale al yadcha keillu asita mezid:
Shelosha chetarim hem. hakketuvim battora, shechiyyeva hattora linhog bahem kavod:
Keter tora. ketiv beh (Vayikra 19) vehadarta pene zaken, ze shekkana chachma:
Keter kehunna. ketiv beh (sham 21) vekiddashto kadosh yihye lach:
Keter malchut. ketiv beh (Devarim 17) som tasim alecha melech, shettehe emato alecha:

Vecheter shem tov. mi sheyyesh beyado maasim tovim ushemuato tova mechamat maasav, lo matzinu lo keter battora sheyyihyu chayyavim linhog bo kavod, vehu ole al gabbe kullan, shekkol hashshelosha ketarim tzerichim lo. sheim talmid chacham hu vesanni shumeaneh, share levizzuye. veim kohen gadol hu, amrinan beyoma (daf amud alef) yeton bene ammaya lishlam deavdin uvede aharon, velo yeton bene aharon lishlam delo avdin uvede aharon. veim melech hu, ketiv (Shemot 22) venasi beammecha lo taor, beose maase ammecha:
Shelli shelli veshellecha shellach. eni rotze lehannotcha, vehalevay shello tehanne oti:

Veyesh omrim zo middat sedom. karov haddavar lavo lide middat sedom, shemmittoch shehu ragil bechach, afillu bedavar shechavero nehene vehu eno chaser lo yirtze lehannot et chavero, vezo hayta middat sedom, shehayu mitkavvenim lechallot haregel mibbenehem, veaf al pi shehayta haaretz rachavat yadayim lifnehem velo hayu chaserim kelum:

Shelli shellecha veshellecha shelli am haaretz. shennehene umehanne beshave, vezehu yishshuvah shel haaretz, aval eno yodea kera dichtiv (Mishlei 15) vesone mattanot yichye. vezehu leshon am haaretz haamur bechol makom, sherotze betikkunah shel haaretz aval en bo chachma lehavedil battikkunin haruyin:
Shelli shellecha veshellecha shellach. mehanne et habberiyyot minnechasav, vehu eno nehene meacherim:
Chasid. sheose lifnim mishshurat haddin:
Raav shel batztzoret. haggeshamim muatim umittoch kach hashshaar mityakker:
Raav shel mehuma. mippene haggeyasot en yecholin leesof hattevua:
Raav shel kelaya. hashshamayim kabbarzel vehaaretz kannechusha:
Shello nimseru levet din. shello asu bahen din tora:
Veal perot sheviit. sheosim bahen sechora veen nohagin bahen kedushshat sheviit:
Innuy haddin. sheyyodim lehechan haddin note umeakkevin veen poskin oto:
Iuut haddin. lezakkot et hachayyav ulechayyev et hazzakkay:
Veal hammorim battora shello chahalacha. leesor et hammuttar ulehattir et haasur:
Mishsheyyivvada ubbarah. lesof shelosha chodashim miyyom shennitabbera:

Ad shettigmol. ad sheyyashlim livnah esrim vearbaa chodesh. vaafillu met betoch esrim vearbaa chodesh, dayyah shatah, shehayyoledet evareha mitparkim veen damah chozer ad achar esrim vearbaa chodesh. umishsham vaelach hare hi kechol hannashim umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida, veaf al pi shemmenika veholechet arba vechamesh shanim:

Gemalattu o met rabbi meir omer metammea meet leet. desavar rabbi meir dam nekar venaasa chalav. uchesheenah menika, afillu kodem esrim vearbaa chodesh chozer haddam limkomo vechozeret lihyot roa. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

En molichin et hassullam mishshovach leshovach. besullam shel aliyya kulle alma lo felige deasur, uvesullam shel shovach nammi keshehu molicho birshut harabbim modu bet hillel deasur, sheharoe omer letakken gaggo hu molicho veose melacha beyom tov. ki felige shemmolicho birshut hayyachid veen bene adam roim oto. bet shammay savre en molichin, shekkol davar sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur. uvet hillel mattirin, af al gav divalma dina hachi hu, hacha share mishshum simchat yom tov:
Mechallon lechallon. beoto shovach atzmo, shekkach derech shovach lihyot bo [mechitztzot harebe] ken lechol zug vezug, vechallon lechol ken vaken:

Ze vaze ani notel. pelugetayhu devet shammay uvet hillel davka bivrecha rishona. shedderech megaddele yonim tamid lehanniach berecha rishona, dehaynu shete gozalot rishonot, shehaimmahot mishtasheot bahen velo yivrechu. uvet shammay savre divdibbur bealma lo saggi, dilma ki shakel lehu lemachar ate leamluche vechayis alayhu vehave tiltul shello letzorech, aval mishshenninea umishmesh bahen mibbeod yom lishchita velo chas alayhu tu lo chayshinan dechayis. uvet hillel savre lo gazrinan dilma chayis alayhu, vaafillu bivrecha rishona:

Kol hoochalim mitztarfin. achal ochalim temeim mikkamma minim veyesh bechullan kachatzi feras shehen shete vetzim lerashi uvetza umechetza ledivre rambam, mitztarfin lifsol geviyyato milleechol batteruma. vechen shata mikkamma minim shel shiva mashkin shehem mayim yayin shemen devash chalav dam tal, sheellu vilvad nikrain mashkin, kullan mitztarfin ze im ze lifsol et haggeviyya birviit hallog, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) mikkol haochel asher yeachel vechol mashke asher yishshate, limmed al hoochalin shekkullan mitztarfin veal mashkin shekkullan mitztarfin:
Sheasu vo shear mashkin. lifsol et haggeviyya:
Kammayim. veen shear mashkin poslin et hammikve bishlosha luggin kammayim. i nammi, en shear mashkin mashlimin shiur mikve learbaim sea kammayim, dichtiv mikve mayim, velo mikve shel shear mashkin:
Bapperozdor. bet shaar. targum ulam, perozdora:
Teraklin. mekom moshav hammelech. kach atta hateken atzmecha baolam hazze kede shettizke laolam habba:

Veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even. mi sheyyesh lo mayim yafim lishtot venitmeu, memalle mehen keli even sheeno mekabbel tuma, venotnan bemikve mayim meluchim o achurim ad shennoshkim mayim lemayim, nimtzeu ellu zeruim umechubbarim leme mikve uvatlu aggabbayhu vetaharu. veen tohora bammikve leshum ochel umashke ella lemayim bilvad, velo betorat tevila ella betorat zeria:
Aval lo matbilin. sheen notnin otan bichli etz tame, shetztzarich tevila lakkeli, lehashshik bo kede laalot tevila lichli aggav hashshakat mayim:

Umatbilin miggav legav. mi shehitbil kelim ledaat sheyyidroch bahen zetim bevet habbad leshemen shel chullin, venimlach lidroch bahen anavim baggat leyayin shel teruma, tzarich lehatebilan paam sheniyya leshem teruma. vechen im hitbil kelim leshem teruma venimlach laasot bahem kodesh, tzerichim tevila sheniyya leshem kodesh. veotah tevila yachol lehatebil beyom tov, sheen kan tikkun keli, lefi sheen tevila zo lehaalot otan miyyde tuma ella letosefet tohora:
Umechavura lachavura. im hitbil kelim al menat leechol pischo im chavura zo venimlach lehimmanot im chavura acheret uva lehatebil kelav paam sheniyya, otah tevila muttar laasotah beyom tov:

En matbilin chammin betzonen. doochalim umashkin en lahem tohora vammikve, ella hammayim shennitmeu vilvad, mittaam hashshaka vechibbur, veen hashshaka moelet ella vemin im mino, chammin bechammin veyafim beyafim umarim bemarim. aval min besheeno mino en hashshaka moelet bahen velo nitharu hammayim:
Male mashkin. kegon yayin veshemen ume ferot vechol mashkin chutz mimmayim:
Keillu lo taval. mishshum dechaytze. vedavka shello nishtannu marehen, shello nitbattelu vammayim:

Male me raglayim roin otan keillu hen mayim. deme raglayim min mayim hen, ucheshehishshiku alehen me mikve naasu chibbur lahen velo chaytze venithar hakkeli. veyesh sefarim sheggorsin, roin otan keillu hen yayin, veim hayu mishtannim marehen vechozrim lemare mayim, mitbattelim bammayim venithar hakkeli. uchegirsa zo muchach battosefta:
Male me chattat. mayim shennitkaddeshu veefer para, umehem mazzim al temee metim:

Ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat. sheyyihye rov hakkeli fanuy kede sheyyirbu me mikve hannichnasim bo al me chattat shehayu vetocho. veim lav, adayin hu vetumato vahare hen kishar mashkin shechotztzin ben hakkeli uven me hammikve:
Kor. sheloshim sein:
Veen bo ella reviit. me chattat. o shear mashkin:

Keillu lo taval. disvira leh lerabbi yose, reviit mashkin o reviit me chattat shebbetoch hakkeli, poslin bitvila, vechotztzin afillu vetoch keli gadol, ad sheyyasir harviit shel mashkin o shel me chattat veyachazor veyatbilo rekan. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Vehammor. 212 belaaz. veyesh sefarim gorsim vechemar:
Dargash. mitta ketanna. targum veyashavt al mitta chevudda (Yechezkel 23), dargashin:
Al hannekiyyim chotztzin. mishshum dekafde alehen:
Belusin. meluchlachim. vedome lo vaggemara veferek kelal gadol [shabbat daf 76] issa velusa:
Enan chotztzin. delo kafde aleh. vehayenu taama demittot baal habbayit veani:
Ikkuf. kemo ukkaf. vehu shel or shemmesimin al hachamor keshennose hammassa:
Zakkakin. nose hannodot shel or. leshon zika ben malya ven chasera sharya, bemassechet avoda zara (daf 60):
Eno chotzetz. sheen makpidin al hallichluch:
Ad keissar haitalki. shehu rochav kearbaa gargere seora, chotzetz. pachot mikkan, eno chotzetz. vetanna kamma lo yahev beh shiura, ella afillu fachot mikkeissar chotzetz. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Meviin shelamim beyom tov. shalme chagiga, lefi sheyyesh bahem tzorech achila laadam:

Veen somchin alehem. shehassemicha asura mishshum shevut, shebbechol kocho haya somech vahava leh mishtammesh bevaale chayyim. ella somchin alehem meerev yom tov, delet lehu levet shammay techef lassemicha shechita:

Aval lo olot. chutz mittemidin umusafin shehen karban tzibbur uzemannan kavua. aval lo yavi olat yachid, sheen bah achilat hedyot. vaafillu olot reiyya kerevot bishar yemot haregel velo beyom tov, derachamana amar (Bamidbar 29) atzeret tihye lachem, lachem velo legavoah:
Uvet hillel omrim. meviim shalme chagiga veolot reiyya, dichtiv (Devarim 16) atzeret laAdonai, kol dela. aval nedarim unedavot divre hakkol en kerevin beyom tov, lo olot velo shelamim:
Hashshochet chayya vaof. habba lishchot chayya vaof venimlach bevet din ketzad yaase:

Bet shammay omrim. bet din morin lo sheyyishchat lechattechilla veyachpor bedeker nautz shehechino mibbeod yom, kelomar sheyyaakor oto mimmekom neitzato veyaale afar vichasse bo. umayre keshehu nautz beafar tichoach harauy lechissuy, sheeno mechussar ketisha:
Deker. yated shennoatzim baaretz. leshon vayyidkor et shenehem (Bamidbar 28):

Sheefer kira muchan hu. lav amilletayhu devet shammay uvet hillel kae, ella milleta beanpe nafshah hi, vehachi kaamar veefer kira muchan hu veeno tzarich hazemana, dedateh illuye. velo shanu ella shehussak meerev yom tov, aval hussak beyom tov asur, delekka lememar dateh illuye meetmol. veim rauy litzlot bo betza, sheadayin hu remetz cham, af al pi shehussak beyom tov muttar lechassot bo, deayde dachazi lehippuche beh litzlot bo betza, shakel leh nammi umechasse bo:
Zappatin. zofte chaviyyot. i nammi, ose hazzefet:
Mefassele ilanot. shennotlim happesolet min hailanot. perush acher, korte hailanot. leshon pesal lecha, shekkoret haanafim min hailan kede sheyyitabbe veyagdil gufo shel ilan:
Shel kayyatzin. hashshotchim lachamma leyabbesh perot shel kayitz. perush acher, melakkete kotzin. vechol hane lo kafdi allichluch hammitpachot shellahem. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Binfol oyivcha al tismach. pasuk hu bemishle, ella sheshshemuel hakkatan haya ragil lehochiach bene adam bemidda zo:
Pen yire Adonai vera beenav. sheasito bilvavcha keillu hu sheluchacha lemalot taavatcha:
Veheshiv mealav appo. middelo ketiv veshav ella veheshiv, mashma yassirehu meal oyvecha vishivehu alecha:
Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat lo yevashshel battechilla. kelomar lo yehe techillat bishshulo veikkaro leshum shabbat, ella leshum yom tov yehe techillat bishshulo, uma shemmotir yehe leshabbat.

Veose tavshil meerev yom tov. leshem eruve tavshilin. it deamre taama dehay tavshil meerev yom tov, mishshum kevod shabbat hu, shemmittoch shemmeerev yom tov zocher hashshabbat, yivror mana yafa leshabbat velo yishkach shabbat mishshum tirdat yom tov. veit deamre mishshum kevod yom tov hu, kede sheyyiru sheen ofin miyyom tov leshabbat ella im ken hitchil mibbeod yom, divyom tov eno ella gomer, kal vachomer miyyom tov lechol dilgamre en ofin velo mevashshelin. umevarchim al eruve tavshilin kederech shemmevarchim al eruve chatzerot. vetzarich lezakkot al yede acher lechol mi sherotze achar kach lismoch al eruvo, vaafillu shello middato, dezachin laadam shello befanav:
Achalo o sheavad. oto tavshil shebbishshel, meerev shabbat:

Somech alav. levashshel bishshulo beyom tov letzorech shabbat. aval mittechillato en eruve tavshilin pachot mikkazzayit, ben leechad ben lemea. veim hitchil beissato veneevad eruvo, ma shehitchil gomer:
Shata mashkin temein. shear mashkin chutz mimmayim:
Sheenan tehorim bagguf. lo alta lahen tevila bitvilat hagguf, doochalin umashkin chutz mimmayim en lahem tohora vammikve.
Aval shata mayim temein vetaval. tehorim bagguf. sheyyesh lahen tohora vammikve al yede hashshaka:
Hare hi chemot shehayta. tehora chemot shehayta, shehu matztzil aleha veodah belua shello tittamma:
Tovel veochel batteruma. detuma velua enah metammea acherim:
Bizman shehu nire. al gufo mibbachutz:
Tovel veochel batteruma. lo shena chetz tame velo shena chetz tahor, eno chotzetz battevila kol zeman sheeno nire:
Al teratztze et chavercha vishat kaaso. dichtiv (Shemot 33) panay yelechu vahanichoti lach, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, hameten ad sheyyaavru panim shel zaam (berachot 7.):

Veal tenachamennu veshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav. shebbishat hachurban kivyachol haya hakkadosh baruch hu mitabbel, bikkeshu malache hashsharet lenachamo, veruach hakkodesh meshivan (Yeshayahu 22:4) al taitzu lenachameni:

Veal tishal lo vishat nidro. limtzo petachim lehattir lo et nidro. mippene sheaz al kol petach ufetach shettimtza lo yomar addata dehachi nadarti, veshuv lo timtza lo petach. umatzinu keshennishba hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe shello yikkanes laaretz lo hitchannen miyyad ella himtin veachar kach hitchil lehitchannen:

Bishat kalkalato. keshennitkalkel bechet. lefi shehu mitbayyesh mikkol adam. vechen atta motze keshechata adam harishon lo nigla alehem hakkadosh baruch hu ad sheasu chagorot, dichtiv (Bereshit 3) vayyaasu lahem chagorot, veachar kach vayyishmeu et kol Adonai elohim:

En tomnin et hachammin miyyom tov lashshabbat. desavre bet shammay en ofin ella im ken erev befat, veen mevashshelin ella im ken erev al hattavshil, veen tomnin ella im ken hayu lo chammin temunin meerev yom tov. uvet hillel savre deofin umevashshelin vetomnin al eruv shel tavshil bilvad. umihu baggemara muchach devet hillel nammi bau pat uvasar. vechen halacha:
En zokfin menora. shel chulyot shennitparku chulyoteha, en machazirin otan, dahave kevone, veyesh binyan bechelim. uvet hillel savre en binyan bechelim:
Geritzin. kikkerot avot:
Ella rekikin. kikkerot dakkot, desavre bet shammay en ofin pat merubba beyom tov mishshum tircha. uvet hillel omrim ofin pat merubba beyom tov, shebbizman shehappat merubba hi neefet yafe:
Vechori. issa gedola haneefet al gabbe gechalim, mishshum devaaya hessek gadol, shehaggechalim holchot veommot, vetircha ikka. veen halacha kerabban gamliel bechol ma shemmachmir kedivre bet shammay:
Mibbelae michnese kohanim. mimmichnese kohanim habbeluyot, umeavnetehen hayyeshanim. targum avnet hemyana:
Hayu mafkiim. korim laasot petilot:
Shello hayta meira. lefi shehammenorot gevohot chamishshim amma vehar habbayit gavoah, vehaora zorachat bechol hair:
Baavukot shel or. bearba avukot o bishmone, zorek zo umekabbel et zo:

Divre shirot vetishbachot. yesh mehen shehayu omrim ashre yaldutenu shello biyyesha et ziknutenu, ellu chasidim veanshe maase. veyesh shehayu omrim ashre ziknutenu shekkippera al yaldutenu, ellu baale teshuva. veellu vaellu omrim ashre mi shello chata umi shechata venimchal lo:
Shealehem haleviyyim omdim beshir. besimchat bet hashshoeva. aval duchan leshir shel karban etzel hammizbeach haya:
Taku veheriu vetakau. ze siman lelech ulemalleot mayim lenissuch min hashshilloach:
Higgiu laazara. lekarka azara shel nashim:
Hafchu fenehem lammaarav. letzad haazara vehahechol kede lomar davar ze:
Shonin. koflin lomar:
Anu leyah. mishtachavim umodim al ma sheavar:
Uleyah enenu. meyachalot lehabba:
Shalosh liftichat shearim. kesheppotchim shaare haazara hayu tokim tekia terua tekia, vechashev lehu leshalosh tekiot:

Vetesha letamid shel shachar. keshehayu menassechim niske hattamid haleviyyim omrim beshir. ushelosha perakim hayu mafsikim bo, veal kol perek uferek hayu hakkohanim tokim shalosh tekiot tekia terua tekia, umishtachavim haam [tekia terua tekia chashev lehu leshalosh], hare tesha tekiot:

Lehavetil haam mimmelacha. tekia rishona levattel haam shebbassadot, tekia sheniyya nistalleku hatterisin veninalu hachanuyyot, tekia shelishit sillek hamesallek vehitmin hammatmin et hachammin vehidliku et hannerot:
Veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. leachar hattekiot harishonot shaha kede litzlot dag katan, vetokea umeria vetokea. ellu shalosh tekiot acharonot lehodia shekkadash hayyom:
Shalosh liftichat shearim. shel azara, shettokim bechol yom:
Veshalosh lashshaar haelyon. kidamran leel amdu shene kohanim bashshaar haelyon kara haggever taku veheriu vetaku:

Veshalosh lashshaar hattachton. ditnan leel higgiu laazara taku veheriu vetaku. umaarichin bahen ad shehiggiu lashshaar hattachton, keditnan hayu tokin veholchin ad shehiggiu lashshaar hayyotze mimmizrach, lehachi kare lehu shalosh shel shaar hattachton. veshalosh shel maala asirit lo kachashev, dehay tanna savar kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar shello hayu tokim lemaala asirit:
Veshalosh lemilluy hammayim. leachar sheshsheavum uvau lahem laazara derech shaar hammayim, taku veheriu vetaku:

Al gabbe hammizbeach. ditnan beferek lulav vaarava uzekafum al gabbe hammizbeach, taku veheriu vetaku. vetanna didan lo mayte hacha keshechal lihyot erev pesach beshabbat shehappesach nishchat beshalosh kittot utekiot tuva havo hatam, mishshum delo shechicha kulle hay sheyyavo erev pesach beshabbat. veha ditnan en mosifin al arbaim ushemone, lav davka, diverev pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat zimnin demosifim ad sheva vachamishshim tekiot:

Chal lihyot yom echad lehafesik bentayim. kegon shechal yom tov rishon besheni beshabbat, shehayu yecholim lavo beechad beshabbat vehen kadmu uvau meerev shabbat, o shechal yom tov haacharon bachamishshi beshabbat, shehayu yecholin lelech beerev shabbat venitakkevu sham beshabbat, kol hammishmarot shennitakkevu sham en notlin ella shete challot:
Umishmar shezzemanno kavua notel eser. vecholkin otan ben mishmar hannichnas uven mishmar hayyotze, kederech kol shabbetot hashshana:
Hannichnas notel shesh kulei. shehammishmarot mitchallefot beshabbat, zo ovedet shacharit vezo ovedet arvit:
Hannichnas notel sheva. notlim shete challot yeterot bischar hagafat delatot, shehem noalim haddelatot sheppatchu hammishmar hayyotze bashshachar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hannichnasim cholkim. benehen lechem hammaggia lechelkam:
Batztzafon. kede sheyyerae lakkol shehen nichnasin, shehatztzafon ikkar, shehi kevua lishchitat kadshe kadashim:
Vehayyotzim cholkim baddarom. kede sheyyerae shehem yotzim veholchim lahem, lefichach shinnu mekoman etzel ruach sheeno ikkar:
Bilga. shem hammishmara:
Leolam choleket baddarom. vaafillu keshehi nichneset, kenasa hu shekkenasuha:

Vetabbatah kevua. esrim vearba tabbaot hayu baazara bimkom hammitbachayim, leesrim vearba mishmerot kehunna, vetabbaot shel kol hammishmarot petuchot tzad echad vehofchah lemala umachnis tzavvar habbehema letochah vechozer vehofech pitcha lematta letoch haritzpa. vetabbaat shel bilga kevua veenah nehefechet, utzericha lehishtammesh beshel acherim, ugenay hu lah:

Vechallonah setuma. challonot hayu belishkat hachalifot sheshsham gonzin et sakkinehem. vechallon shel mishmeret bilga hayta setuma, diknasuha rabbanan mishshum maase shehaya, sheishsha achat mimmishmeret bilga umiryam bat bilga shemah nishtammeda venisset lesardeyot echad mimmalche yevanim, ucheshennichnesu yevanim lahechol halcha vetafcha bassandal al gabbe hammizbeach veamra, lokus lokus, perush zeev zeev belashon yevani, ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael veen atta omed lahen bishat dochokan. uchesheshshamu chachamim bedavar ze kavu et tabbatah vesatmu et challonah shel kol hammishmeret kullah, ki amru im lo sheshshama meaviha shehaya mevazze et haavoda lo amra chen. uvishvil aviha kansu kol hammishpacha. deoy larasha veoy lishcheno, tov latztzaddik tov lishcheno:
